38.s:
agnir uvāca
vāsudevādyālayasya kṛtau vakṣye phalādikaṃ /
cikīrṣordevadhāmādi sahasrajanipāpanut //
38.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वासुदेवाद्यालयस्य कृतौ वक्ष्ये फलादिकं /
चिकीर्षोर्देवधामादि सहस्रजनिपापनुत् //
38.m: Agni said: / I shall explain the fruit and further [benefits] in the construction of an abode for Vāsudeva and other deities. / Even desiring to build a divine dwelling and the like destroys sins of a thousand births.

38.s:
manasā sadmakartṝṇāṃ śatajanmāghanāśanaṃ /
yenumodanti kṛṣṇasya kriyamāṇaṃ narā gṛhaṃ(1) //
38.d:
मनसा सद्मकर्तॄणां शतजन्माघनाशनं /
येनुमोदन्ति कृष्णस्य क्रियमाणं नरा गृहं(1) //
38.m: For those who build an abode in thought, sins of a hundred births are destroyed. / Men who rejoice in a house being built for Kṛṣṇa,

38.s:
tepi pāpair vinirmuktāḥ prayāntyacyutalokatāṃ /
samatītaṃ bhaviṣyañca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ //
38.d:
तेपि पापैर् विनिर्मुक्ताः प्रयान्त्यच्युतलोकतां /
समतीतं भविष्यञ्च कुलानामयुतं नरः //
38.m: they too, released from sins, go to the world of Acyuta. / Having caused a house of Hari to be built, a man quickly leads

38.s:
viṣṇulokaṃ nayatyāśu kārayitvā harergṛhaṃ /
vasanti(2) pitaro dṛṣṭvā(3) viṣṇuloke hy alaṅkṛtāḥ //
38.d:
विष्णुलोकं नयत्याशु कारयित्वा हरेर्गृहं /
वसन्ति(2) पितरो दृष्ट्वा(3) विष्णुलोके ह्य् अलङ्कृताः //
38.m: ten thousand past and future families to the world of Viṣṇu. / Seeing a temple of Kṛṣṇa made by the builder, the ancestors,

38.s:
vimuktā nārakair duḥkhaiḥ kartuḥ kṛṣṇasya mandiraṃ /
brahmahatyādipāpaughaghātakaṃ devatālayaṃ //
38.d:
विमुक्ता नारकैर् दुःखैः कर्तुः कृष्णस्य मन्दिरं /
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापौघघातकं देवतालयं //
38.m: adorned and freed from the torments of hell, dwell in the world of Viṣṇu. / A temple of the deity destroys a flood of sins such as the slaying of a brahmin.

38.s:
phalaṃ yannāpyate yajñair dhāma kṛtvā tadāpyate /
devāgāre kṛte sarvatīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet //
38.d:
फलं यन्नाप्यते यज्ञैर् धाम कृत्वा तदाप्यते /
देवागारे कृते सर्वतीर्थस्नानफलं लभेत् //
38.m: The fruit which is not obtained through sacrifices is obtained by making a dwelling [for God]. / When an abode for God is built, one obtains the fruit of bathing at all sacred fords.

38.s:
devādyarthe hatānāñca raṇe yattatphalādikaṃ /
śāṭhyena pāṃśunā vāpi kṛtaṃ dhāma ca nākadaṃ //
:n
1 gṛhādikaṃ ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 nandanti iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ / valganti iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 hṛṣṭā iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 109
38.d:
देवाद्यर्थे हतानाञ्च रणे यत्तत्फलादिकं /
शाठ्येन पांशुना वापि कृतं धाम च नाकदं //
:न्
1 गृहादिकं ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 नन्दन्ति इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः / वल्गन्ति इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 हृष्टा इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 109
38.m:
Whatever fruit and benefits belong to those slain in battle for the sake of the gods and the like, / an abode built even in deceit or with dust bestows heaven.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "gṛhādikam" is the reading in the two manuscripts Ga and Gha.]
[Footnote 2: "nandanti" is the reading in the two manuscripts Kha and Ga; "valganti" is the reading in manuscript Ña.]
[Footnote 3: "hṛṣṭāḥ" is the reading in the two manuscripts Kha and Ga.]

38.s:
ekāyatanakṛt svargī tryagārī brahmalokabhāk /
pañcāgārī śambhulokamaṣṭāgārāddharau sthitiḥ //
38.d:
एकायतनकृत् स्वर्गी त्र्यगारी ब्रह्मलोकभाक् /
पञ्चागारी शम्भुलोकमष्टागाराद्धरौ स्थितिः //
38.m: One who builds a single temple goes to heaven; one who builds three houses attains the world of Brahmā; / one who builds five houses attains the world of Śambhu; through eight houses there is residence in Hari.

38.s:
ṣoḍaśālayakārī tu(1) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārayitvā harergṛhaṃ //
38.d:
षोडशालयकारी तु(1) भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
कनिष्ठं मध्यमं श्रेष्ठं कारयित्वा हरेर्गृहं //
38.m: One who makes sixteen temples, however, attains worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Having caused a house of Hari to be built—small, medium, or superior—

38.s:
svargaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ mokṣamāpnoti ca kramāt /
śreṣṭhamāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā yaddhanavān labhet //
38.d:
स्वर्गं च वैष्णवं लोकं मोक्षमाप्नोति च क्रमात् /
श्रेष्ठमायतनं विष्णोः कृत्वा यद्धनवान् लभेत् //
38.m: he attains, in order, heaven, the world of Viṣṇu, and liberation. / Whatever a wealthy man would obtain by making a superior temple of Viṣṇu,

38.s:
kaniṣṭhenaiva tat puṇyaṃ prāpnotyadhanavānnaraḥ /
samutpādya dhanaṃ kṛtyā svalpenāpi(2) surālayaṃ //
38.d:
कनिष्ठेनैव तत् पुण्यं प्राप्नोत्यधनवान्नरः /
समुत्पाद्य धनं कृत्या स्वल्पेनापि(2) सुरालयं //
38.m: a man without wealth obtains that same religious merit merely with the smallest [shrine]. / Having acquired wealth by work, even with a little, a temple of the gods [may be built].

38.s:
kārayitvā hareḥ puṇyaṃ samprāpnotyadhikaṃ varaṃ /
lakṣaṇātha sahasreṇa śatenārdhena vā hareḥ //
38.d:
कारयित्वा हरेः पुण्यं सम्प्राप्नोत्यधिकं वरं /
लक्षणाथ सहस्रेण शतेनार्धेन वा हरेः //
38.m: Having caused [a temple] of Hari to be made, he attains great and supreme merit. / With a hundred thousand, a thousand, a hundred, or with half of that, for Hari

38.s:
kārayan bhavanaṃ yāti yatrāste garuḍadhvajaḥ /
bālye tu krīḍamāṇā ye pāṃśubhirbhavanaṃ hareḥ //
38.d:
कारयन् भवनं याति यत्रास्ते गरुडध्वजः /
बाल्ये तु क्रीडमाणा ये पांशुभिर्भवनं हरेः //
38.m: one who causes an abode to be made goes where the Garuḍa-bannered [Lord] resides. / Those who in childhood, playing with dust, make an abode of Hari,

38.s:
vāsudevasya kurvanti tepi tallokagāminaḥ /
tīrthe cāyatane puṇye saddhakṣetre tathāṣṭame //
38.d:
वासुदेवस्य कुर्वन्ति तेपि तल्लोकगामिनः /
तीर्थे चायतने पुण्ये सद्धक्षेत्रे तथाष्टमे //
38.m: of Vāsudeva, they too go to his realm. / At a sacred ford, in a sacred shrine, in a sacred field, and likewise in the eighth,

38.s:
karturāyatanaṃ viṣṇoryathoktāttriguṇaṃ phalaṃ /
bandhūkapuṣpavinyāsaiḥ sudhāpaṅkena vaiṣṇavaṃ //
38.d:
कर्तुरायतनं विष्णोर्यथोक्तात्त्रिगुणं फलं /
बन्धूकपुष्पविन्यासैः सुधापङ्केन वैष्णवं //
38.m: the builder of a temple of Viṣṇu obtains three times the fruit stated [elsewhere]. / Those who smear the abode of Viṣṇu with arrangements of bandhūka flowers,

38.s:
ye vilimpanti bhavanaṃ te yānti bhagavatpuraṃ /
patitaṃ patamānantu tathārdhapatitaṃ naraḥ //
38.d:
ये विलिम्पन्ति भवनं ते यान्ति भगवत्पुरं /
पतितं पतमानन्तु तथार्धपतितं नरः //
38.m: and with whitewash plaster, go to the city of the Lord. / A man who restores Hari's abode that has fallen,

38.s:
samuddhṛtya harerdhāma prāpnoti dviguṇaṃ phalaṃ /
patitasya tu yaḥ kartā patitasya ca rakṣitā //
38.d:
समुद्धृत्य हरेर्धाम प्राप्नोति द्विगुणं फलं /
पतितस्य तु यः कर्ता पतितस्य च रक्षिता //
38.m: or is falling, or has half fallen, obtains double the fruit. / The one who rebuilds what has fallen and protects what has fallen

38.s:
viṣṇorāyatanasyeha naro viṣṇulokabhāk /
iṣṭakānicayastiṣṭhed yāvadāyatane hareḥ //
38.d:
विष्णोरायतनस्येह नरो विष्णुलोकभाक् /
इष्टकानिचयस्तिष्ठेद् यावदायतने हरेः //
38.m: of Viṣṇu's temple, that man partakes of Viṣṇu's realm. / As long as the pile of bricks remains in the temple of Hari,

38.s:
sakulastasya vai kartā viṣṇuloke mahīyate /
:n
1 ṣoḍaśāgārakārī tu iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 svalpenaiveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 110
sa eva puṇyavān pūjya iha loke paratra ca //
38.d:
सकुलस्तस्य वै कर्ता विष्णुलोके महीयते /
:न्
1 षोडशागारकारी तु इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्वल्पेनैवेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 110
स एव पुण्यवान् पूज्य इह लोके परत्र च //
38.m:
its builder is indeed honored along with his family in Viṣṇu's realm.
[Footnote]
1. "ṣoḍaśāgārakārī tu" is the reading in manuscript ga.
2. "svalpenaiva" is the reading in manuscript kha. / [Page 110]
He alone is meritorious and worthy of worship in this world and in the next.

38.s:
kṛṣṇasya vāsudevasya yaḥ kārayati ketanaṃ /
jātaḥ sa eva sukṛtī kulantenaiva pāvitaṃ //
38.d:
कृष्णस्य वासुदेवस्य यः कारयति केतनं /
जातः स एव सुकृती कुलन्तेनैव पावितं //
38.m: He who causes a shrine of Kṛṣṇa Vāsudeva to be made / is born a performer of good deeds; his family is purified by him alone.

38.s:
viṣṇurudrārkadevyādergṛhakartā sa kīrtibhāk /
kiṃ tasya vittanicayair mūḍhasya parirakṣitaḥ //
38.d:
विष्णुरुद्रार्कदेव्यादेर्गृहकर्ता स कीर्तिभाक् /
किं तस्य वित्तनिचयैर् मूढस्य परिरक्षितः //
38.m: The builder of a house of Viṣṇu, Rudra, the Sun, the Goddess, and others partakes of renown. / What is the use of his stores of wealth guarded by that fool,

38.s:
duḥkhārjitair yaḥ kṛṣṇasya na kārayati ketanaṃ /
nopabhogyaṃ dhanaṃ yasya pitṛvipradivaukasāṃ //
38.d:
दुःखार्जितैर् यः कृष्णस्य न कारयति केतनं /
नोपभोग्यं धनं यस्य पितृविप्रदिवौकसां //
38.m: acquired with hardship, who does not cause a shrine of Kṛṣṇa to be made? / One whose wealth cannot be enjoyed by ancestors, Brahmins, and gods,

38.s:
nopabhogāya bandhūnāṃ vyarthastasya dhanāgamaḥ /
yathā dhruvo nṛṇāṃ mṛtyurvittanāśas tathā dhruvaḥ //
38.d:
नोपभोगाय बन्धूनां व्यर्थस्तस्य धनागमः /
यथा ध्रुवो नृणां मृत्युर्वित्तनाशस् तथा ध्रुवः //
38.m: nor for the enjoyment of relatives—his acquisition of wealth is futile. / Just as death is certain for mortals, so the destruction of wealth is certain.

38.s:
mūḍhastatrānubadhnāti jīvitetha cale ghane /
yadā vittaṃ na dānāya nopabhogāya dehināṃ //
38.d:
मूढस्तत्रानुबध्नाति जीवितेथ चले घने /
यदा वित्तं न दानाय नोपभोगाय देहिनां //
38.m: A fool clings to life and to wealth, though it is unsteady. / When wealth is neither for giving nor for enjoyment by embodied beings,

38.s:
nāpi kīrtyai na dharmāthaṃ tasya svāmyetha ko guṇaḥ /
tasmādvittaṃ samāsādya daivādvā pauruṣādatha //
38.d:
नापि कीर्त्यै न धर्माथं तस्य स्वाम्येथ को गुणः /
तस्माद्वित्तं समासाद्य दैवाद्वा पौरुषादथ //
38.m: nor for fame, nor for righteousness—then what virtue is there in ownership of it? / Therefore, having obtained wealth, whether through destiny or through human effort,

38.s:
dadyāt samyag dvijāgryebhyaḥ kīrtanāni ca kārayet /
dānebhyaścādhikaṃ yasmāt kīrtanebhyo varaṃ yataḥ //
38.d:
दद्यात् सम्यग् द्विजाग्र्येभ्यः कीर्तनानि च कारयेत् /
दानेभ्यश्चाधिकं यस्मात् कीर्तनेभ्यो वरं यतः //
38.m: one should give it properly to the foremost twice-born and cause monuments to be built. / Because it is greater than gifts and superior to monuments,

38.s:
atastatkārayeddhīmān viṣṇvādermandirādikaṃ /
viniveśya harerdhāma bhaktimadbhir narottamaiḥ //
38.d:
अतस्तत्कारयेद्धीमान् विष्ण्वादेर्मन्दिरादिकं /
विनिवेश्य हरेर्धाम भक्तिमद्भिर् नरोत्तमैः //
38.m: therefore a wise man should cause a temple and so forth of Viṣṇu and others to be built. / When Hari's abode is established by the best of men endowed with devotion,

38.s:
niveśitaṃ bhavet kṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaraṃ /
bhūtaṃ bhavayam bhaviṣyañca sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tathetarat(1) //
38.d:
निवेशितं भवेत् कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरं /
भूतं भवयम् भविष्यञ्च स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं तथेतरत्(1) //
38.m: the entire triple world with its mobile and immobile beings would be established— / past, present, and future, gross, subtle, and other,

38.s:
ābrāhmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇoḥ samudbhavaṃ /
tasya devādidevasya sarvagasya(2) mahātmanaḥ //
38.d:
आब्राह्मस्तम्बपर्यन्तं सर्वं विष्णोः समुद्भवं /
तस्य देवादिदेवस्य सर्वगस्य(2) महात्मनः //
38.m: all arising from Viṣṇu, from Brahmā down to a clump of grass. / For that god of gods, all-pervading and great-souled,

38.s:
niveśya bhavanaṃ viṣṇor na bhūyo bhuvi jāyate /
yathā viṣṇordhāmakṛtau phalaṃ tadvaddivaukasāṃ //
:n
1 tathaiva ca iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sarveśasya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 111
38.d:
निवेश्य भवनं विष्णोर् न भूयो भुवि जायते /
यथा विष्णोर्धामकृतौ फलं तद्वद्दिवौकसां //
:न्
1 तथैव च इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सर्वेशस्य इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 111
38.m:
having established an abode of Viṣṇu, one is not born on earth again. / As is the fruit in building an abode of Viṣṇu, so it is for the gods,
[Footnote]
1. "tathaiva ca" is the reading in manuscript ga.
2. "sarveśasya" is the reading in manuscript kha. / [Page 111]

38.s:
śivabrahmārkavighneśacaṇḍīlakṣmyādikātmanāṃ /
devālayakṛteḥ puṇyaṃ pratimākaraṇedhikaṃ(3) //
38.d:
शिवब्रह्मार्कविघ्नेशचण्डीलक्ष्म्यादिकात्मनां /
देवालयकृतेः पुण्यं प्रतिमाकरणेधिकं(3) //
38.m: whose essence is Śiva, Brahmā, the Sun, the Lord of Obstacles, Caṇḍī, Lakṣmī, and others. / The merit from making an image is greater than [that from] making an abode for a deity;

38.s:
pratimāsthāpane yāge phalasyānto na vidyate /
mṛṇmayāddāruje puṇyaṃ dārujādiṣṭkābhave //
38.d:
प्रतिमास्थापने यागे फलस्यान्तो न विद्यते /
मृण्मयाद्दारुजे पुण्यं दारुजादिष्ट्काभवे //
38.m: in the consecration and ritual worship of an image, there is no end to the fruit. / Merit from a wooden [image] is greater than from an earthen one; greater in one made of brick than in a wooden one;

38.s:
iṣṭakotthācchailaje syāddhemāderadhikaṃ phalaṃ /
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prārambhādeva naśyati //
38.d:
इष्टकोत्थाच्छैलजे स्याद्धेमादेरधिकं फलं /
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं प्रारम्भादेव नश्यति //
38.m: greater fruit would be from a stone one than from a brick one; and greater from gold and the like. / Sin committed across seven births is destroyed from the very beginning [of construction].

38.s:
devālayasya svargī syānnarakaṃ na sa gacchati /
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ nayennaraḥ //
38.d:
देवालयस्य स्वर्गी स्यान्नरकं न स गच्छति /
कुलानां शतमुद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं नयेन्नरः //
38.m: [The builder] of a deity's temple goes to heaven; he does not go to hell. / Having lifted up a hundred ancestral lines, a man leads them to Viṣṇu's realm.

38.s:
yamo yamabhaṭānāha devamandirakāriṇaḥ /
yama uvāca
pratimāpūjādikṛto nāneyā narakaṃ narāḥ //
38.d:
यमो यमभटानाह देवमन्दिरकारिणः /
यम उवाच
प्रतिमापूजादिकृतो नानेया नरकं नराः //
38.m: Yama spoke to Yama's soldiers regarding the makers of a deity's temple. / Yama said: / "Men who perform image worship and the like are not to be brought to hell;

38.s:
devālayādyakartāra āneyāste tu gocare(1) /
visāradhvaṃ yathānyāyanniyogo mama pālyatāṃ (2) //
38.d:
देवालयाद्यकर्तार आनेयास्ते तु गोचरे(1) /
विसारध्वं यथान्यायन्नियोगो मम पाल्यतां (2) //
38.m: those who do not build deities' temples and the like are to be brought within your range. / Spread out according to rule; let my order be maintained.

38.s:
nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacit /
kevalaṃ te jagattātamanantaṃ samupāśritāḥ //
38.d:
नाज्ञाभङ्गं करिष्यन्ति भवतां जन्तवः क्वचित् /
केवलं ते जगत्तातमनन्तं समुपाश्रिताः //
38.m: Living beings will never disobey your command, / except only those who have taken refuge in the eternal Father of the universe.

38.s:
bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyāsteṣāṃ nātrāsti saṃsthitiḥ /
ye ca bhagavatā loke taccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ //
38.d:
भवद्भिः परिहर्तव्यास्तेषां नात्रास्ति संस्थितिः /
ये च भगवता लोके तच्चित्तास्तत्परायणाः //
38.m: They must be avoided by you; they have no dwelling here. / And in this world, those who are devoted to the Lord, their minds fixed on him, dedicated to him,

38.s:
pūjayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ /
yastiṣṭhan prasvapan gacchannuttiṣṭhan skhalite sthite(4) //
38.d:
पूजयन्ति सदा विष्णुं ते वस्त्याज्याः सुदूरतः /
यस्तिष्ठन् प्रस्वपन् गच्छन्नुत्तिष्ठन् स्खलिते स्थिते(4) //
38.m: who always worship Viṣṇu—they are to be abandoned far away by you. / Whoever standing, sleeping, walking, rising, stumbling, or stationary

38.s:
saṅkīrtayanti govindaṃ te vastyājyāḥ sudūrataḥ /
nityanaimittikair devaṃ ye yajanti janārdanam //
38.d:
सङ्कीर्तयन्ति गोविन्दं ते वस्त्याज्याः सुदूरतः /
नित्यनैमित्तिकैर् देवं ये यजन्ति जनार्दनम् //
38.m: praises Govinda—they are to be abandoned far away by you. / Those who worship the god Janārdana through obligatory and occasional rites

38.s:
nāvalokyā bhavadbhiste tadgatā yānti tadgatim /
:n
1 āneyāstvaviśeṣata iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 niyamo me 'nupālyatāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 jantavaḥ kvaciditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 112
ye puṣpadhūpavāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiścātivallabhaiḥ //
38.d:
नावलोक्या भवद्भिस्ते तद्गता यान्ति तद्गतिम् /
:न्
1 आनेयास्त्वविशेषत इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 नियमो मे ऽनुपाल्यतामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 जन्तवः क्वचिदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 112
ये पुष्पधूपवासोभिर्भूषणैश्चातिवल्लभैः //
38.m:
are not to be looked upon by you; absorbed in him, they attain his state.
[Footnote]
1. "āneyāstvaviśeṣata" is the reading in manuscript ga.
2. "niyamo me 'nupālyatām" is the reading in manuscript kha.
3. "jantavaḥ kvacid" is the reading in manuscript kha. / [Page 112]
Those who, with flowers, incense, garments, and very dear ornaments,

38.s:
arcayanti na te grāhyā narāḥ kṛṣṇālaye gatāḥ(1) /
upalepanakartāraḥ sammārjanaparāś ca ye //
38.d:
अर्चयन्ति न ते ग्राह्या नराः कृष्णालये गताः(1) /
उपलेपनकर्तारः सम्मार्जनपराश् च ये //
38.m: worship—those men who have entered Kṛṣṇa's temple are not to be seized. / Those who perform plastering and who are devoted to sweeping

38.s:
kṛṣṇālaye parityajyāsteṣāṃ putrās tathā kulam /
yena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavam //
38.d:
कृष्णालये परित्यज्यास्तेषां पुत्रास् तथा कुलम् /
येन चायतनं विष्णोः कारितं तत्कुलोद्भवम् //
38.m: in Kṛṣṇa's temple are to be spared, and so are their sons and their family. / And by whom Viṣṇu's temple was caused to be made, born in his family

38.s:
puṃsāṃ śataṃ nāvalokyaṃ bhavadbhirduṣṭacetasā /
yastu devālayaṃ viṣṇordāruśailamayaṃ tathā //
38.d:
पुंसां शतं नावलोक्यं भवद्भिर्दुष्टचेतसा /
यस्तु देवालयं विष्णोर्दारुशैलमयं तथा //
38.m: a hundred men must not be looked upon by you with evil intent. / He who causes a deity's temple of Viṣṇu to be made of wood or stone,

38.s:
kārayen mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
ahanyahani yajñena yajato yan mahāphalam //
38.d:
कारयेन् मृण्मयं वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
अहन्यहनि यज्ञेन यजतो यन् महाफलम् //
38.m: or even of clay, is freed from all sins. / What great fruit belongs to one sacrificing with sacrifice day by day,

38.s:
prāpnoti tat phalaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ kārayati ketanaṃ /
kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ tathā śataṃ //
38.d:
प्राप्नोति तत् फलं विष्णोर्यः कारयति केतनं /
कुलानां शतमागामि समतीतं तथा शतं //
38.m: that fruit he attains who causes Viṣṇu's shrine to be made. / A hundred future ancestral lines and likewise a hundred past ones,

38.s:
kārayan bhagavaddhāma nayatyacyutalokatāṃ /
saptalokamayo viṣṇustasya yaḥ kurute gṛhaṃ //
38.d:
कारयन् भगवद्धाम नयत्यच्युतलोकतां /
सप्तलोकमयो विष्णुस्तस्य यः कुरुते गृहं //
38.m: he, causing the Lord's abode to be made, leads to the realm of Acyuta. / Viṣṇu consists of the seven worlds; he who makes a house for him

38.s:
tārayatyakṣayāṃllokānakṣayān pratipadyate /
iṣṭakācayavinyāso yāvantyabdāni tiṣṭhati //
38.d:
तारयत्यक्षयांल्लोकानक्षयान् प्रतिपद्यते /
इष्टकाचयविन्यासो यावन्त्यब्दानि तिष्ठति //
38.m: delivers imperishable worlds and attains imperishable [worlds]. / As many years as the arrangement of the brick structure remains,

38.s:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkarturdivi saṃsthitiḥ /
pratimākṛdviṣṇulokaṃ sthāpako līyate harau /
devasadmapratikṛtipratiṣṭhākṛttu gocare //
38.d:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि तत्कर्तुर्दिवि संस्थितिः /
प्रतिमाकृद्विष्णुलोकं स्थापको लीयते हरौ /
देवसद्मप्रतिकृतिप्रतिष्ठाकृत्तु गोचरे //
38.m: for that many thousands of years is its builder's stay in heaven. / The maker of an image goes to Viṣṇu's realm; the installer is dissolved into Hari; / but the one who performs the consecration of a deity's house and image is in [our] purview."

38.s:
agnir uvāca
yamoktā nānayaṃstetha pratiṣṭhādikṛtaṃ hareḥ /
hayaśīrṣaḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ(2) devānāṃ brahmaṇe 'bravīt //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye devālayādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma
aṣṭatriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kṛṣṇāśraye gatā iti kha, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 pratiṣṭhādyamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 113
:ś athonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhūparigrahavidhānaṃ
38.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
यमोक्ता नानयंस्तेथ प्रतिष्ठादिकृतं हरेः /
हयशीर्षः प्रतिष्ठार्थं(2) देवानां ब्रह्मणे ऽब्रवीत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये देवालयादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम
अष्टत्रिंशोध्यायः ||
:न्
1 कृष्णाश्रये गता इति ख, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 प्रतिष्ठाद्यमिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 113
:श् अथोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
भूपरिग्रहविधानं
38.m:
Agni said: / Directed by Yama, they did not bring those who performed consecration and other rites of Hari. / Hayaśīrṣa explained to Brahmā the procedure for consecration of the gods.
Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, named "Description of the Glorification of Temples of the Gods and Other Matters," in the venerable first Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
1. "kṛṣṇāśraye gatā" is the reading in the three manuscripts kha, gha, and ṅa.
2. "pratiṣṭhādyam" is the reading in the two manuscripts kha and ṅa. / [Page 113]
Now, the thirty-ninth chapter.
The Rule for the Acquisition of Land

39.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
viṣṇvādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhādi vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me /
proktāni pañcarātarāṇi saptarātrāṇi vai mayā //
39.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
विष्ण्वादीनां प्रतिष्ठादि वक्ष्ये ब्रह्मन् शृणुष्व मे /
प्रोक्तानि पञ्चरातराणि सप्तरात्राणि वै मया //
39.m: Hayagrīva said: / I shall declare the consecration and other rites of Viṣṇu and others; listen to me, O Brahmā. / The Pañcarātra and Saptarātra systems were indeed taught by me.

39.s:
vyastāni munibhirloke pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā /
hayaśīrṣaṃ tantramādyaṃ tantraṃ trailokyamohanaṃ //
39.d:
व्यस्तानि मुनिभिर्लोके पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यया /
हयशीर्षं तन्त्रमाद्यं तन्त्रं त्रैलोक्यमोहनं //
39.m: were divided by the sages in the world into the number of twenty-five: / The first is the Hayaśīrṣa Tantra, [then] the Trailokyamohana Tantra,

39.s:
vaibhavaṃ pauṣkaraṃ tantraṃ prahrādaṅgārgyagālavaṃ /
nāradīyañca sampraśnaṃ śāṇḍilyaṃ vaiśvakaṃ(1) tathā //
39.d:
वैभवं पौष्करं तन्त्रं प्रह्रादङ्गार्ग्यगालवं /
नारदीयञ्च सम्प्रश्नं शाण्डिल्यं वैश्वकं(1) तथा //
39.m: the Vaibhava, the Pauṣkara Tantra, the Prahrāda, Gārgya, Gālava, / the Nāradīya, the Sampraśna, the Śāṇḍilya, and the Vaiśvaka,

39.s:
satyoktaṃ śaunakaṃ tantraṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ jñānasāgaraṃ /
svāyambhuvaṃ kapilañca tārkṣaṃ nārāyaṇīyakaṃ //
39.d:
सत्योक्तं शौनकं तन्त्रं वासिष्ठं ज्ञानसागरं /
स्वायम्भुवं कपिलञ्च तार्क्षं नारायणीयकं //
39.m: the Śaunaka Tantra spoken by Satya, the Vāsiṣṭha, the Jñānasāgara, / the Svāyambhuva, the Kapila, the Tārkṣya, the Nārāyaṇīyaka,

39.s:
ātreyaṃ nārasiṃhākhyamānandākhyaṃ tathāruṇaṃ /
baudhāyanaṃ tathārṣaṃ tu(2) viśvoktaṃ tasya sārataḥ //
39.d:
आत्रेयं नारसिंहाख्यमानन्दाख्यं तथारुणं /
बौधायनं तथार्षं तु(2) विश्वोक्तं तस्य सारतः //
39.m: the Ātreya, the one called Nārasiṃha, the one called Ānanda, and the Āruṇa, / the Baudhāyana, and the Ārṣa, and the Viśvokta out of its essence.

39.s:
pratiṣṭhāṃ hi dvijaḥ kuryānmadhyadeśādisambhavaḥ /
nakacchadeśasambhūtaḥ kāverīkoṅkaṇodgataḥ //
39.d:
प्रतिष्ठां हि द्विजः कुर्यान्मध्यदेशादिसम्भवः /
नकच्छदेशसम्भूतः कावेरीकोङ्कणोद्गतः //
39.m: Indeed, a twice-born born in the Madhyadeśa or similar regions should perform the consecration, / not one born in the Kaccha region, nor one hailing from the Kāverī or Koṅkaṇa,

39.s:
kāmarūpakaliṅgoptyaḥ kāñcīkāśmīrakośalaḥ(3) /
ākāśavāyutejombu bhūretāḥ pañca rātrayaḥ //
39.d:
कामरूपकलिङ्गोप्त्यः काञ्चीकाश्मीरकोशलः(3) /
आकाशवायुतेजोम्बु भूरेताः पञ्च रात्रयः //
39.m: nor one produced in Kāmarūpa or Kaliṅga, nor one from Kāñcī, Kāśmīra, or Kośala. / Space, wind, fire, water, and earth—these are the five nights (pañcarātra);

39.s:
acaitanyāstamodriktāḥ pañcarātravivarjitaṃ /
brahmāhaṃ viṣṇuramala iti vidyātsa deśikaḥ //
39.d:
अचैतन्यास्तमोद्रिक्ताः पञ्चरात्रविवर्जितं /
ब्रह्माहं विष्णुरमल इति विद्यात्स देशिकः //
39.m: devoid of consciousness, they are dominated by darkness (tamas). The preceptor should know / [himself] free of the five nights, [reflecting,] 'I am Brahmā, the stainless Viṣṇu.'

39.s:
sarvalakṣaṇahīṇopi sa gurustantrapāragaḥ /
:n
1 caiśvaraṃ tatheti ga, ṅa, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 tathāṣṭāṅgamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 kāśmīrake sthita iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 114
nagarābhimukhāḥ sthāpyā devā na ca parāṅmukhāḥ //
39.d:
सर्वलक्षणहीणोपि स गुरुस्तन्त्रपारगः /
:न्
1 चैश्वरं तथेति ग, ङ, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 तथाष्टाङ्गमिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 काश्मीरके स्थित इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 114
नगराभिमुखाः स्थाप्या देवा न च पराङ्मुखाः //
39.m:
Even if bereft of all physical marks, he is a guru who has mastered the tantras.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "caiśvaraṃ tathā" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, ṅa, and gha.]
[Footnote 2: "tathāṣṭāṅgam" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.]
[Footnote 3: "kāśmīrake sthitaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.]
Deities should be installed facing towards the settlement, not facing away [from it].

39.s:
kurukṣetre gayādau ca nadīnāntu(1) samīpataḥ /
brahmā madhye tu nagare pūrve śakrasya śobhanaṃ //
39.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रे गयादौ च नदीनान्तु(1) समीपतः /
ब्रह्मा मध्ये तु नगरे पूर्वे शक्रस्य शोभनं //
39.m: In Kurukṣetra, Gayā, and other places, and near rivers: / Brahmā in the center of the town, and in the east [a temple] of Śakra is auspicious;

39.s:
agnāvagneś ca mātṝṇāṃ bhūtānāñca yamasya ca /
dakṣiṇe caṇḍikāyāś ca pitṛdaityādikasya ca //
39.d:
अग्नावग्नेश् च मातॄणां भूतानाञ्च यमस्य च /
दक्षिणे चण्डिकायाश् च पितृदैत्यादिकस्य च //
39.m: in the southeast, of Agni, of the Mothers, and of the spirits (bhūtas); and of Yama / in the south; and of Caṇḍikā, of the ancestors (pitṛs), daityas, and so forth,

39.s:
vairṛte mandiraṃ kuryāt varuṇādadeś ca vāruṇe /
vāyor nāgasya vāyavye saumye yakṣaguhasya ca //
39.d:
वैरृते मन्दिरं कुर्यात् वरुणाददेश् च वारुणे /
वायोर् नागस्य वायव्ये सौम्ये यक्षगुहस्य च //
39.m: in the southwest one should build a shrine; and of Varuṇa and others in the west; / of Vāyu and the Nāga in the northwest; of the Yakṣa and Guha in the north;

39.s:
caṇḍīśasya maheśasya aiśe viṣṇoś ca sarvaśaḥ /
pūrvadevakulaṃ pīḍya prāsādaṃ svalpakaṃ tvatha //
39.d:
चण्डीशस्य महेशस्य ऐशे विष्णोश् च सर्वशः /
पूर्वदेवकुलं पीड्य प्रासादं स्वल्पकं त्वथ //
39.m: of Caṇḍīśa and Maheśa in the northeast, and of Viṣṇu everywhere. / Encroaching upon an existing shrine of a deity, a temple, whether small,

39.s:
samaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi na kartavyaṃ vijānatā /
ubhayordviguṇāṃ sīmāṃ tyaktvā cocchrayasammitāṃ //
39.d:
समं वाप्यधिकं वापि न कर्तव्यं विजानता /
उभयोर्द्विगुणां सीमां त्यक्त्वा चोच्छ्रयसम्मितां //
39.m: equal, or even larger, must not be constructed by a knowledgeable person. / Leaving a boundary twice [the height] of both, equal to their elevation,

39.s:
prāsādaṃ kārayedanyaṃ nobhayaṃ pīḍayedbudhaḥ /
bhūmau tu śodhitāyāṃ tu kuryādbhumiparigrahaṃ //
39.d:
प्रासादं कारयेदन्यं नोभयं पीडयेद्बुधः /
भूमौ तु शोधितायां तु कुर्याद्भुमिपरिग्रहं //
39.m: the wise person should construct another temple, and should not encroach upon either. / Only when the ground has been purified should one take possession of the site.

39.s:
prākārasīmāparyantaṃ tato bhutabaliṃ haret /
māṣaṃ haridrācūrṇantu salājaṃ dadhisaktubhiḥ //
39.d:
प्राकारसीमापर्यन्तं ततो भुतबलिं हरेत् /
माषं हरिद्राचूर्णन्तु सलाजं दधिसक्तुभिः //
39.m: Up to the limit of the boundary wall, one should then offer a bali oblation to the spirits (bhūtas): / black gram, turmeric powder, along with parched grain, curd, and roasted barley meal.

39.s:
aṣṭākṣareṇa saktūṃś ca pātāyitvāṣṭadikṣu ca /
rākṣasāś ca piśācāś ca yesmiṃstiṣṭhanti bhūtale //
39.d:
अष्टाक्षरेण सक्तूंश् च पातायित्वाष्टदिक्षु च /
राक्षसाश् च पिशाचाश् च येस्मिंस्तिष्ठन्ति भूतले //
39.m: Having scattered the barley meal in the eight directions with the eight-syllable mantra, [one recites:] / 'Whatever rākṣasas and piśācas reside on this surface of the earth,

39.s:
sarve te vyapagacchantu sthānaṃ kuryāmahaṃ hareḥ /
halena vāhayitvā gāṃ gobhiś caivāvadārayet //
39.d:
सर्वे ते व्यपगच्छन्तु स्थानं कुर्यामहं हरेः /
हलेन वाहयित्वा गां गोभिश् चैवावदारयेत् //
39.m: may all of them depart; I am making an abode for Hari!' / Having ploughed the earth with a plough, he should also have it trodden by cows.

39.s: pramāṇvaṣṭakenaiva trasareṇuḥ prakīrtyate //19//
39.d: प्रमाण्वष्टकेनैव त्रसरेणुः प्रकीर्त्यते //19//
39.m: A mote in a sunbeam (trasareṇu) is designated by eight paramāṇus. //19

39.s:
tair aṣṭabhistu bālāgraṃ likhyā tair aṣṭabhirmatā /
tābhiryūkāṣṭabhiḥ khyātā tāścāṣṭau yavamadhyamaḥ //
:n
1 nadyadriṣu iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 115
39.d:
तैर् अष्टभिस्तु बालाग्रं लिख्या तैर् अष्टभिर्मता /
ताभिर्यूकाष्टभिः ख्याता ताश्चाष्टौ यवमध्यमः //
:न्
1 नद्यद्रिषु इति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 115
39.m:
By eight of them, a hair's tip (bālāgra); by eight of those, a nit (likhyā) is considered; / by eight of those, a louse (yūkā) is declared; and eight of those make a middling barley-corn (yava).
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "nadyadriṣu" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa.]

39.s:
yavāṣṭakair aṅgulaṃ syāccaturviṃśāṅgulaḥ karaḥ /
caturaṅgulasaṃyuktaḥ sa hastaḥ(1) padmahastakaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratiṣṭhāyāṃ bhūparigraho
nāmonacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
arghyadānavidhānaṃ
39.d:
यवाष्टकैर् अङ्गुलं स्याच्चतुर्विंशाङ्गुलः करः /
चतुरङ्गुलसंयुक्तः स हस्तः(1) पद्महस्तकः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रतिष्ठायां भूपरिग्रहो
नामोनचत्वारिंशोध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
अर्घ्यदानविधानं
39.m:
By eight barley-corns, there is a digit (aṅgula); a cubit (kara) is twenty-four digits; / joined with four digits, that cubit is a lotus-cubit (padmahasta).
Thus in the primal Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni, in [the section on] consecration, the thirty-ninth chapter, entitled "Taking Possession of the Site."
Now the fortieth chapter.
The Rule for Presenting Offerings

40.s:
bhagavānuvāca
pūrvamāsit mahadbhūtaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraṃ /
taddevair nihitaṃ bhumau sa vāstupuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ //
40.d:
भगवानुवाच
पूर्वमासित् महद्भूतं सर्वभूतभयङ्करं /
तद्देवैर् निहितं भुमौ स वास्तुपुरुषः स्मृतः //
40.m: The Blessed Lord said: / Formerly there was a great being that caused terror to all beings; / it was cast down onto the earth by the gods, and is remembered as the Vāstupuruṣa.

40.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭipade kṣetre īśaṃ koṇārdhasaṃsthitaṃ /
ghṛtākṣataistarpayettaṃ parjanyaṃ padagataṃ tataḥ //
40.d:
चतुःषष्टिपदे क्षेत्रे ईशं कोणार्धसंस्थितं /
घृताक्षतैस्तर्पयेत्तं पर्जन्यं पदगतं ततः //
40.m: On a grid of sixty-four squares, situated in half a square in the northeast, / one should satisfy Īśa with clarified butter and unbroken grains; then Parjanya situated in one square,

40.s:
utpalādibhirjayantañca dvipadasthaṃ patākayā /
mahendrañcaikakoṣṭhasthaṃ sarvaraktaiḥ pade raviṃ //
40.d:
उत्पलादिभिर्जयन्तञ्च द्विपदस्थं पताकया /
महेन्द्रञ्चैककोष्ठस्थं सर्वरक्तैः पदे रविं //
40.m: with blue lotuses and the like; and Jayanta, occupying two squares, with a banner; / and Mahendra, situated in one square; [and] Ravi in a square with all red [offerings];

40.s:
vitānenārdhapadagaṃ satyaṃ pade bhṛśaṃ ghṛtaiḥ /
vyoma śākunamāṃsena(2) koṇārdhapadasaṃsthitaṃ //
40.d:
वितानेनार्धपदगं सत्यं पदे भृशं घृतैः /
व्योम शाकुनमांसेन(2) कोणार्धपदसंस्थितं //
40.m: Satya, occupying half a square, with a canopy; Bhṛśa in a square with clarified butter; / Vyoma, situated in half a corner-square, with bird meat;

40.s:
srucā cārdhapade vahniṃ pūṣāṇaṃ lājayaikataḥ /
svarṇena vitathaṃ dviṣṭhaṃ mathanena gṛhākṣataṃ //
40.d:
स्रुचा चार्धपदे वह्निं पूषाणं लाजयैकतः /
स्वर्णेन वितथं द्विष्ठं मथनेन गृहाक्षतं //
40.m: and Vahni in half a square with a ladle; Pūṣan in one square with parched grain; / Vitatha, occupying two squares, with gold; Gṛhākṣata with churned curd;

40.s:
māṃsaudanena dharmeśamekaikasmin sthitaṃ dvayaṃ /
gandharvaṃ dvipadaṃ gandhair bhṛśaṃ śākunajihvayā //
40.d:
मांसौदनेन धर्मेशमेकैकस्मिन् स्थितं द्वयं /
गन्धर्वं द्विपदं गन्धैर् भृशं शाकुनजिह्वया //
40.m: Dharmeśa with boiled rice and meat, two situated in each single [square]; / Gandharva, occupying two squares, with perfumes; Bhṛśa with a bird's tongue;

40.s:
ekasthamūrdhvasaṃsthañca mṛgaṃ nīlapaṭais tathā /
pitṝn kṛśarayārdhasthaṃ dantakāṣṭhaiḥ padasthitaṃ //
:n
1 nṛhasta iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vyoma śākulamāṃseneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 116
40.d:
एकस्थमूर्ध्वसंस्थञ्च मृगं नीलपटैस् तथा /
पितॄन् कृशरयार्धस्थं दन्तकाष्ठैः पदस्थितं //
:न्
1 नृहस्त इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 व्योम शाकुलमांसेनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 116
40.m:
and Mṛga, situated in one square and occupying the upper position, with blue cloths; / the Pitṛs, situated in half a square, with kṛśara; [Dauvārika,] situated in a square, with tooth-sticks;
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "nṛhastaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.]
[Footnote 2: "vyoma śākulamāṃsena" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.]

40.s:
dauvārikaṃ dvisaṃsthañca sugrīvaṃ yāvakena tu /
puṣpadantaṃ kuśastambaiḥ padmair varuṇamekataḥ //
40.d:
दौवारिकं द्विसंस्थञ्च सुग्रीवं यावकेन तु /
पुष्पदन्तं कुशस्तम्बैः पद्मैर् वरुणमेकतः //
40.m: Dauvārika, occupying two squares; and Sugrīva with barley-mash; / Puṣpadanta with bunches of kuśa grass; Varuṇa in one [square] with lotuses;

40.s:
asuraṃ surayā dviṣṭhaṃ pade śeṣaṃ ghṛtāmbhasā /
yavaiḥ pāpaṃ padārdhasthaṃ rogamardhe ca maṇḍakaiḥ //
40.d:
असुरं सुरया द्विष्ठं पदे शेषं घृताम्भसा /
यवैः पापं पदार्धस्थं रोगमर्धे च मण्डकैः //
40.m: Asura, occupying two squares, with liquor; Śeṣa in a square with water and clarified butter; / Pāpa, occupying half a square, with barley; and Roga in half a square with flat cakes;

40.s:
nāgapuṣpaiḥ pade nāgaṃ mukhyaṃ bhakṣyair dvisaṃsthitaṃ /
mudgaudanena bhallāṭaṃ pade somaṃ pade tathā //
40.d:
नागपुष्पैः पदे नागं मुख्यं भक्ष्यैर् द्विसंस्थितं /
मुद्गौदनेन भल्लाटं पदे सोमं पदे तथा //
40.m: Nāga in a square with nāgapuṣpa flowers; Mukhya, occupying two squares, with edibles; / Bhallāṭa with boiled mung-bean and rice; likewise Soma in a square,

40.s:
madhunā pāyasenātha śālūkena ṛṣiṃ dvaye /
pade ditiṃ lopikābhirardhe ditimathāparaṃ //
40.d:
मधुना पायसेनाथ शालूकेन ऋषिं द्वये /
पदे दितिं लोपिकाभिरर्धे दितिमथापरं //
40.m: with honey and milk-porridge, and the Ṛṣi in two squares with lotus root; / Diti in a square with sweet cakes; then another Diti in half a square,

40.s:
pūrikābhistataścāpamīśādhaḥ payasā pade /
tatodhaścāpavatsantu dadhnā caikapade sthitaṃ //
40.d:
पूरिकाभिस्ततश्चापमीशाधः पयसा पदे /
ततोधश्चापवत्सन्तु दध्ना चैकपदे स्थितं //
40.m: with deep-fried cakes; and then Āpa below Īśa, in a square with milk; / then Āpavatsa below that, situated in one square, with curd;

40.s:
laḍḍukaiś ca marīcintu pūrvakoṣṭhacatuṣṭaye(1) /
savitre raktapuṣpāṇi brahmādhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake //
40.d:
लड्डुकैश् च मरीचिन्तु पूर्वकोष्ठचतुष्टये(1) /
सवित्रे रक्तपुष्पाणि ब्रह्माधःकोणकोष्ठके //
40.m: and Marīci in the four eastern squares with sweetmeats; / red flowers to Savitṛ in the corner square below Brahmā;

40.s:
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyāt sāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ /
vivaste 'ruṇaṃ dadyāccandanañcaturaṅghriṣu //
40.d:
तदधःकोष्ठके दद्यात् सावित्र्यै च कुशोदकं /
विवस्ते ऽरुणं दद्याच्चन्दनञ्चतुरङ्घ्रिषु //
40.m: in the square below that, one should give kuśa-water to Sāvitrī; / in the four squares one should give red sandalwood to Vivasvat;

40.s:
rakṣodhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhe tu indrāyānnaṃ niśānvitaṃ /
indrajayāya tasyādho ghṛtānnaṃ koṇakoṣṭhake //
40.d:
रक्षोधःकोणकोष्ठे तु इन्द्रायान्नं निशान्वितं /
इन्द्रजयाय तस्याधो घृतान्नं कोणकोष्ठके //
40.m: in the corner square below the Southwest, cooked rice mixed with turmeric to Indra; / in the corner square below that, cooked rice with clarified butter to Indrajaya;

40.s:
catuṣpadeṣu dātavyamindrāya guḍapāyasaṃ /
vāyvadhaḥkoṇadeśe tu rudrāya pakvamāṃsakaṃ //
40.d:
चतुष्पदेषु दातव्यमिन्द्राय गुडपायसं /
वाय्वधःकोणदेशे तु रुद्राय पक्वमांसकं //
40.m: milk-porridge with jaggery should be given to Indra in four squares; / and cooked meat to Rudra in the corner region below the Northwest;

40.s:
tadadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhe tu yakṣāyārdraṃ phalantathā /
mahīdharāya māṃsānnaṃ māghañca caturaṅghriṣu //
40.d:
तदधःकोणकोष्ठे तु यक्षायार्द्रं फलन्तथा /
महीधराय मांसान्नं माघञ्च चतुरङ्घ्रिषु //
40.m: in the corner square below that, fresh fruit to the Yakṣa; / cooked rice with meat, and Māgha in the four squares, to Mahīdhara;

40.s:
madhye catuṣpade sthāpyā brahmaṇe tilataṇḍulāḥ /
carakīṃ māṣasarpibhyāṃ skandaṃ kṛśarayāsṛjā //
40.d:
मध्ये चतुष्पदे स्थाप्या ब्रह्मणे तिलतण्डुलाः /
चरकीं माषसर्पिभ्यां स्कन्दं कृशरयासृजा //
40.m: in the four squares in the center, sesame seeds and rice grains should be deposited for Brahmā; / Carakī with black gram and clarified butter; Skanda with kṛśara and blood;

40.s:
raktapadmair vidārīñca kandarpañca palodanaiḥ /
pūtanāṃ palapittābhyāṃ māṃsāsṛgbhyāñca jambhakaṃ //
:n
1 madhyacatuṣṭaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 117
40.d:
रक्तपद्मैर् विदारीञ्च कन्दर्पञ्च पलोदनैः /
पूतनां पलपित्ताभ्यां मांसासृग्भ्याञ्च जम्भकं //
:न्
1 मध्यचतुष्टये इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 117

40.s:
pittāsṛgasthibhiḥ pāpāṃ pilipiñjaṃ(1) srajāsṛjā /
īśādyān raktamāṃsena abhāvādakṣatair yajet //
40.d:
पित्तासृगस्थिभिः पापां पिलिपिञ्जं(1) स्रजासृजा /
ईशाद्यान् रक्तमांसेन अभावादक्षतैर् यजेत् //
40.m: Pāpā with bile, blood, and bones; Pilipiñja with a garland and blood; / one should worship Īśa and the rest with blood and meat, or with unbroken grains in the absence [thereof].

40.s:
rakṣomātṛgaṇebhyaś ca piśācādibhya eva ca /
pitṛbhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyo balīn dadyāt prakāmataḥ //
40.d:
रक्षोमातृगणेभ्यश् च पिशाचादिभ्य एव च /
पितृभ्यः क्षेत्रपालेभ्यो बलीन् दद्यात् प्रकामतः //
40.m: And to the hosts of rākṣasas and mātṛs, and to the piśācas and others, / to the pitṛs, and to the guardians of the field (kṣetrapālas), one should lavishly give bali offerings.

40.s:
āhutvaitānasantarpya prāsādādīnna kārayet /
brahamasthāne hariṃ lakṣmīṃ gaṇaṃ paścāt samarcayet //
40.d:
आहुत्वैतानसन्तर्प्य प्रासादादीन्न कारयेत् /
ब्रहमस्थाने हरिं लक्ष्मीं गणं पश्चात् समर्चयेत् //
40.m: Without offering to these and propitiating them, one should not construct a temple or other buildings. / Afterwards, one should worship Hari, Lakṣmī, and the Gaṇa in the Brahmā-position.

40.s:
mahīśvaraṃ vāstumayaṃ(2) vardhanyā sahitaṃ ghaṭaṃ /
brahmāṇaṃ madhyataḥ kumbhe brahmādīṃś ca digīśvarān //
40.d:
महीश्वरं वास्तुमयं(2) वर्धन्या सहितं घटं /
ब्रह्माणं मध्यतः कुम्भे ब्रह्मादींश् च दिगीश्वरान् //
40.m: One should worship the lord of the earth who embodies the site, along with the water jar and the pitcher; / [and worship] Brahmā in the middle of the pitcher, and Brahmā and the others, the regents of the directions.

40.s:
dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ paścāt svasti vācya praṇamya ca /
pragṛhya karkarīṃ samyak maṇḍalantu pradakṣiṇaṃ //
40.d:
दद्यात् पूर्णाहुतिं पश्चात् स्वस्ति वाच्य प्रणम्य च /
प्रगृह्य कर्करीं सम्यक् मण्डलन्तु प्रदक्षिणं //
40.m: Afterwards, one should offer the final oblation, have benedictions pronounced, bow down, / properly take up the spouted pitcher, and make a clockwise circumambulation of the maṇḍala.

40.s:
sūtramārdeṇa he brahmaṃstoyadhārāñca bhrāmayet /
pūrvavattena mārgeṇa sapta vījāni vāpayet //
40.d:
सूत्रमार्देण हे ब्रह्मंस्तोयधाराञ्च भ्रामयेत् /
पूर्ववत्तेन मार्गेण सप्त वीजानि वापयेत् //
40.m: Following the line of the measuring cord, O Brahmin, one should pour a continuous stream of water. / Following that same path as before, one should sow seven kinds of seeds.

40.s:
prārambhaṃ tena mārgeṇa tasya khātasya kārayet /
tato gartaṃ khanenmadhye hastamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ //
40.d:
प्रारम्भं तेन मार्गेण तस्य खातस्य कारयेत् /
ततो गर्तं खनेन्मध्ये हस्तमात्रं प्रमाणतः //
40.m: Following that path, one should initiate the excavation. / Then one should dig a pit in the middle measuring precisely one cubit,

40.s:
caturaṅgulakaṃ cādhaścopalipyārcayettataḥ /
dhyātvā caturbhujaṃ viṣṇumarghyaṃ dadyāttu kumbhataḥ //
40.d:
चतुरङ्गुलकं चाधश्चोपलिप्यार्चयेत्ततः /
ध्यात्वा चतुर्भुजं विष्णुमर्घ्यं दद्यात्तु कुम्भतः //
40.m: and smeared four finger-breadths below. Then one should worship, / meditate on four-armed Viṣṇu, and offer the water offering from the pitcher.

40.s:
karkaryā pūrayet śvabhraṃ śuklapuṣpāṇi ca nyaset /
dakṣiṇāvartakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bījair mṛddbhiś ca pūrayet //
40.d:
कर्कर्या पूरयेत् श्वभ्रं शुक्लपुष्पाणि च न्यसेत् /
दक्षिणावर्तकं श्रेष्ठं बीजैर् मृद्द्भिश् च पूरयेत् //
40.m: With the spouted pitcher one should fill the pit and deposit white flowers. / One should fill that auspicious dextrorotatory [pit] with seeds and earth.

40.s:
arghyādānaṃ viniṣpādya govastrādīndadedgurau /
kālajñāya sthapataye vaiṣṇavādibhya arcayet //
40.d:
अर्घ्यादानं विनिष्पाद्य गोवस्त्रादीन्ददेद्गुरौ /
कालज्ञाय स्थपतये वैष्णवादिभ्य अर्चयेत् //
40.m: Having completed the water offering, one should give cows, clothing, and other gifts to the guru. / One should honor the astrologer, the architect, and the Vaiṣṇavas.

40.s:
tatastu khānayedyatnajjalāntaṃ yāvadeva tu /
puruṣādhaḥsthitaṃ śalyaṃ(3) na gṛhe doṣadaṃ bhavet //
:n
1 pilipicchamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 mahīdharaṃ vāstumayamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ śalyamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 118
40.d:
ततस्तु खानयेद्यत्नज्जलान्तं यावदेव तु /
पुरुषाधःस्थितं शल्यं(3) न गृहे दोषदं भवेत् //
:न्
1 पिलिपिच्छमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 महीधरं वास्तुमयमिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पुरुषाधिष्ठितं शल्यमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 118
40.m:
Then one should have the excavation made with effort down to the water level. / An extraneous object situated below a man's height does not cause harm to a house.
:n
1 'pilipiccham' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 'mahīdharaṃ vāstumayam' is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
3 'puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ śalyam' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / :p 118

40.s:
asthiśalye vidyate vai bhittirvai gṛhiṇo 'sukhaṃ /
yannāmaśabdaṃ śṛṇuyāttatra śalyaṃ tadudbhavaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye arghyadānakathanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śilāvinyāsavidhānaṃ
40.d:
अस्थिशल्ये विद्यते वै भित्तिर्वै गृहिणो ऽसुखं /
यन्नामशब्दं शृणुयात्तत्र शल्यं तदुद्भवं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अर्घ्यदानकथनं नाम चत्वारिंशो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
शिलाविन्यासविधानं
40.m:
If a bone fragment is present, there will indeed be misery for the householder. / Whatever name or sound one hears, an extraneous object originating from that will be there.
Thus ends the fortieth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Offering of Arghya', in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now begins the forty-first chapter.
The Procedure for the Laying of the Foundation Stone

41.s:
bhagavānuvāca
pādapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣāmi śilāvinyāsalakṣaṇaṃ /
agrato maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ kuṇḍalānāntu catuṣṭayaṃ //
41.d:
भगवानुवाच
पादप्रतिष्ठां वक्षामि शिलाविन्यासलक्षणं /
अग्रतो मण्डपः कार्यः कुण्डलानान्तु चतुष्टयं //
41.m: The Holy One said: / I shall explain the consecration of the base, the characteristics of the laying of the foundation stone. / A pavilion is to be built in front, along with four fire-pits.

41.s:
kumbhanyāseṣṭakānyāso dvārastambhocchrayaṃ śubhaṃ /
pādonaṃ pūrayet khātaṃ tatra vāstuṃ yajet same //
41.d:
कुम्भन्यासेष्टकान्यासो द्वारस्तम्भोच्छ्रयं शुभं /
पादोनं पूरयेत् खातं तत्र वास्तुं यजेत् समे //
41.m: The deposition of pitchers, the deposition of bricks, and the raising of doorposts are auspicious. / One should fill three quarters of the excavation, and there worship the site architecture on level ground.

41.s:
iṣṭakāś ca supakvāḥ syurdvādaśāṅgulasammitāḥ /
savistāratribhāgena vaipulyena(1) samanvitāḥ //
41.d:
इष्टकाश् च सुपक्वाः स्युर्द्वादशाङ्गुलसम्मिताः /
सविस्तारत्रिभागेन वैपुल्येन(1) समन्विताः //
41.m: The bricks should be well baked, measuring twelve finger-breadths, / and endowed with a width that is one third of their length.

41.s:
karapramāṇā śreṣṭhā syācchilāpyatha śilāmaye(2) /
nava kumbhāṃstāmramayān sthāpayediṣṭakāghaṭān //
41.d:
करप्रमाणा श्रेष्ठा स्याच्छिलाप्यथ शिलामये(2) /
नव कुम्भांस्ताम्रमयान् स्थापयेदिष्टकाघटान् //
41.m: A stone measuring one cubit is best; or, in a stone temple, / one should set down nine copper pitchers as brick-pitchers,

41.s:
adbhiḥ pañcakaṣāyeṇa sarvauṣadhijalena ca /
gandhatoyena ca tathā kumbhaistoyasupūritaiḥ //
41.d:
अद्भिः पञ्चकषायेण सर्वौषधिजलेन च /
गन्धतोयेन च तथा कुम्भैस्तोयसुपूरितैः //
41.m: with waters of the five astringents, with water of all medicinal herbs, / with perfumed water, and with pitchers completely filled with water,

41.s:
hiraṇyavrīhisaṃyuktair gandhacandanacarcitaiḥ /
āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śanno devīti cāpyatha //
41.d:
हिरण्यव्रीहिसंयुक्तैर् गन्धचन्दनचर्चितैः /
आपो हि ष्ठेति तिसृभिः शन्नो देवीति चाप्यथ //
41.m: endowed with gold and unhusked rice, anointed with perfume and sandalwood paste; / with the three verses 'āpo hi ṣṭhā', and also 'śan no devī',

41.s:
tarat samandīriti ca(3) pāvamānībhireva ca /
uduttamaṃ varuṇamiti kathānaś ca tathaiva ca //
:n
1 suvistāraṃ vibhāgena naipuṇyaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śilā syānna śilāmaye iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 bhavatatsamandīritīti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 119
41.d:
तरत् समन्दीरिति च(3) पावमानीभिरेव च /
उदुत्तमं वरुणमिति कथानश् च तथैव च //
:न्
1 सुविस्तारं विभागेन नैपुण्यनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शिला स्यान्न शिलामये इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 भवतत्समन्दीरितीति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 119
41.m:
and 'tarat sa mandī', and with the Pāvamānī verses, / 'ud uttamam varuṇam', and likewise 'ka thā naḥ',
:n
1 'suvistāraṃ vibhāgena naipuṇyena' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2 'śilā syān na śilāmaye' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3 'bhavatatsamandīriti' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa. / :p 119

41.s:
varuṇasyeti mantreṇa haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityapi /
śrīsūktena tathā śilāḥ saṃsthāpya saṃghaṭāḥ(1) //
41.d:
वरुणस्येति मन्त्रेण हंसः शुचिषदित्यपि /
श्रीसूक्तेन तथा शिलाः संस्थाप्य संघटाः(1) //
41.m: with the mantra of Varuṇa, also 'haṃsaḥ śuciṣat', / and with the Śrīsūkta; having thus established the stones along with the pitchers,

41.s:
śayyāyāṃ maṇḍape prācyāṃ maṇḍale harimarcayet /
juhuyājjanayitvāgniṃ samidho dvādaśīstataḥ //
41.d:
शय्यायां मण्डपे प्राच्यां मण्डले हरिमर्चयेत् /
जुहुयाज्जनयित्वाग्निं समिधो द्वादशीस्ततः //
41.m: one should worship Hari upon a bed in a maṇḍala in the eastern part of the pavilion. / Having generated the fire, one should then offer twelve kindling sticks.

41.s:
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu praṇavenaiva kārayet /
aṣṭāhutīs tathāṣṭāntair ājyaṃ(2) vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt //
41.d:
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु प्रणवेनैव कारयेत् /
अष्टाहुतीस् तथाष्टान्तैर् आज्यं(2) व्याहृतिभिः क्रमात् //
41.m: One should perform the two continuous ghee offerings and the two portions of ghee with the Praṇava alone. / Then [offer] eight oblations of ghee sequentially with the eight terminal [mantras] along with the Vyāhṛtis,

41.s:
lokeśānāmagnaye vai somāyāvagraheṣu ca(3) /
puruṣottamāyeti ca vyāhṛtīrjuhuyāttataḥ //
41.d:
लोकेशानामग्नये वै सोमायावग्रहेषु च(3) /
पुरुषोत्तमायेति च व्याहृतीर्जुहुयात्ततः //
41.m: to the lords of the worlds, to Agni, to Soma, and to the planets; / and saying 'To Puruṣottama', one should then offer the Vyāhṛtis.

41.s:
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ pūrṇāṃ mūrtimāṃsaghṛtāṃstilān /
vedādyair dvādaśāntena(4) kumbheṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak //
41.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं ततः पूर्णां मूर्तिमांसघृतांस्तिलान् /
वेदाद्यैर् द्वादशान्तेन(4) कुम्भेषु च पृथक् पृथक् //
41.m: Then [one should offer] the expiation, the final oblation, flesh offerings to the deities, ghee, and sesamum seeds / with the initial Vedic mantras ending with the twelve-syllabled mantra, severally in the pitchers.

41.s:
prāṅmukhastu guruḥ kuryādaṣṭadikṣu vilipya ca /
madhye caikāṃ śilāṃ kumbhaṃ nyasedetān surān kramāt //
41.d:
प्राङ्मुखस्तु गुरुः कुर्यादष्टदिक्षु विलिप्य च /
मध्ये चैकां शिलां कुम्भं न्यसेदेतान् सुरान् क्रमात् //
41.m: Facing east, the guru should anoint them in the eight directions, / and in the middle deposit one stone and a pitcher, and these deities in sequence:

41.s:
padmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathā /
kumudañca tathā nandaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhañca padminīṃ //
41.d:
पद्मं चैव महापद्मं मकरं कच्छपं तथा /
कुमुदञ्च तथा नन्दं पद्मं शङ्खञ्च पद्मिनीं //
41.m: Padma, Mahāpadma, Makara, Kacchapa, / Kumuda, Nanda, Padma, Śaṅkha, and Padminī.

41.s:
kumbhānna cālayetteṣu iṣṭakānāntu devatāḥ /
īśānāntāś ca pūrvādāviṣṭakāṃ prathamaṃ nyaset //
41.d:
कुम्भान्न चालयेत्तेषु इष्टकानान्तु देवताः /
ईशानान्ताश् च पूर्वादाविष्टकां प्रथमं न्यसेत् //
41.m: One must not move the pitchers; among them are the deities of the bricks. / One should deposit the first brick in the east and end in the northeast.

41.s:
śaktayo vimalādyāstu iṣṭakānāntu devatāḥ /
nyasanīyā yathā yogaṃ madhye nyasyā tvanugrahā //
41.d:
शक्तयो विमलाद्यास्तु इष्टकानान्तु देवताः /
न्यसनीया यथा योगं मध्ये न्यस्या त्वनुग्रहा //
41.m: The powers beginning with Vimalā are the deities of the bricks; / they should be deposited appropriately, and Anugrahā should be deposited in the middle.

41.s:
avyaṅge cākṣata pūrṇaṃ muneraṅgirasaḥ sute /
iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmyahaṃ //
41.d:
अव्यङ्गे चाक्षत पूर्णं मुनेरङ्गिरसः सुते /
इष्टके त्वं प्रयच्छेष्टं प्रतिष्ठां कारयाम्यहं //
41.m: 'O unbroken, unblemished, full one, daughter of sage Aṅgiras! / O brick, grant what is desired; I am performing the consecration.'

41.s:
mantreṇānena vinyasya iṣṭakā deśakramottamaḥ /
:n
1 samyutā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ .|
2 aṣṭāhutīplathā pūrṇair ājyamiti ga, gha, ṅa, iti
pustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 somāya ca grahāya ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 dvādaśārṇena iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 120
garbhādhānaṃ tataḥ kuryānmadhyasthāne samāhitaḥ //
41.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन विन्यस्य इष्टका देशक्रमोत्तमः /
:न्
1 सम्युता इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः .|
2 अष्टाहुतीप्लथा पूर्णैर् आज्यमिति ग, घ, ङ, इति
पुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 सोमाय च ग्रहाय चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 द्वादशार्णेन इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 120
गर्भाधानं ततः कुर्यान्मध्यस्थाने समाहितः //
41.m:
Having deposited the bricks with this mantra, the excellent master of the ritual
:n
1 'saṃyutāḥ' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 'aṣṭāhutīḥ tathā pūrṇair ājyam' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa.
3 'somāya ca grahāya ca' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4 'dvādaśārṇena' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / :p 120
should then, composed in mind, deposit the foundation deposit in the central position.

41.s:
kumbhopariṣṭhādeveśaṃ padminīṃ nyasya devatāṃ /
mṛttikāś caiva puṣpāṇi dhātavo ratnameva ca(1) //
41.d:
कुम्भोपरिष्ठादेवेशं पद्मिनीं न्यस्य देवतां /
मृत्तिकाश् चैव पुष्पाणि धातवो रत्नमेव च(1) //
41.m: Above the pitcher, having placed the deity Padminī, the lord of gods, / as well as earths, flowers, minerals, gems,

41.s:
lauhāni dikpaterastraṃ yajedvai garbhabhājane /
dvādaśāṅgulavistāre caturaṅgulakocchraye //
41.d:
लौहानि दिक्पतेरस्त्रं यजेद्वै गर्भभाजने /
द्वादशाङ्गुलविस्तारे चतुरङ्गुलकोच्छ्रये //
41.m: metals, and the weapon of the guardian of the direction, one should worship in the vessel of the foundation deposit. / In a copper vessel shaped like a lotus, twelve finger-breadths wide

41.s:
padmākāre tāmramaye bhājane pṛthivīṃ yajet /
ekānte sarvabhūteśe parvatāsanamaṇḍite //
41.d:
पद्माकारे ताम्रमये भाजने पृथिवीं यजेत् /
एकान्ते सर्वभूतेशे पर्वतासनमण्डिते //
41.m: and four finger-breadths high, one should worship the Earth: / 'O solitary ruler of all beings, adorned with the mountains as your seat,

41.s:
samudraparivāre tvaṃ devi garbhaṃ samāśraya /
nande nandaya vāsiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā(2) saha //
41.d:
समुद्रपरिवारे त्वं देवि गर्भं समाश्रय /
नन्दे नन्दय वासिष्ठे वसुभिः प्रजया(2) सह //
41.m: surrounded by the oceans, O Goddess, enter into this foundation deposit! / O Nanda, daughter of Vasiṣṭha, bring joy along with the Vasus and offspring!

41.s:
jaye bhārgavadāyāde prajānāṃ vijayāvahe /
pūrṇeṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kuruṣva māṃ //
41.d:
जये भार्गवदायादे प्रजानां विजयावहे /
पूर्णेङ्गिरसदायादे पूर्णकामं कुरुष्व मां //
41.m: O Jayā, heiress of Bhṛgu, bringer of victory to the people! / O Pūrṇā, heiress of Aṅgiras, fulfill my desire!

41.s:
bhadre kāśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama /
sarvavījasamāyukte sarvaratnauṣadhīvṛte //
41.d:
भद्रे काश्यपदायादे कुरु भद्रां मतिं मम /
सर्ववीजसमायुक्ते सर्वरत्नौषधीवृते //
41.m: O Bhadrā, heiress of Kaśyapa, make my mind auspicious! / O you who are endowed with all seeds, surrounded by all jewels and medicinal herbs!

41.s:
jaye surucire nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha /
prajāpatisute devi caturasre mahīyasi //
41.d:
जये सुरुचिरे नन्दे वासिष्ठे रम्यतामिह /
प्रजापतिसुते देवि चतुरस्रे महीयसि //
41.m: O victorious, lovely Nandā, daughter of Vasiṣṭha, take delight here! / O Goddess, daughter of Prajāpati, four-cornered, most exalted!

41.s:
subhage suprabhe bhadre gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatāṃ /
pūjite paramāś carye gandhamālyair alaṅkṛte //
41.d:
सुभगे सुप्रभे भद्रे गृहे काश्यपि रम्यतां /
पूजिते परमाश् चर्ये गन्धमाल्यैर् अलङ्कृते //
41.m: O fortunate, radiant, auspicious daughter of Kaśyapa, take delight in this house! / O worshiped, wondrous one, adorned with perfumes and garlands,

41.s:
bhavabhūtikarī devi gṛhe bhārgavi ramyatāṃ /
deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmiparigrahe //
41.d:
भवभूतिकरी देवि गृहे भार्गवि रम्यतां /
देशस्वामिपुरस्वामिगृहस्वामिपरिग्रहे //
41.m: O Goddess, granter of prosperity, daughter of Bhṛgu, take delight in this house! / In the possession of the lord of the country, the lord of the town, and the master of the house,

41.s:
manuṣyādikatuṣṭyarthaṃ paśuvṛddhikarī bhava /
evamuktvā tataḥ khātaṃ gomūtreṇa tu secayet //
41.d:
मनुष्यादिकतुष्ट्यर्थं पशुवृद्धिकरी भव /
एवमुक्त्वा ततः खातं गोमूत्रेण तु सेचयेत् //
41.m: bring about the increase of cattle for the satisfaction of humans and others!' / Having spoken thus, one should then sprinkle the excavation with cow urine.

41.s:
kṛtvā nidhāpayedgarbhaṃ garbhādhānaṃ bhavenniśi /
govastrādi pradadyācca guravenyeṣu bhojanaṃ //
:n
1 rasameva ceti ga. gha. ṅa. cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 priyayeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 121
41.d:
कृत्वा निधापयेद्गर्भं गर्भाधानं भवेन्निशि /
गोवस्त्रादि प्रदद्याच्च गुरवेन्येषु भोजनं //
:न्
1 रसमेव चेति ग. घ. ङ. चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 प्रिययेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 121
41.m:
Having performed [these rites], one should lay the foundation deposit; the laying of the foundation deposit should take place at night. / One should give cows, clothing, and other gifts to the guru, and food to the others.
:n
1 'rasam eva ca' is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa.
2 "priyayā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
[p. 121]

41.s:
garbhaṃ nyasyeṣṭakā nyasya tato garbhaṃ prapūrayet /
pīṭhabandhamataḥ kuryānmitaprāsādamānataḥ(1) //
41.d:
गर्भं न्यस्येष्टका न्यस्य ततो गर्भं प्रपूरयेत् /
पीठबन्धमतः कुर्यान्मितप्रासादमानतः(1) //
41.m: Having placed the foundation receptacle and laid the bricks, he should then fill the foundation pit. / Thereafter, he should construct the plinth according to the measured dimensions of the temple.

41.s:
pīṭhottamañcocchrayeṇa prāsādasyārdhavistarāt /
padahīnaṃ madhyamaṃ syāt kaniṣṭhaṃ cottamārdhataḥ //
41.d:
पीठोत्तमञ्चोच्छ्रयेण प्रासादस्यार्धविस्तरात् /
पदहीनं मध्यमं स्यात् कनिष्ठं चोत्तमार्धतः //
41.m: The best plinth has a height of half the width of the temple; / the intermediate is less by one quarter, and the lowest is half of the highest.

41.s:
pīṭhabandhopariṣṭhāttu vāstuyāgaṃ punaryajet /
pādapratiṣṭhākārī tu niṣpāpo divi modate //
41.d:
पीठबन्धोपरिष्ठात्तु वास्तुयागं पुनर्यजेत् /
पादप्रतिष्ठाकारी तु निष्पापो दिवि मोदते //
41.m: Above the plinth, however, he should again perform the site architecture sacrifice. / One who accomplishes the consecration of the base rejoices sinless in heaven.

41.s:
devāgāraṃ karomīti manasā yastu cintayet /
tasya kāyagataṃ pāpaṃ tadahnā hi praṇaśyati //
41.d:
देवागारं करोमीति मनसा यस्तु चिन्तयेत् /
तस्य कायगतं पापं तदह्ना हि प्रणश्यति //
41.m: Whoever merely reflects in mind, "I shall build a temple for the deity"— / whatever sin resides in his body is destroyed on that very day.

41.s:
kṛte tu kiṃ punastasya prāsāde vidhinaiva tu /
aṣṭeṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ yaḥ kuryāddevatālayaṃ //
41.d:
कृते तु किं पुनस्तस्य प्रासादे विधिनैव तु /
अष्टेष्टकसमायुक्तं यः कुर्याद्देवतालयं //
41.m: What more need be said when a temple has indeed been built by him in accordance with rule? / He who makes an abode for a deity endowed with eight bricks—

41.s:
na tasya phalasampattirvaktuṃ śakyeta kenacit /
anenaivānumeyaṃ hi phalaṃ prāsādavistarāt //
41.d:
न तस्य फलसम्पत्तिर्वक्तुं शक्येत केनचित् /
अनेनैवानुमेयं हि फलं प्रासादविस्तरात् //
41.m: no one could express the abundant fruit he gains. / From the extent of the temple itself, indeed, such fruit is to be inferred.

41.s:
grāmamadhye ca pūrve ca pratyagdvāraṃ prakalpayet /
vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu grāme pratyaṅmukho bhavet /
dakṣiṇe cottare caiva paścime prāṅmukho bhavet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pātālayogakathanaṃ nāma
ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvācatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāsādalakṣaṇakathanaṃ
41.d:
ग्राममध्ये च पूर्वे च प्रत्यग्द्वारं प्रकल्पयेत् /
विदिशासु च सर्वासु ग्रामे प्रत्यङ्मुखो भवेत् /
दक्षिणे चोत्तरे चैव पश्चिमे प्राङ्मुखो भवेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पातालयोगकथनं नाम
एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्वाचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
प्रासादलक्षणकथनं
41.m:
In the middle of the village and in the east, one should provide a west-facing doorway; / and in all the intermediate directions in the village, it should face west; / in the south, north, and west, it should face east.
Thus in the primary Great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, the forty-first chapter, entitled "The Account of the Conjunction with the Netherdworld."
Now the forty-second chapter.
Description of the Characteristics of a Temple

42.s:
hayagrīva uvāca
prāsādaṃ sampravakṣyāmi sarvasādhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu /
caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhajet ṣoḍaśadhā budhaḥ //
42.d:
हयग्रीव उवाच
प्रासादं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वसाधारणं शृणु /
चतुरस्रीकृतं क्षेत्रं भजेत् षोडशधा बुधः //
42.m: Hayagrīva said: / I shall explain the temple common to all; listen: / A wise man should divide a squared ground into sixteen parts.

42.s:
madhye tasya caturbhistu kuryādāyasamanvitaṃ /
:n
1 samaprāsādamānata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 122
dvadaśaiva tu bhāgāni bhittyarthaṃ parikalpayet //
42.d:
मध्ये तस्य चतुर्भिस्तु कुर्यादायसमन्वितं /
:न्
1 समप्रासादमानत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 122
द्वदशैव तु भागानि भित्त्यर्थं परिकल्पयेत् //
42.m:
In the middle of it, with four [parts], he should make [the sanctum] endowed with breadth.
[Footnote]
1 "samaprāsādamānataḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[p. 122]
He should assign twelve parts for the wall.

42.s:
jaṅghocchrāyantu kartavyaṃ caturbhāgeṇa cāyataṃ(1) /
jaṅghāyāṃ dviguṇocchrāyaṃ mañjaryāḥ kalpayed budhaḥ //
42.d:
जङ्घोच्छ्रायन्तु कर्तव्यं चतुर्भागेण चायतं(1) /
जङ्घायां द्विगुणोच्छ्रायं मञ्जर्याः कल्पयेद् बुधः //
42.m: The height of the wall-shaft is to be made equal in length to four parts; / a wise man should design the height of the spire to be twice that of the wall-shaft.

42.s:
turyabhāgena mañjaryāḥ kāryaḥ samyak pradakṣiṇaḥ(2) /
tanmānanirgamaṃ kāryamubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ samaṃ //
42.d:
तुर्यभागेन मञ्जर्याः कार्यः सम्यक् प्रदक्षिणः(2) /
तन्माननिर्गमं कार्यमुभयोः पार्श्वयोः समं //
42.m: A circumambulatory passage is to be made properly with a fourth part of the spire; / an projection of that measure is to be made equal on both sides.

42.s:
śikhareṇa samaṃ kāryamagre jagati vistaraṃ /
dviguṇenāpi kartavyaṃ yathāśobhānurūpataḥ //
42.d:
शिखरेण समं कार्यमग्रे जगति विस्तरं /
द्विगुणेनापि कर्तव्यं यथाशोभानुरूपतः //
42.m: The breadth of the basal platform in front is to be made equal to the spire, / or it may also be made twice [that], in accordance with beauty.

42.s:
vistārānmaṇḍapasyāgre garbhasūtradvayena tu /
dairghyātpādādhikaṃ kuryānmadhyastambhair vibhūṣitaṃ //
42.d:
विस्तारान्मण्डपस्याग्रे गर्भसूत्रद्वयेन तु /
दैर्घ्यात्पादाधिकं कुर्यान्मध्यस्तम्भैर् विभूषितं //
42.m: In front of the pavilion, by two measuring lines of the sanctum beyond its width, / he should make [it] longer by one fourth of its length, adorned with central pillars.

42.s:
prāsādagarbhamānaṃ vā kurvīta mukhamaṇḍapaṃ /
ekāśītipadair vyāstuṃ paścāt maṇḍapamārabhet //
42.d:
प्रासादगर्भमानं वा कुर्वीत मुखमण्डपं /
एकाशीतिपदैर् व्यास्तुं पश्चात् मण्डपमारभेत् //
42.m: Or he should make the front pavilion the measure of the temple's sanctum. / Having measured out the site with eighty-one squares, he should subsequently begin the pavilion.

42.s:
śukān prāgdvāravinyāse pādāntaḥsthān yajet surān /
tathā prākāravinyāse yajed dvātriṃśadantagān(3) //
42.d:
शुकान् प्राग्द्वारविन्यासे पादान्तःस्थान् यजेत् सुरान् /
तथा प्राकारविन्यासे यजेद् द्वात्रिंशदन्तगान्(3) //
42.m: In the placement of the east door, he should worship the deities situated within the parts, as well as the parrots; / likewise, in laying out the surrounding wall, he should worship those situated at the thirty-two limits.

42.s:
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ caitat prāsādasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ /
mānena pratimāyā vā prāsādamaparaṃ śṛṇu //
42.d:
सर्वसाधारणं चैतत् प्रासादस्य च लक्षणं /
मानेन प्रतिमाया वा प्रासादमपरं शृणु //
42.m: This is the characteristic of a temple common to all. / Or listen to another [type of] temple [proportioned] by the measurement of the image.

42.s:
pratimāyāḥ pramāṇana kartavyā piṇḍikā śubhā /
garbhastu piṇḍikārdhena garbhamānāstu bhittayaḥ //
42.d:
प्रतिमायाः प्रमाणन कर्तव्या पिण्डिका शुभा /
गर्भस्तु पिण्डिकार्धेन गर्भमानास्तु भित्तयः //
42.m: An auspicious pedestal is to be made by the measure of the image. / The sanctum is [measured by] half the pedestal, and the walls are the measure of the sanctum.

42.s:
bhitterāyāmamānena utsedhantu prakalpayet /
bhittyucchrāyāttu dviguṇaṃ śikharaṃ kalpayed budhaḥ //
42.d:
भित्तेरायाममानेन उत्सेधन्तु प्रकल्पयेत् /
भित्त्युच्छ्रायात्तु द्विगुणं शिखरं कल्पयेद् बुधः //
42.m: He should design the height by the measure of the length of the wall; / and from the height of the wall, a wise man should design the spire to be twice [as high].

42.s:
śikharasya tu turyeṇa bhramaṇaṃ parikalpayet /
śikharasya caturthena vyagrato mukhamaṇḍapaṃ //
:n
1 catyurbhāgeṇa vā yutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / caturbhāgeṇa
saṃyutamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 samyak kuryāt pradakṣiṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dvātriṃśadantare iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 123
42.d:
शिखरस्य तु तुर्येण भ्रमणं परिकल्पयेत् /
शिखरस्य चतुर्थेन व्यग्रतो मुखमण्डपं //
:न्
1 चत्युर्भागेण वा युतमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / चतुर्भागेण
संयुतमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सम्यक् कुर्यात् प्रदक्षिणमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 द्वात्रिंशदन्तरे इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 123
42.m:
He should design the circumambulatory passage with a fourth of the spire, / and the front pavilion facing forward with a fourth of the spire.
[Footnote]
1 "caturbhāgeṇa vā yutam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "caturbhāgeṇa saṃyutam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2 "samyak kuryāt pradakṣiṇam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3 "dvātriṃśadantare" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[p. 123]

42.s:
aṣṭamāṃsena garbhasya rathakānāntu nirgamaḥ /
paridherguṇabhāgena rathakāṃstatra kalpayet //
42.d:
अष्टमांसेन गर्भस्य रथकानान्तु निर्गमः /
परिधेर्गुणभागेन रथकांस्तत्र कल्पयेत् //
42.m: The projection of the buttresses is by an eighth part of the sanctum; / he should design the buttresses there by a third part of the perimeter.

42.s:
tattṛtīyeṇa(4) vā kuryādrathakānāntu nirgamaṃ /
vāmatrayaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ rathakatritaye sadā //
42.d:
तत्तृतीयेण(4) वा कुर्याद्रथकानान्तु निर्गमं /
वामत्रयं स्थापनीयं रथकत्रितये सदा //
42.m: Or he should make the projection of the buttresses by one third of that; / three recessed angles must always be placed on the three buttresses.

42.s:
śikharārthaṃ hi sūtrāṇi catvāri vinipātayet /
śukanāśordhvataḥ sūtraṃ tiryagbhūtaṃ nipātayet //
42.d:
शिखरार्थं हि सूत्राणि चत्वारि विनिपातयेत् /
शुकनाशोर्ध्वतः सूत्रं तिर्यग्भूतं निपातयेत् //
42.m: Indeed, for the sake of the spire, he should drop four plumb-lines; / above the antefix, he should drop a cord positioned obliquely.

42.s:
śikharasyārdhabhāgasthaṃ siṃhaṃ tatra tu kārayet /
śukanāsāṃ sthirīkṛtya madhyasandhau nidhāpayet //
42.d:
शिखरस्यार्धभागस्थं सिंहं तत्र तु कारयेत् /
शुकनासां स्थिरीकृत्य मध्यसन्धौ निधापयेत् //
42.m: He should then place a lion standing in the middle part of the spire; / having made the antefix firm, he should set it at the central joint.

42.s:
apare ca tathā pārśvaṃ tadvat sūtraṃ nidhāpayet /
tadūrdhvantu bhavedvedī sakaṇṭā manasārakaṃ //
42.d:
अपरे च तथा पार्श्वं तद्वत् सूत्रं निधापयेत् /
तदूर्ध्वन्तु भवेद्वेदी सकण्टा मनसारकं //
42.m: And on the other side likewise, he should drop the cord in the same way. / Above that there should be an altar platform with a neck and a crowning capstone.

42.s:
skandhabhagnaṃ na kartavyaṃ vikarālaṃ tathaiva ca /
ūrdhvaṃ ca vedikāmānāt kalaśaṃ parikalpayet //
42.d:
स्कन्धभग्नं न कर्तव्यं विकरालं तथैव च /
ऊर्ध्वं च वेदिकामानात् कलशं परिकल्पयेत् //
42.m: It must not be made with a broken shoulder, nor terrifyingly distorted; / and above the measure of the altar platform, he should design the pot-finial.

42.s:
vistārāddviguṇaṃ dvāraṃ kartavyaṃ tu suśobhanaṃ /
udumbarau tadūrdhvañca nyasecchākhāṃ sumaṅgalaiḥ //
42.d:
विस्ताराद्द्विगुणं द्वारं कर्तव्यं तु सुशोभनं /
उदुम्बरौ तदूर्ध्वञ्च न्यसेच्छाखां सुमङ्गलैः //
42.m: The doorway is to be made twice [the measure of] the breadth, very beautiful; / above the two threshold posts, he should place the doorframe with very auspicious [motifs].

42.s:
dvārasya tu caturthāṃśe kāryau caṇḍapracaṇdakau /
viśvaksenavatsadaṇḍau śikhordhvoḍumbare śriyaṃ //
42.d:
द्वारस्य तु चतुर्थांशे कार्यौ चण्डप्रचण्दकौ /
विश्वक्सेनवत्सदण्डौ शिखोर्ध्वोडुम्बरे श्रियं //
42.m: Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa are to be made on the fourth part of the doorway, / holding staffs like Viṣvaksena; and above the lintel, [he should place] Śrī,

42.s:
diggajaiḥ snāpyamānāntāṃ ghaṭeḥ sābjāṃ surūpikāṃ /
prāsādasya caturthāṃśaiḥ prākārasyocchrayo bhavet //
42.d:
दिग्गजैः स्नाप्यमानान्तां घटेः साब्जां सुरूपिकां /
प्रासादस्य चतुर्थांशैः प्राकारस्योच्छ्रयो भवेत् //
42.m: being bathed by the elephants of the quarters with pitchers, holding a lotus, of beautiful form. / The height of the surrounding wall should be one fourth of [the height of] the temple.

42.s:
prāsādāt pādahīnastu gopurasyocchrayo bhavet /
pañcahastasya devasya ekahastā tu pīṭhikā //
42.d:
प्रासादात् पादहीनस्तु गोपुरस्योच्छ्रयो भवेत् /
पञ्चहस्तस्य देवस्य एकहस्ता तु पीठिका //
42.m: The height of the gateway-tower should be one quarter less than that of the temple. / For a deity of five cubits, the pedestal is one cubit.

42.s:
gāruḍaṃ maṇḍapañcāgre ekaṃ bhaumādidhāma ca /
kuryāddhi pratimāyāntu dikṣu cāṣṭamāsu copari //
42.d:
गारुडं मण्डपञ्चाग्रे एकं भौमादिधाम च /
कुर्याद्धि प्रतिमायान्तु दिक्षु चाष्टमासु चोपरि //
42.m: In front, there should be a Garuḍa pavilion and a single multi-storeyed abode, / and on the image, he should place [deities] in the eight directions and above:

42.s:
pūrve varāhaṃ dakṣe ca nṛsiṃhaṃ śrīdharaṃ jale /
uttare tu hayagrīvanāgneyyāṃ jāmadagnyakaṃ //
:n
1 tatturīyeṇeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 124
42.d:
पूर्वे वराहं दक्षे च नृसिंहं श्रीधरं जले /
उत्तरे तु हयग्रीवनाग्नेय्यां जामदग्न्यकं //
:न्
1 तत्तुरीयेणेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 124
42.m:
Varāha in the east, Nṛsiṃha in the south, Śrīdhara in the [direction of] water, / Hayagrīva in the north, and Paraśurāma in the south-east,
[Footnote]
1 "tatturīyeṇa" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[p. 124]

42.s:
nairṛtyāṃ rāmakaṃ vāyau vāmanaṃ vāsudevakaṃ /
īśe prāsādaracanā deyā vasvarkakādibhiḥ /
dvārasya cāṣṭamādyaṃśaṃ tyatkā bedho na doṣabhāk //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma
dvācattvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāsādadevatāsthāpanaṃ
42.d:
नैरृत्यां रामकं वायौ वामनं वासुदेवकं /
ईशे प्रासादरचना देया वस्वर्ककादिभिः /
द्वारस्य चाष्टमाद्यंशं त्यत्का बेधो न दोषभाक् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रासादलक्षणं नाम
द्वाचत्त्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
प्रासाददेवतास्थापनं
42.m:
Rāma in the south-west, Vāmana in the north-west, and Vāsudeva / in the north-east: the layout of the temple should be given by groups of eight, twelve, and so on; / discarding the eighth and first part of the doorway, an obstruction incurs no fault.
Thus in the primary Great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, the forty-second chapter, entitled "Description of the Characteristics of a Temple."
Now the forty-third chapter.
Installation of Deities in a Temple

43.s:
bhagavānuvāca
prāsāde devatāḥ sthāpyā vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me /
pañcāyatamadhye tu vāsudevaṃ niveśayet //
43.d:
भगवानुवाच
प्रासादे देवताः स्थाप्या वक्ष्ये ब्रह्मन् शृणुष्व मे /
पञ्चायतमध्ये तु वासुदेवं निवेशयेत् //
43.m: The Blessed One said: / I shall state the deities to be installed in a temple; listen to me, O Brahmā: / In the middle of a five-shrine complex, one should install Vāsudeva,

43.s:
vāmanaṃ nṛhariñcāśvaśīrṣaṃ tadvañca śūkaraṃ /
āgneye nairṛte caiva vāyavye ceśagocare //
43.d:
वामनं नृहरिञ्चाश्वशीर्षं तद्वञ्च शूकरं /
आग्नेये नैरृते चैव वायव्ये चेशगोचरे //
43.m: and Vāmana, Nṛhari, the Horse-Headed One, and likewise the Boar / in the south-east, south-west, north-west, and north-east quarters.

43.s:
atha nārāyaṇaṃ madhye āgneyyāmambikāṃ nyaset /
nairṛtyāṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyau brahmāṇaṃ liṅgamīśake //
43.d:
अथ नारायणं मध्ये आग्नेय्यामम्बिकां न्यसेत् /
नैरृत्यां भास्करं वायौ ब्रह्माणं लिङ्गमीशके //
43.m: Or else one should place Nārāyaṇa in the center, Ambikā in the south-east, / the Sun in the south-west, Brahmā in the north-west, and a liṅga in the north-east;

43.s:
athavā rudrarūpantu athavā navadhāmasu /
vāsudevaṃ nyasenmadhye pūrvādau vāmavāmakān //
43.d:
अथवा रुद्ररूपन्तु अथवा नवधामसु /
वासुदेवं न्यसेन्मध्ये पूर्वादौ वामवामकान् //
43.m: or in the form of Rudra; or in nine shrines / one should place Vāsudeva in the center, and on the left of each, beginning with the east,

43.s:
indrādīn lokapālāṃś ca athavā navadhāmasu /
pañcāyatanakaṃ kuryāt madhye tu puruṣottamaṃ //
43.d:
इन्द्रादीन् लोकपालांश् च अथवा नवधामसु /
पञ्चायतनकं कुर्यात् मध्ये तु पुरुषोत्तमं //
43.m: Indra and the other world-protectors. Or in nine abodes / he should make a five-shrine complex with Puruṣottama in the center.

43.s:
lakṣmīvaiśravaṇau pūrvaṃ dakṣe mātṛgaṇaṃ nyaset /
skandaṃ gaṇeśamīśānaṃ sūryādīn paścime grahān //
43.d:
लक्ष्मीवैश्रवणौ पूर्वं दक्षे मातृगणं न्यसेत् /
स्कन्दं गणेशमीशानं सूर्यादीन् पश्चिमे ग्रहान् //
43.m: He should place Lakṣmī and Kubera in the east, the troop of Mothers in the south, / Skanda, Gaṇeśa, and Īśāna [along with] the Sun and other planets in the west,

43.s:
uttare daśa matsyādīnāgneyyāṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā /
nairṛtyāmambikāṃ sthāpya vāyavye tu sarasvatīṃ //
43.d:
उत्तरे दश मत्स्यादीनाग्नेय्यां चण्डिकां तथा /
नैरृत्यामम्बिकां स्थाप्य वायव्ये तु सरस्वतीं //
43.m: the ten [incarnations] beginning with the Fish in the north; likewise Caṇḍikā in the south-east; / having placed Ambikā in the south-west, and Sarasvatī in the north-west,

43.s:
padmāmaiśe vāsudevaṃ madhye nārāyaṇañca vā /
trayodaśālaye madhye viśvarūpaṃ nyaseddhariṃ //
:p 125
43.d:
पद्मामैशे वासुदेवं मध्ये नारायणञ्च वा /
त्रयोदशालये मध्ये विश्वरूपं न्यसेद्धरिं //
:प् 125
43.m:
[One should deposit] Padmā in the northeast, or Vāsudeva or Nārāyaṇa in the centre; / in a shrine of thirteen [deities] one should deposit Hari in his cosmic form (Viśvarūpa) in the centre.
[Page 125]

43.s:
pūrvādau keśavādīn vā anyadhāmasvayaṃ hariṃ(1) /
mṛṇmayī dārughaṭitā lohajā ratnajā tathā //
43.d:
पूर्वादौ केशवादीन् वा अन्यधामस्वयं हरिं(1) /
मृण्मयी दारुघटिता लोहजा रत्नजा तथा //
43.m: Or [one should deposit] Keśava and the others beginning in the east, or Hari himself in another abode. / An image is taught to be of seven kinds: made of clay, fashioned of wood, made of metal, made of jewels,

43.s:
śailajā gandhajā caiva kausumī(2) saptadhā smṛtā /
kausumī gandhajā caiva mṛṇmayī pratimā tathā //
43.d:
शैलजा गन्धजा चैव कौसुमी(2) सप्तधा स्मृता /
कौसुमी गन्धजा चैव मृण्मयी प्रतिमा तथा //
43.m: made of stone, made of fragrant paste, and made of flowers. / An image made of flowers, of fragrant paste, or of clay—

43.s:
tatkālapūjitāś caitāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ /
atha śailamayīṃ vakṣye śilā yatra ca gṛhyate //
43.d:
तत्कालपूजिताश् चैताः सर्वकामफलप्रदाः /
अथ शैलमयीं वक्ष्ये शिला यत्र च गृह्यते //
43.m: these, worshipped for that particular time, bestow the fruits of all desires. / Now I shall describe [the image] made of stone, and where the stone is to be taken.

43.s:
parvatānāmabhāve ca gṛhṇīyādbhūgatāṃ śilāṃ /
pāṇḍarā hy aruṇā pītā kṛṣṇā śastā tu vairṇināṃ //
43.d:
पर्वतानामभावे च गृह्णीयाद्भूगतां शिलां /
पाण्डरा ह्य् अरुणा पीता कृष्णा शस्ता तु वैर्णिनां //
43.m: In the absence of mountains, one may take a stone found in the earth. / White, red, yellow, and black stones are commended for the four social classes.

43.s:
na yadā labhyate samyag varṇināṃ varṇataḥ śilā /
varṇādyāpādānaṃ tatra juhyāt siṃhavidyayā //
43.d:
न यदा लभ्यते सम्यग् वर्णिनां वर्णतः शिला /
वर्णाद्यापादानं तत्र जुह्यात् सिंहविद्यया //
43.m: When a stone according to the colour of the social classes cannot properly be obtained, / one should perform fire oblation there using the Nṛsiṃha mantra to produce the [desired] colour and other [qualities].

43.s:
śilāyāṃ śuklarekhāgryā kṛṣṇāgryā siṃhahomataḥ /
kāṃsyaghaṇṭāninādā syāt puṃliṅgā visphuliṅgikā //
43.d:
शिलायां शुक्लरेखाग्र्या कृष्णाग्र्या सिंहहोमतः /
कांस्यघण्टानिनादा स्यात् पुंलिङ्गा विस्फुलिङ्गिका //
43.m: A stone with prominent white lines, or prominent black lines through fire oblation to Nṛsiṃha, / producing the sound of a bronze bell, sparking, is masculine.

43.s:
tanmandalakṣaṇā(3) strī syādrūpābhāvānnapuṃsakā /
dṛśyate maṇḍalaṃ yasyāṃ sagarbhāṃ tāṃ vivarjayet //
43.d:
तन्मन्दलक्षणा(3) स्त्री स्याद्रूपाभावान्नपुंसका /
दृश्यते मण्डलं यस्यां सगर्भां तां विवर्जयेत् //
43.m: One with milder characteristics is feminine; in the absence of [either set of] characteristics, it is neuter. / One in which a circular mark is seen should be avoided as pregnant.

43.s:
pratimārthaṃ vanaṃ gatvā vrajayāgaṃ samācaret /
tatra khātvopalipyātha maṇḍape tu hariṃ yajet //
43.d:
प्रतिमार्थं वनं गत्वा व्रजयागं समाचरेत् /
तत्र खात्वोपलिप्याथ मण्डपे तु हरिं यजेत् //
43.m: Having gone to the forest for the sake of the image, one should perform the sacrifice for departure. / There, having dug and smeared [the ground], one should worship Hari in a pavilion.

43.s:
baliṃ datvā karmaśastraṃ ṭaṅkādikamathārcayet /
hutvātha śālitoyena astreṇa prokṣayecchilāṃ //
43.d:
बलिं दत्वा कर्मशस्त्रं टङ्कादिकमथार्चयेत् /
हुत्वाथ शालितोयेन अस्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेच्छिलां //
43.m: Having offered an oblation, one should then worship the working tools, such as the chisel. / Having made fire oblation, one should sprinkle the stone with rice water using the weapon-mantra.

43.s:
rakṣāṃ kṛtvā nṛsiṃhena mūlamantreṇa pūjayet(4) /
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāttato bhūtabaliṃ guruḥ //
:n
1 anyadhāmasu yajñaviditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
yugmadhāmasvayaṃ harimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kaumudī iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 unmattalakṣaṇā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 mantrayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 126
43.d:
रक्षां कृत्वा नृसिंहेन मूलमन्त्रेण पूजयेत्(4) /
हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं दद्यात्ततो भूतबलिं गुरुः //
:न्
1 अन्यधामसु यज्ञविदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
युग्मधामस्वयं हरिमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कौमुदी इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 उन्मत्तलक्षणा इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 मन्त्रयेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 126
43.m:
Having made protection with Nṛsiṃha, one should worship [it] with the root-mantra. / Having made fire oblation, the guru should offer the final oblation and then the oblation to the spirits.
[Footnotes]
1. "anyadhāmasu yajñavit" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
"yugmadhāmasvayaṃ harim" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2. "kaumudī" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
3. "unmattalakṣaṇā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "mantrayet" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 126]

43.s:
atra ye saṃsthitāḥ sattvā yātudhānāś ca guhyakāḥ /
siddhādayo vā ye cānye tān sampūjya kṣamāpayet //
43.d:
अत्र ये संस्थिताः सत्त्वा यातुधानाश् च गुह्यकाः /
सिद्धादयो वा ये चान्ये तान् सम्पूज्य क्षमापयेत् //
43.m: Whatever beings, Yātudhānas, Guhyakas, / Siddhas, or others dwell here, having worshipped them, one should ask their pardon:

43.s:
viṣṇubimbārthamasmākaṃ(1) yātraiṣā keśavājñayā /
viṣṇvarthaṃ yadbhavet kāryaṃ yuṣmākamapi tadbhavet //
43.d:
विष्णुबिम्बार्थमस्माकं(1) यात्रैषा केशवाज्ञया /
विष्ण्वर्थं यद्भवेत् कार्यं युष्माकमपि तद्भवेत् //
43.m: “This journey of ours is for the sake of an image of Viṣṇu, by the command of Keśava. / The work that is for the sake of Viṣṇu shall also be yours.

43.s: anena balidānena prītā bhavata sarvathā /
43.d: अनेन बलिदानेन प्रीता भवत सर्वथा /
43.m: May you be pleased in every way by this offering of oblation!

43.s: kṣameṇa gacchatānyatra muktvā sthānamidaṃ tvarāt //
43.d: क्षमेण गच्छतान्यत्र मुक्त्वा स्थानमिदं त्वरात् //
43.m: Pardon us and go elsewhere, leaving this place quickly.”

43.s:
evaṃ prabodhitāḥ sattvā yānti tṛptā yathāsukhaṃ /
śilpibhiś ca caruṃ prāśya svapnamantraṃ japenniśi //
43.d:
एवं प्रबोधिताः सत्त्वा यान्ति तृप्ता यथासुखं /
शिल्पिभिश् च चरुं प्राश्य स्वप्नमन्त्रं जपेन्निशि //
43.m: Thus addressed, the spirits depart, satisfied and at ease. / Having eaten the ritual porridge along with the artisans, one should recite the dream-mantra at night:

43.s:
oṃ namaḥ sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave /
viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye(2) namaḥ //
43.d:
ओं नमः सकललोकाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे /
विश्वाय विश्वरूपाय स्वप्नाधिपतये(2) नमः //
43.m: “Oṃ, obeisance to Viṣṇu, the Lord of all the worlds, / to the All, the Cosmic Form, the Lord of dreams, obeisance!

43.s:
ācakṣva devadeveśa prasuptosmi(3) tavāntikaṃ /
svapne sarvāṇi kāryāṇi hṛdisthāni tu yāni me //
oṃ oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ viṣṇave svāhā(4)
43.d:
आचक्ष्व देवदेवेश प्रसुप्तोस्मि(3) तवान्तिकं /
स्वप्ने सर्वाणि कार्याणि हृदिस्थानि तु यानि मे //
ओं ओं ह्रूं फट् विष्णवे स्वाहा(4)
43.m:
Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, as I sleep near you, / in a dream, all the tasks that dwell within my heart!”
“Oṃ oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ to Viṣṇu, svāhā!”

43.s:
śubhe svapne śubhaṃ sarvaṃ hy aśubhe siṃhahomataḥ /
prātararghyaṃ śilāyāṃ tu datvāstreṇāstrakaṃ yajet //
43.d:
शुभे स्वप्ने शुभं सर्वं ह्य् अशुभे सिंहहोमतः /
प्रातरर्घ्यं शिलायां तु दत्वास्त्रेणास्त्रकं यजेत् //
43.m: If the dream is auspicious, everything is auspicious; but if inauspicious, [one cures it] by fire oblation to Nṛsiṃha. / In the morning, having offered water offering to the stone, one should worship the weapon with the weapon-mantra.

43.s:
kuddālaṭaṅkaśastrādyaṃ madhvānyāktamukhañcaret /
ātmānaṃ cintayedviṣṇuṃ śilpinaṃ viśvakarmakaṃ(5) //
43.d:
कुद्दालटङ्कशस्त्राद्यं मध्वान्याक्तमुखञ्चरेत् /
आत्मानं चिन्तयेद्विष्णुं शिल्पिनं विश्वकर्मकं(5) //
43.m: One should smear the edges of the hoe, chisel, and other tools with honey and ghee. / One should contemplate oneself as Viṣṇu, and the artisan as Viśvakarman.

43.s:
śastraṃ viṣṇvātmakaṃ(6) dadyāt mukhapṛṣṭhādi darśayet /
jitendriyaḥ ṭaṅkahastaḥ śilpī tu caturasrakāṃ //
:n
1 lokasiddhyarthamasmākamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 viśvādhipataye iti kha, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ
3 prapanno 'smi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ oṃ hrīṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 viśvakarmaṇimiti kha, ga, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ
6 viśvātmakamiti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 127
43.d:
शस्त्रं विष्ण्वात्मकं(6) दद्यात् मुखपृष्ठादि दर्शयेत् /
जितेन्द्रियः टङ्कहस्तः शिल्पी तु चतुरस्रकां //
:न्
1 लोकसिद्ध्यर्थमस्माकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विश्वाधिपतये इति ख, चिह्नितपुअतकपाठः
3 प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ओं ओं ह्रीं फडिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 विश्वकर्मणिमिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुअतकपाठः
6 विश्वात्मकमिति ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 127
43.m:
One should present the tool as being composed of Viṣṇu, and indicate the face, back, and other parts. / Restraining his senses, with chisel in hand, the artisan [should make it] four-sided.
[Footnotes]
1. "lokasiddhyarthamasmākam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "viśvādhipataye" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "prapanno 'smi" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "oṃ oṃ hrīṃ phaṭ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
5. "viśvakarmaṇim" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
6. "viśvātmakam" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa. / [Page 127]

43.s:
śilāṃ kṛtvā piṇḍikārthaṃ kiñcinnyūnāntu kalpayet /
rathe sthāpya samānīya savastrāṃ kāruveśmani /
pūjayitvātha ghaṭayet pratimāṃ sa tu karmakṛt //
:e ity ādi mahāpurāṇe āgneye śāntyādivarṇanaṃ nāma
tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
