The Kinnaras hold vīṇās; the Vidyādharas in the sky hold garlands. / Piśācas are weak-limbed; Vetālas have deformed faces; / Kṣetrapālas carry spears; and Pretas have large bellies and emaciated bodies.
Thus ends the fifty-first chapter, named "Iconographic Characteristics of Images," in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the fifty-second chapter:
Iconographic Characteristics of Goddesses.

52.s:
bhagavānuvāca
yoginyaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ vakṣye aindrādīśāntataḥ kramāt /
:n
1 śikhinīsūtravān śaniriti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 khaḍgo iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 maṇividyādharāś ca khe iti kha, cihitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 vistṛtānanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 śūlayutā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 147
akṣobhyā rūkṣakarṇo ca rākṣasī kṛpaṇākṣayā(1) //
52.d:
भगवानुवाच
योगिन्यष्टाष्टकं वक्ष्ये ऐन्द्रादीशान्ततः क्रमात् /
:न्
1 शिखिनीसूत्रवान् शनिरिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 खड्गो इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 मणिविद्याधराश् च खे इति ख, चिहितपुस्तकपाठः
4 विस्तृतानना इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 शूलयुता इति ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 147
अक्षोभ्या रूक्षकर्णो च राक्षसी कृपणाक्षया(1) //
52.m:
The Lord said: / I shall describe the sixty-four Yoginīs in order from east to northeast:
[...]
1. The reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha is "śikhinīsūtravān śaniḥ".
2. The reading in the manuscript marked gha is "khaḍgo".
3. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is "maṇividyādharāś ca khe".
4. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is "vistṛtānanāḥ".
5. The reading in the manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa is "śūlayutāḥ".
Akṣobhyā, Rūkṣakarṇā, Rākṣasī, Kṛpaṇā, Kṣayā,

52.s:
piṅgākṣī ca kṣayā kṣemā ilā līlālayā tathā /
lolā laktā balākeśī(2) lālasā vimalā punaḥ(3) //
52.d:
पिङ्गाक्षी च क्षया क्षेमा इला लीलालया तथा /
लोला लक्ता बलाकेशी(2) लालसा विमला पुनः(3) //
52.m: Piṅgākṣī, Kṣayā, Kṣemā, Ilā, Līlālayā, / Lolā, Laktā, Balākeśī, Lālasā, and Vimalā;

52.s:
hutāśā ca viśālākṣī huṅkārā vaḍavāmukhī /
mahākrūrā krodhanā tu bhayaṅkarī mahānanā //
52.d:
हुताशा च विशालाक्षी हुङ्कारा वडवामुखी /
महाक्रूरा क्रोधना तु भयङ्करी महानना //
52.m: Hutāśā, Viśālākṣī, Huṅkārā, Vaḍavāmukhī, / Mahākrūrā, Krodhanā, Bhayaṅkarī, Mahānanā,

52.s:
sarvajñā taralā tārā ṛgvedā tu hayānanā /
sārākhyā rudraśaṅgrāhī(4) sambarā tālajaṅghikā //
52.d:
सर्वज्ञा तरला तारा ऋग्वेदा तु हयानना /
साराख्या रुद्रशङ्ग्राही(4) सम्बरा तालजङ्घिका //
52.m: Sarvajñā, Taralā, Tārā, Ṛgvedā, Hayānanā, / Sārākhyā, Rudrasaṅgrāhī, Śambarā, Tālajaṅghikā,

52.s:
raktākṣī suprasiddhā tu vidyujjihvā karaṅkiṇī /
meghanādā pracaṇḍogrā kālakarṇī(5) varapradā //
52.d:
रक्ताक्षी सुप्रसिद्धा तु विद्युज्जिह्वा करङ्किणी /
मेघनादा प्रचण्डोग्रा कालकर्णी(5) वरप्रदा //
52.m: Raktākṣī, Suprasiddhā, Vidyujjihvā, Karaṅkiṇī, / Meghanādā, Pracaṇḍogrā, Kālakarṇī, Varapradā,

52.s:
candrā candrāvalī(6) caiva prapañcā pralayāntikā /
śiśuvaktrā piśācī ca piśitāśā ca lolupā //
52.d:
चन्द्रा चन्द्रावली(6) चैव प्रपञ्चा प्रलयान्तिका /
शिशुवक्त्रा पिशाची च पिशिताशा च लोलुपा //
52.m: Candrā, Candrāvalī, Prapañcā, Pralayāntikā, / Śiśuvaktrā, Piśācī, Piśitāśā, Lolupā,

52.s:
dhamanī tāpanī caiva rāgiṇī(7) vikṛtānanā /
vāyuvegā vṛhatkukṣirvikṛtā viśvarūpikā //
52.d:
धमनी तापनी चैव रागिणी(7) विकृतानना /
वायुवेगा वृहत्कुक्षिर्विकृता विश्वरूपिका //
52.m: Dhamanī, Tāpanī, Rāgiṇī, Vikṛtānanā, / Vāyuvegā, Bṛhatkukṣi, Vikṛtā, Viśvarūpikā,

52.s:
yamajihvā jayantī ca durjayā ca jayāntikā /
viḍālī revatī caiva pūtanā vijayāntikā //
52.d:
यमजिह्वा जयन्ती च दुर्जया च जयान्तिका /
विडाली रेवती चैव पूतना विजयान्तिका //
52.m: Yamajihvā, Jayantī, Durjayā, Jayāntikā, / Biḍālī, Revatī, Pūtanā, and Vijayāntikā.

52.s:
aṣṭahastāś caturhastā icchāstrāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ /
:n
1 kṣapaṇā kṣamā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / kṣapaṇā
kṣapā iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayakapāṭhaḥ
2 lolā raktā ca lokeśo iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihniapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 vimalā tata iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 rasasaṅgrāhī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vasusaṅgrāhī iti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 kālavarṇī iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
6 caṇḍā caṇdavatīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 vāmanī iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 148
bhairavaścārkahastaḥ syāt kūrparāsyo(1) jaṭendubhṛt //
52.d:
अष्टहस्ताश् चतुर्हस्ता इच्छास्त्राः सर्वसिद्धिदाः /
:न्
1 क्षपणा क्षमा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / क्षपणा
क्षपा इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयकपाठः
2 लोला रक्ता च लोकेशो इति ग, घ, ङ, चिह्निअपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 विमला तत इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 रससङ्ग्राही इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / वसुसङ्ग्राही इति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 कालवर्णी इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
6 चण्डा चण्दवतीति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 वामनी इति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 148
भैरवश्चार्कहस्तः स्यात् कूर्परास्यो(1) जटेन्दुभृत् //
52.m:
They have eight arms or four arms, hold weapons according to desire, and grant all supernatural attainments.
[...]
1. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is "kṣapaṇā kṣamā"; the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha is "kṣapaṇā kṣapā".
2. The reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa is "lolā raktā ca lokeśī".
3. The reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha is "vimalā tataḥ".
4. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is "rasasaṅgrāhī"; the reading in the manuscript marked gha is "vasusaṅgrāhī".
5 "kālavarṇī" is the reading of the two manuscripts marked ga and gha.
6 "caṇḍā caṇḍavatī" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
7 "vāmanī" is the reading of the manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa.
Bhairava should have twelve hands, an elbow-like face, and bear matted locks and the moon.
Holding a sword, an elephant goad, an axe, an arrow, and dispelling universal fear on one side, / and raising a bow, a trident, a skull-topped staff, a noose, and a half-[gesture] granting boons;

52.s:
gajacarmadharo dvābhyāṃ kṛttivāsohibhūṣataḥ /
pretāśano mātṛmadhye pūjyaḥ pañcānanothavā //
52.d:
गजचर्मधरो द्वाभ्यां कृत्तिवासोहिभूषतः /
प्रेताशनो मातृमध्ये पूज्यः पञ्चाननोथवा //
52.m: Wearing an elephant hide with two [hands], clad in animal skins, adorned with serpents, / feeding on corpses, he is to be worshipped in the midst of the Mothers, or [depicted] five-faced.

52.s:
avilomāgniparyantaṃ dīrghāṣṭakaikabheditaṃ /
tatṣaḍaṅgāni jātyantair anvitaṃ ca kramād yajet //
52.d:
अविलोमाग्निपर्यन्तं दीर्घाष्टकैकभेदितं /
तत्षडङ्गानि जात्यन्तैर् अन्वितं च क्रमाद् यजेत् //
52.m: One should worship the [mantra] differentiated by the eight long vowels, ending with non-inverted fire, / and its six limbs endowed in sequence with those terminating in jāti-words.
Mounted on a leaf of the temple-fire, endowed with gold and mercury, / accompanied by the sound and crescent-bindu, illuminated by the limb of the Lord of the Mothers.

52.s:
vīrabhadro vṛṣārūḍho mātragre sa caturmukhaḥ /
gaurīṃ tu dvibhujā tryakṣā śūlinī darpaṇānvitā //
52.d:
वीरभद्रो वृषारूढो मात्रग्रे स चतुर्मुखः /
गौरीं तु द्विभुजा त्र्यक्षा शूलिनी दर्पणान्विता //
52.m: Vīrabhadra is mounted on a bull, in front of the Mothers, with four faces. / But Gaurī is two-armed, three-eyed, holding a trident, and accompanied by a mirror.

52.s:
śūlaṃ galantikā kuṇḍī(3) varadā ca caturbhujā /
abjasthā lalitā skandagaṇādarśaśalākayā(4) //
52.d:
शूलं गलन्तिका कुण्डी(3) वरदा च चतुर्भुजा /
अब्जस्था ललिता स्कन्दगणादर्शशलाकया(4) //
52.m: Four-armed, [she holds] a trident, a water-pot, an ascetic's vessel, and gives boons. / Seated on a lotus, Lalitā [is adorned] with a mirror-probe of the gaṇas of Skanda.

52.s:
caṇḍikā saśahastā syāt khaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛk /
dakṣe vāme nāgapāśaṃ carmāgkuśakuṭhārakaṃ /
dhanuḥ siṃhe ca mahiṣaḥ śūlena prahatogrataḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma
dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 danturāsya iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 maṇḍalāgnidalārūḍhamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śūlaṃ galantī kuṇḍī ceti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 skandagaṇā daśa vināyakā iti kha, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 atra caṇḍikādaśahasteṣu khaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛgiti yuktaḥ
pāṭhaḥ
asmallabdhapustakapañcakeṣu nāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ
:p 149
:ś atha tripañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ
liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ
52.d:
चण्डिका सशहस्ता स्यात् खड्गशूलारिशक्तिधृक् /
दक्षे वामे नागपाशं चर्माग्कुशकुठारकं /
धनुः सिंहे च महिषः शूलेन प्रहतोग्रतः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रतिमालक्षणं नाम
द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 दन्तुरास्य इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 मण्डलाग्निदलारूढमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शूलं गलन्ती कुण्डी चेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 स्कन्दगणा दश विनायका इति ख, चिहिनितपुस्तकपाठः
5 अत्र चण्डिकादशहस्तेषु खड्गशूलारिशक्तिधृगिति युक्तः
पाठः
अस्मल्लब्धपुस्तकपञ्चकेषु नायं पाठः
:प् 149
:श् अथ त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः
लिङ्गलक्षणं
52.m:
Caṇḍikā should have ten hands, bearing a sword, a trident, a discus, and a spear / in the right, and in the left a serpent-noose, a shield, a goad, an axe, / and a bow; and the buffalo [demon] is fiercely struck by the trident on the lion.
Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, titled "Characteristics of Images", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
1 "danturāsya" is the reading of the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
2 "maṇḍalāgnidalārūḍham" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3 "śūlaṃ galantī kuṇḍī ca" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
4 "skandagaṇā daśa vināyakāḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
5 Here, the reading "khaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛk" in the ten hands of Caṇḍikā is suitable.
This reading is not found in the five manuscripts obtained by us.
Now the fifty-third chapter.
Characteristics of the Liṅga

53.s:
bhagavānuvāca
liṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye kamalodbhava tacchṛṇu /
dairghyārdhaṃ vasubhirbhaktvā tyaktvā bhāgatrayaṃ tataḥ //
53.d:
भगवानुवाच
लिङ्गादिलक्षणं वक्ष्ये कमलोद्भव तच्छृणु /
दैर्घ्यार्धं वसुभिर्भक्त्वा त्यक्त्वा भागत्रयं ततः //
53.m: The Lord said: / I shall state the characteristics of the liṅga and other objects; hear that, O lotus-born [Brahmā]! / Having divided the length into eight and then discarded three parts,

53.s:
viṣkambhaṃ bhūtabhāgaistu caturasrantu kārayet /
āyāmaṃ mūrtibhirbhaktvā ekadvitrikramān nyaset //
53.d:
विष्कम्भं भूतभागैस्तु चतुरस्रन्तु कारयेत् /
आयामं मूर्तिभिर्भक्त्वा एकद्वित्रिक्रमान् न्यसेत् //
53.m: one should make the square diameter five parts. / Having divided the height into [nine] parts, one should assign [them] in the order of one, two, and three

53.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivāṃśeṣu vardhamānoyamucyate /
caturasresya varṇārdhaṃ guhyakoṇeṣu lāñchayet //
53.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवांशेषु वर्धमानोयमुच्यते /
चतुरस्रेस्य वर्णार्धं गुह्यकोणेषु लाञ्छयेत् //
53.m: to the portions of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; this is called the Vardhamāna [liṅga]. / On its square, one should mark half a syllable in the hidden corners.

53.s:
aṣṭāgraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgaṃ sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
ṣoḍaśāsraṃ tataḥ kuryāddvātriṃśāsraṃ tataḥ punaḥ //
53.d:
अष्टाग्रं वैष्णवं भागं सिध्यत्येव न संशयः /
षोडशास्रं ततः कुर्याद्द्वात्रिंशास्रं ततः पुनः //
53.m: The octagonal Vaiṣṇava portion is then successfully produced; there is no doubt. / Then one should make it sixteen-sided, and then thirty-two-sided;

53.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭyasrakaṃ kṛtvā vartulaṃ sādhayettataḥ /
kartayedatha liṅgasya śiro vai deśikottamaḥ //
53.d:
चतुःषष्ट्यस्रकं कृत्वा वर्तुलं साधयेत्ततः /
कर्तयेदथ लिङ्गस्य शिरो वै देशिकोत्तमः //
53.m: having made it sixty-four-sided, one should then make it circular. / The best of masters should then fashion the head of the liṅga.

53.s:
vistāramatha liṅgasya aṣṭadhā saṃvibhājayet /
bhāgārdhārdhantu santyajya cchatrākāraṃ śiro bhavet //
53.d:
विस्तारमथ लिङ्गस्य अष्टधा संविभाजयेत् /
भागार्धार्धन्तु सन्त्यज्य च्छत्राकारं शिरो भवेत् //
53.m: Then one should divide the width of the liṅga eightfold; / having discarded a quarter part, the head should take the shape of an umbrella.

53.s:
triṣu bhāgeṣu sadṛśamāyāmaṃ yasya cistaraḥ /
tadvibhāgasamaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ //
53.d:
त्रिषु भागेषु सदृशमायामं यस्य चिस्तरः /
तद्विभागसमं लिङ्गं सर्वकामफलप्रदं //
53.m: A liṅga whose height is equal in three parts and whose width / is equal to one of those divisions bestows the fruit of all desires.

53.s:
dairghyasya tu caturthena viṣkambhaṃ devapūjite /
sarveṣāmeva liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu sāmprataṃ //
53.d:
दैर्घ्यस्य तु चतुर्थेन विष्कम्भं देवपूजिते /
सर्वेषामेव लिङ्गानां लक्षणं शृणु साम्प्रतं //
53.m: Its diameter should be one-fourth of its length, O one worshipped by the gods! / Now hear the characteristics of all liṅgas.

53.s:
madhyasūtraṃ samāsādya brahmarudrāntikaṃ(1) budhaḥ /
ṣoḍaśāṅgulaliṅgasya ṣaḍbhāgair bhājito yathā //
53.d:
मध्यसूत्रं समासाद्य ब्रह्मरुद्रान्तिकं(1) बुधः /
षोडशाङ्गुललिङ्गस्य षड्भागैर् भाजितो यथा //
53.m: Fixing the central line up to [the sections of] Brahmā and Rudra, the wise [sculptor], / as for a liṅga of sixteen aṅgulas divided into six parts,

53.s:
tadvaiyamanasūtrābhyāṃ mānamantaramucyate /
yavāṣṭamuttare kāryaṃ śeṣāṇāṃ yavahānitaḥ //
53.d:
तद्वैयमनसूत्राभ्यां मानमन्तरमुच्यते /
यवाष्टमुत्तरे कार्यं शेषाणां यवहानितः //
53.m: by those two plumb lines the internal measurement is taught: / it is to be made eight barley-corns in the northern [direction], diminishing by a barley-corn for the remainder.

53.s:
adhobhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā tvardhamekaṃ parityajet /
:n
1 vrajedātyantikamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 150
aṣṭadhā taddvayaṃ kṛtvā ūrdhvabhāgatryaṃ tyajet //
53.d:
अधोभागं त्रिधा कृत्वा त्वर्धमेकं परित्यजेत् /
:न्
1 व्रजेदात्यन्तिकमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 150
अष्टधा तद्द्वयं कृत्वा ऊर्ध्वभागत्र्यं त्यजेत् //
53.m:
Having made the lower section threefold, one should abandon half of one [part].
[Notes]
1 "vrajed ātyantikam" is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
Having divided those two eightfold, one should discard three parts of the upper portion.

53.s:
ūrdhvañca pañcamādbhāgād bhrāmya rekhāṃ pralambayet /
bhāgamekaṃ parityajya saṅgaṃ kārayettayoḥ //
53.d:
ऊर्ध्वञ्च पञ्चमाद्भागाद् भ्राम्य रेखां प्रलम्बयेत् /
भागमेकं परित्यज्य सङ्गं कारयेत्तयोः //
53.m: And turning upward from the fifth part, one should let a line hang down; / having discarded one part, one should join the two together.

53.s:
etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mayā /
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye piṇḍikāntānnibodha me //
53.d:
एतत् साधारणं प्रोक्तं लिङ्गानां लक्षणं मया /
सर्वसाधारणं वक्ष्ये पिण्डिकान्तान्निबोध मे //
53.m: These general characteristics of liṅgas have been stated by me; / I shall state what is universal up to the pedestal; listen to me:

53.s:
brahmabhāgapraveśañca jñātvā liṅgasya cocchrayaṃ /
nyased brahmaśilāṃ vidvān samyakkarmaśilopari //
53.d:
ब्रह्मभागप्रवेशञ्च ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गस्य चोच्छ्रयं /
न्यसेद् ब्रह्मशिलां विद्वान् सम्यक्कर्मशिलोपरि //
53.m: Having understood the entrance of the Brahmā portion and the height of the liṅga, / the wise man should place the stone of Brahmā properly above the stone of ritual.

53.s:
tathā sumucchrayaṃ jñātvā piṇḍikāṃ pravibhājayet /
dvibhāgamucchritaṃ pīṭhaṃ vistāraṃ liṅgasammitam //
53.d:
तथा सुमुच्छ्रयं ज्ञात्वा पिण्डिकां प्रविभाजयेत् /
द्विभागमुच्छ्रितं पीठं विस्तारं लिङ्गसम्मितम् //
53.m: Likewise, having understood its full height, one should divide the pedestal; / the pedestal should be two parts in height and its width equal to the liṅga.

53.s:
tribhāgaṃ madhyataḥ khātaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ(1) vibhājayet /
svamānārdhatribhāgeṇa bāhulyaṃ parikalpayet //
53.d:
त्रिभागं मध्यतः खातं कृत्वा पीठं(1) विभाजयेत् /
स्वमानार्धत्रिभागेण बाहुल्यं परिकल्पयेत् //
53.m: Having made an excavation of three parts in the center, one should divide the pedestal; / one should design the thickness as three parts of half its own measurement.

53.s:
bāhulyasya tribhāgeṇa mekhalāmatha kalpayet /
khātaṃ syānmekhalātulyaṃ kramānnimnantu kārayet //
53.d:
बाहुल्यस्य त्रिभागेण मेखलामथ कल्पयेत् /
खातं स्यान्मेखलातुल्यं क्रमान्निम्नन्तु कारयेत् //
53.m: One should then fashion the molding with a third of the thickness; / the cavity should be equal to the molding, and one should make it gradually descending.

53.s:
mekhalāṣoḍaśāṃśena khātaṃ vā tatpramāṇajñaḥ /
ucchrāyaṃ tasya pīṭhasya vikārāṅgaṃ tu(2) kārayet //
53.d:
मेखलाषोडशांशेन खातं वा तत्प्रमाणज्ञः /
उच्छ्रायं तस्य पीठस्य विकाराङ्गं तु(2) कारयेत् //
53.m: Or the one knowing its proportions [makes] the cavity one-sixteenth of the molding; / one should make the height of that pedestal into transformed parts:

53.s:
bhūmau praviṣṭamekaṃ tu bhāgaikena(3) piṇḍikā /
kaṇṭhaṃ bhāgaistribhiḥ kāryaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikā //
53.d:
भूमौ प्रविष्टमेकं तु भागैकेन(3) पिण्डिका /
कण्ठं भागैस्त्रिभिः कार्यं भागेनैकेन पट्टिका //
53.m: one [part] entered into the earth, the pedestal [itself] by one part; / the neck is to be made with three parts, and the fillet with one part.

53.s:
dyaṃgena cordhvapaṭṭantu(4) ekāṃśāḥ śeṣapaṭṭikā /
bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ praviṣṭantu yāvat kaṇṭhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ //
53.d:
द्यंगेन चोर्ध्वपट्टन्तु(4) एकांशाः शेषपट्टिका /
भागं भागं प्रविष्टन्तु यावत् कण्ठं ततः पुनः //
53.m: The upper fillet with two parts, and the remaining fillets are of one part each; / each part entered as far as the neck, and then again

53.s:
nirgamaṃ bhāgamekaṃ tu yāvadvai śeṣapaṭṭikā /
praṇālasya tribhāgena nirgamastu tribhāgataḥ //
:n
1 madhyataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭhamiti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vikārāṃśāṃśceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 bhāgenaikeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 cārdhapaṭṭantu iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 151
53.d:
निर्गमं भागमेकं तु यावद्वै शेषपट्टिका /
प्रणालस्य त्रिभागेन निर्गमस्तु त्रिभागतः //
:न्
1 मध्यतः कृत्वा ततः पीठमिति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विकारांशांश्चेति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 भागेनैकेनेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 चार्धपट्टन्तु इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 151
53.m:
a projection of one part as far as the remaining fillet; / the drain's projection is by three parts from the three parts.
[Notes]
1 "madhyataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭham" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
2 "vikārāṃśāṃś ca" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
3 "bhāgenaikena" is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
4 "cārdhapaṭṭantu" is the reading of the manuscripts marked kha and ga.

53.s:
mūleṅgulyagravistāramagre tryaṃśena cārdhataḥ /
īṣannimnantu kurvīta khātaṃ taccottareṇa vai /
piṇḍikāsahitaṃ liṅgametat sādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma
tripañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catuḥpañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ
liṅgamānādikathanaṃ
53.d:
मूलेङ्गुल्यग्रविस्तारमग्रे त्र्यंशेन चार्धतः /
ईषन्निम्नन्तु कुर्वीत खातं तच्चोत्तरेण वै /
पिण्डिकासहितं लिङ्गमेतत् साधारणं स्मृतम् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये लिङ्गलक्षणं नाम
त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुःपञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः
लिङ्गमानादिकथनं
53.m:
The width at the base is an finger-tip, and at the top it is half of three parts; / one should make it slightly low, with that cavity indeed towards the north; / this is remembered as the universal [rule] for a liṅga endowed with a pedestal.
Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, titled "Characteristics of the Liṅga", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the fifty-fourth chapter.
Statement of the Measurements and Other Properties of the Liṅga

54.s:
bhagavānuvāca
vakṣyāmyanyaprakāreṇa(1) liṅgamānādikaṃ śṛṇu /
vakṣye lavaṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ ghṛtajaṃ buddhivardhanam //
54.d:
भगवानुवाच
वक्ष्याम्यन्यप्रकारेण(1) लिङ्गमानादिकं शृणु /
वक्ष्ये लवणजं लिङ्गं घृतजं बुद्धिवर्धनम् //
54.m: The Lord said: / I shall state the measurements and other properties of the liṅga in another manner; listen: / I shall speak of the liṅga made of salt, and that made of ghee which increases intellect;

54.s:
bhūtaye vastraliṅgantu liṅgantātkālikaṃ viduḥ /
pakvāpakvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ syādapakvāt pakvajaṃ varaṃ //
54.d:
भूतये वस्त्रलिङ्गन्तु लिङ्गन्तात्कालिकं विदुः /
पक्वापक्वं मृण्मयं स्यादपक्वात् पक्वजं वरं //
54.m: a cloth liṅga is for prosperity; they consider [these] liṅgas temporary. / An earthen one may be baked or unbaked; the baked one is better than the unbaked.

54.s:
tato dārumayaṃ puṇyaṃ dārujāt śailajaṃ varaṃ /
śailādvaraṃ tu muktājaṃ tato lauhaṃ suvarṇajaṃ //
54.d:
ततो दारुमयं पुण्यं दारुजात् शैलजं वरं /
शैलाद्वरं तु मुक्ताजं ततो लौहं सुवर्णजं //
54.m: Better than that is one made of wood, meritorious; better than one made of wood is one of stone; / better than stone is one made of pearl; then one made of iron, and one made of gold.

54.s:
rājataṃ kīrtitaṃ tāmraṃ paittalaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ /
raṅgajaṃ (2) rasaliṅgañca bhuktimuktipradaṃ varaṃ //
54.d:
राजतं कीर्तितं ताम्रं पैत्तलं भुक्तिमुक्तिदं /
रङ्गजं (2) रसलिङ्गञ्च भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं वरं //
54.m: One of silver is celebrated, [and] copper, [and] brass, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation; / a tin liṅga and a mercury liṅga are superior, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation.

54.s:
rasajaṃ rasalohādiratnagarbhantu vardhayet /
mānādi neṣṭaṃ siddhādi sthāpitetha svayambhuvi //
54.d:
रसजं रसलोहादिरत्नगर्भन्तु वर्धयेत् /
मानादि नेष्टं सिद्धादि स्थापितेथ स्वयम्भुवि //
54.m: One should augment the mercury-born [liṅga] containing mercury, iron and other metals, and gems; / measurement and other rules are not required for one established by perfected beings or one that is self-manifest.

54.s:
vāme ca svecchayā teṣāṃ pīṭhaprāsādakalpanā /
pūjayet sūryavimbasthaṃ darpaṇe prativimbitaṃ //
54.d:
वामे च स्वेच्छया तेषां पीठप्रासादकल्पना /
पूजयेत् सूर्यविम्बस्थं दर्पणे प्रतिविम्बितं //
54.m: And on their left, the arrangement of pedestal and temple is according to one's wish. / One should worship [the deity] situated in the disc of the sun, reflected in a mirror.

54.s:
pūjye harastu sarvatra liṅge pūrṇārcanaṃ bhavet /
hastottaravidhaṃ śailaṃ(3) dārujaṃ tadvadeva hi //
:n
1 pravakṣye 'haṃ prakāreṇeti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 ratnajamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 haste tu vividhaṃ śailamiti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 152
54.d:
पूज्ये हरस्तु सर्वत्र लिङ्गे पूर्णार्चनं भवेत् /
हस्तोत्तरविधं शैलं(3) दारुजं तद्वदेव हि //
:न्
1 प्रवक्ष्ये ऽहं प्रकारेणेति ग. चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 रत्नजमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 हस्ते तु विविधं शैलमिति ग. चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 152
54.m:
When Hara is worshipped, there is full worship in every liṅga. / Stone [liṅgas] are of the variety exceeding a cubit, and wooden ones are indeed just like that.
[...]
1 "I shall explain in due manner" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2 "Made of gems" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3 "In a cubit indeed there are diverse stones" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 152]

54.s:
calamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakaraiḥ sthitam(1) /
aṅgulād gṛhaliṅgaṃ syādyāvat pañcaśāṅgulaṃ //
54.d:
चलमङ्गुलमानेन द्वारगर्भकरैः स्थितम्(1) /
अङ्गुलाद् गृहलिङ्गं स्याद्यावत् पञ्चशाङ्गुलं //
54.m: A movable [liṅga] is measured by digits, while a stationary one is measured by cubits of the door and the sanctum. / A household liṅga should be from one digit up to fifteen digits.

54.s:
dvāramānāt trisaṅkhyākaṃ navadhā garbhamānataḥ /
navadhā garbhamānena liṅgandhāmni ca pūjayet //
54.d:
द्वारमानात् त्रिसङ्ख्याकं नवधा गर्भमानतः /
नवधा गर्भमानेन लिङ्गन्धाम्नि च पूजयेत् //
54.m: From the measure of the door, it is threefold; from the measure of the sanctum, it is ninefold. / One should worship the liṅga in the shrine according to the ninefold measure of the sanctum.

54.s:
evaṃ liṅgāni ṣaṭtriṃśat jñeyāni jyeṣṭhamānataḥ /
madhyamānena ṣaṭtriṃśat ṣaṭtriṃśadadhamena ca //
54.d:
एवं लिङ्गानि षट्त्रिंशत् ज्ञेयानि ज्येष्ठमानतः /
मध्यमानेन षट्त्रिंशत् षट्त्रिंशदधमेन च //
54.m: Thus thirty-six liṅgas are to be known by the superior measure, / thirty-six by the middling measure, and thirty-six by the inferior.

54.s:
itthamaikyena liṅgānāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet /
ekāṅgulādipañcāntaṃ kanyasañcalamucyate //
54.d:
इत्थमैक्येन लिङ्गानां शतमष्टोत्तरं भवेत् /
एकाङ्गुलादिपञ्चान्तं कन्यसञ्चलमुच्यते //
54.m: Thus by combination there are one hundred and eight liṅgas. / The smallest movable [liṅga] is said to range from one digit up to five.

54.s:
ṣadvādidaśaparyantañcalaṃ liṅgañca madhyamaṃ /
ekādaśāṅgulādi syāt jyeṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśāntakam //
54.d:
षद्वादिदशपर्यन्तञ्चलं लिङ्गञ्च मध्यमं /
एकादशाङ्गुलादि स्यात् ज्येष्ठं पञ्चदशान्तकम् //
54.m: The middling movable liṅga ranges from six digits up to ten; / the superior should range from eleven digits up to fifteen.

54.s:
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ mahāratnai ratnair anyair navāṅgulam /
ravibhirhemabhārotthaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaistripañcabhiḥ //
54.d:
षडङ्गुलं महारत्नै रत्नैर् अन्यैर् नवाङ्गुलम् /
रविभिर्हेमभारोत्थं लिङ्गं शेषैस्त्रिपञ्चभिः //
54.m: With great precious stones it is six digits; with other gems, nine digits; / made of a bhāra of gold, [it is measured] by twelve; with the remaining materials, by fifteen.

54.s:
ṣoḍaśāṃśe ca vedāṃśe yugaṃ luptvordhvadeśataḥ /
dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṃśāṃś ca(2) koṇayostu vilopayet //
54.d:
षोडशांशे च वेदांशे युगं लुप्त्वोर्ध्वदेशतः /
द्वात्रिंशत्षोडशांशांश् च(2) कोणयोस्तु विलोपयेत् //
54.m: Having removed four parts from the upper region in sixteenths and fourths, / one should pare away thirty-seconds and sixteenths at the corners.

54.s:
caturniveśanāt kaṇṭho viṃśatistriyugais tathā(3) /
pārśvābhyāṃ tu viluptābhyāṃ calaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaraṃ(4) //
54.d:
चतुर्निवेशनात् कण्ठो विंशतिस्त्रियुगैस् तथा(3) /
पार्श्वाभ्यां तु विलुप्ताभ्यां चललिङ्गं भवेद्वरं(4) //
54.m: From setting four parts, the neck is formed, and likewise twenty by six parts; / with both flanks pared away, an excellent movable liṅga is produced.

54.s:
dhāmno yugartunāgāṃśair dvāraṃ hīnāditaḥ kramāt /
liṅgadvārocchrayādarvāg bhavet pādonataḥ kramāt //
54.d:
धाम्नो युगर्तुनागांशैर् द्वारं हीनादितः क्रमात् /
लिङ्गद्वारोच्छ्रयादर्वाग् भवेत् पादोनतः क्रमात् //
54.m: The door is in parts of four, six, or eight of the shrine, successively from the inferior [to the superior]; / the liṅga should be less than the height of the door, successively reduced by one fourth.

54.s:
garbhārdhenādhamaṃ liṅgaṃ bhūtāṃśaiḥ syāt tribhirvaraṃ /
tayormadhye ca sūtrāṇi sapta sampātayet samaṃ //
:n
1 vanamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakare sthitamiti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśārdhañceti ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 viṃśatistriguṇaistatheti gha, cihnitapusutakapāṭhaḥ
4 vanaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaramiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / calaliṅgaṃ
bhaved dhruvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 153
54.d:
गर्भार्धेनाधमं लिङ्गं भूतांशैः स्यात् त्रिभिर्वरं /
तयोर्मध्ये च सूत्राणि सप्त सम्पातयेत् समं //
:न्
1 वनमङ्गुलमानेन द्वारगर्भकरे स्थितमिति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 द्वात्रिंशत्षोडशार्धञ्चेति ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 विंशतिस्त्रिगुणैस्तथेति घ, चिह्नितपुसुतकपाठः
4 वनलिङ्गं भवेद्वरमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / चललिङ्गं
भवेद् ध्रुवमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 153
54.m:
An inferior liṅga is half the sanctum; the best is three-fifths. / Between those two, one should drop seven equal cords.
[...]
1 "The forest [liṅga] is measured by digits, while it is situated in cubits of the door and sanctum" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2 "Thirty-two and a half sixteenths" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa.
3 "Twenty by three times the attributes" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
4 "An excellent forest liṅga is produced" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha. "A movable liṅga is certainly produced" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 153]

54.s:
evaṃ syurnava sūtrāṇi bhūtasūtraiś ca madhyamaṃ /
dvyantaro vāmavāmañca(1) liṅgānāṃ dīrghatā nava //
54.d:
एवं स्युर्नव सूत्राणि भूतसूत्रैश् च मध्यमं /
द्व्यन्तरो वामवामञ्च(1) लिङ्गानां दीर्घता नव //
54.m: Thus there should be nine cords, and the middling [measure] is with five cords; / with intervals of two, progressively to the left, the length of the liṅgas is ninefold.

54.s:
hastādvivardhate hasto yāvatsyur nava pāṇayaḥ /
hīnamadhyottamaṃ liṅgaṃ trividhaṃ trividhātmakam //
54.d:
हस्ताद्विवर्धते हस्तो यावत्स्युर् नव पाणयः /
हीनमध्योत्तमं लिङ्गं त्रिविधं त्रिविधात्मकम् //
54.m: It increases from a cubit by a cubit until there are nine cubits. / The liṅga is threefold—inferior, middling, and superior—each being threefold.

54.s:
ekaikaliṅgamadhyeṣu trīṇi trīṇi ca pādaśaḥ /
liṅgāni ghaṭayeddhīmān ṣaṭsu cāṣṭottareṣu ca //
54.d:
एकैकलिङ्गमध्येषु त्रीणि त्रीणि च पादशः /
लिङ्गानि घटयेद्धीमान् षट्सु चाष्टोत्तरेषु च //
54.m: Within each single liṅga, a wise man should fashion three liṅgas / quarter by quarter, among the one hundred and eight.

54.s:
sthiradīrghaprameyāttu dvāragarbhakarātmikā /
bhāgeśañcāpyamīśañca devejyantulyasaṃjñitaṃ //
54.d:
स्थिरदीर्घप्रमेयात्तु द्वारगर्भकरात्मिका /
भागेशञ्चाप्यमीशञ्च देवेज्यन्तुल्यसंज्ञितं //
54.m: Derived from the stationary and long measurement, consisting of cubits of the door and sanctum, / [they are] named Āḍhya, Anāḍhya, Surejya, and Samāna.

54.s:
catvāri liṅgarūpāṇi viṣkambheṇa tu lakṣayet /
dīrghamāyānvitaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kuryāt trirūpakaṃ //
54.d:
चत्वारि लिङ्गरूपाणि विष्कम्भेण तु लक्षयेत् /
दीर्घमायान्वितं कृत्वा लिङ्गं कुर्यात् त्रिरूपकं //
54.m: One should characterize the four forms of liṅgas by their diameter. / Having made the liṅga long and endowed with length, one should make it threefold in form.

54.s:
caturaṣṭāṣṭavṛttañca tattvatrayaguṇātmakaṃ /
liṅgānāmīpsitaṃ dairghyaṃ tena kṛtvāṅgulāni vai //
54.d:
चतुरष्टाष्टवृत्तञ्च तत्त्वत्रयगुणात्मकं /
लिङ्गानामीप्सितं दैर्घ्यं तेन कृत्वाङ्गुलानि वै //
54.m: Four-sided, eight-sided, and circular, possessing the quality of the three principles: / having determined the desired length of the liṅgas into digits thereby,

54.s:
dhvajādyāyaiḥ surair bhūtaiḥ śikhibhirvā haret kṛtiṃ /
tānyaṅgulāni yaccheṣaṃ lakṣayecca śubhāśubhaṃ //
54.d:
ध्वजाद्यायैः सुरैर् भूतैः शिखिभिर्वा हरेत् कृतिं /
तान्यङ्गुलानि यच्छेषं लक्षयेच्च शुभाशुभं //
54.m: one should divide the product by the deities of the banner and the rest, or by the elements, or by the fires; / whatever remains of those digits, one should discern the auspicious and inauspicious [result].

54.s:
dhvajādyā dhvajasiṃhebhavṛṣāḥ jyeṣṭhāḥ pare śubhāḥ /
svareṣu ṣaḍjagāndhārapañcamāḥ śubhadāyakāḥ //
54.d:
ध्वजाद्या ध्वजसिंहेभवृषाः ज्येष्ठाः परे शुभाः /
स्वरेषु षड्जगान्धारपञ्चमाः शुभदायकाः //
54.m: Banner and the rest are banner, lion, elephant, and bull; the former are best, the others are auspicious. / Among notes, the ṣaḍja, gāndhāra, and pañcama bestow auspiciousness.

54.s:
bhūteṣu ca śubhā bhūḥ syādagniṣvāhavanīyakaḥ /
uktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe nāgāṃśair bhājite kramāt //
54.d:
भूतेषु च शुभा भूः स्यादग्निष्वाहवनीयकः /
उक्तायामस्य चार्धांशे नागांशैर् भाजिते क्रमात् //
54.m: Among elements, the auspicious one is earth; among fires, the āhavanīya. / In half the part of its stated length, divided successively into eight parts,

54.s:
rasabhūtāṃśaṣaṣṭhāṃśatryaṃśādhikaśarair bhavet /
āḍhyānāḍhyasurejyārkatulyānāñcaturasratā //
54.d:
रसभूतांशषष्ठांशत्र्यंशाधिकशरैर् भवेत् /
आढ्यानाढ्यसुरेज्यार्कतुल्यानाञ्चतुरस्रता //
54.m: with an excess of six, five, a sixth, and a third part of five, / the four-sidedness belongs to the Āḍhya, Anāḍhya, Surejya, and Arka-equal [liṅgas].

54.s:
pañcamaṃ vardhamānākhyaṃ vyāsānnāhapravṛddhitaḥ /
dvidhā bhedā bahūnyatra vakṣyante viśvakarmataḥ //
54.d:
पञ्चमं वर्धमानाख्यं व्यासान्नाहप्रवृद्धितः /
द्विधा भेदा बहून्यत्र वक्ष्यन्ते विश्वकर्मतः //
54.m: The fifth is named Vardhamāna, due to an increase in diameter and circumference. / Many twofold distinctions here will be spoken of according to Viśvakarman.

54.s:
āḍhyādīnāṃ tridhā sthaulyādyavadhūtaṃ tadaṣṭadhā(2) /
:n
1 antare vāmavāme ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sthaulyād yavavṛddhyā tadaṣṭadhā iti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 154
tridhā hastājjinākhyañca yuktaṃ sarvasamena ca(1) //
54.d:
आढ्यादीनां त्रिधा स्थौल्याद्यवधूतं तदष्टधा(2) /
:न्
1 अन्तरे वामवामे चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्थौल्याद् यववृद्ध्या तदष्टधा इति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 154
त्रिधा हस्ताज्जिनाख्यञ्च युक्तं सर्वसमेन च(1) //
54.m:
From the threefold thickness of the Āḍhya and the others, that is discarded as eightfold,
[...]
1 "In the interval, on the left and left" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "From thickness by an increase of a barley-corn, that is eightfold" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 154]
threefold from the cubit, called Jina, and endowed with equal dimensions in all.

54.s:
pañcaviṃśatiliṅgāni nādye(2) devārcite tathā /
pañcasaptabhirekatvājjinair bhaktair bhavanti hi //
54.d:
पञ्चविंशतिलिङ्गानि नाद्ये(2) देवार्चिते तथा /
पञ्चसप्तभिरेकत्वाज्जिनैर् भक्तैर् भवन्ति हि //
54.m: There are twenty-five liṅgas in the Āḍhya, and likewise in that worshipped by the gods; / united by five and seven, they indeed become [varieties] divided by Jina.

54.s:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi caturdaśaśatāni ca /
evamaṣṭāṅgulavistāro(3) navaikakaragarbhataḥ //
54.d:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि चतुर्दशशतानि च /
एवमष्टाङ्गुलविस्तारो(3) नवैककरगर्भतः //
54.m: Fourteen thousand and fourteen hundred; / thus the width is eight digits from a sanctum of nine to one cubit.

54.s:
teṣāṃ koṇārdhakoṇasthaiścintyāt koṇāni(4) sūtrakaiḥ /
vistāraṃ madhyamaḥ kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayaṃ //
54.d:
तेषां कोणार्धकोणस्थैश्चिन्त्यात् कोणानि(4) सूत्रकैः /
विस्तारं मध्यमः कृत्वा स्थाप्यं वा मध्यतस्त्रयं //
54.m: By means of cords situated at their corners and half-corners, one should consider the corners. / Having made the middling width, one should establish the triad from the middle,

54.s:
vibhāgādūrdhvamaṣṭāsro(5) dvyaṣṭāsraḥsyācchivāṃśakaḥ /
pādājjānvantako brahmā nābhyanto viṣṇurityataḥ //
54.d:
विभागादूर्ध्वमष्टास्रो(5) द्व्यष्टास्रःस्याच्छिवांशकः /
पादाज्जान्वन्तको ब्रह्मा नाभ्यन्तो विष्णुरित्यतः //
54.m: above the division it should be eight-sided, and the Śiva portion sixteen-sided. / Brahmā extends from the foot to the knees; Viṣṇu up to the navel;

54.s:
mūrdhvānto bhūtabhāgeśo vyakte 'vyakte ca tadvati /
pañcaliṅgavyavasthāyāṃ śiro vartulamucyate //
54.d:
मूर्ध्वान्तो भूतभागेशो व्यक्ते ऽव्यक्ते च तद्वति /
पञ्चलिङ्गव्यवस्थायां शिरो वर्तुलमुच्यते //
54.m: up to the top is the Lord of the elements' portion, in the manifest and unmanifest having that form. / In the system of five liṅgas, the head is said to be circular,

54.s:
chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ vā bālendupratimākṛtiḥ(6) /
ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ(7) kāmyabhedāt phalaṃ vade //
54.d:
छत्राभं कुक्कुटाभं वा बालेन्दुप्रतिमाकृतिः(6) /
एकैकस्य चतुर्भेदैः(7) काम्यभेदात् फलं वदे //
54.m: resembling an umbrella, or resembling a cock's egg, or having the shape of the crescent moon. / By four divisions for each one, I shall tell the fruit according to various desires.

54.s:
liṅgamastakavistāraṃ vasubhaktantu kārayet /
ādyabhāgaṃ caturdhā tu(8) vistārocchrāyato bhajet //
54.d:
लिङ्गमस्तकविस्तारं वसुभक्तन्तु कारयेत् /
आद्यभागं चतुर्धा तु(8) विस्तारोच्छ्रायतो भजेत् //
54.m: One should divide the width of the liṅga's crown into eight parts. / One should divide the first part into four, along width and height.

54.s:
catvāri tatra sūtrāṇi(9) bhāgabhāgānupātanāt /
:n
1 pūjayet sarvameva ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 nāḍhye devārcita iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 evamaṣṭāṅgualavinyāsa iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 chindyāt koṇānīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / chindyāt koṣāṇi
iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 dvibhāgādūrdhavamaṣṭāsra iti kha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 bālendutrapuṣākṛtiriti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 caturbhāgair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
8 antyabhāgamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
9 catvāri tatra chatrāṇi iti ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakacatuṣṭyapāṭhaḥ
:p 155
puṇḍarīkantu bhāgena viśālākhyaṃ vilopanāt //
54.d:
चत्वारि तत्र सूत्राणि(9) भागभागानुपातनात् /
:न्
1 पूजयेत् सर्वमेव चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 नाढ्ये देवार्चित इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 एवमष्टाङ्गुअलविन्यास इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 छिन्द्यात् कोणानीति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / छिन्द्यात् कोषाणि
इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 द्विभागादूर्धवमष्टास्र इति ख, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 बालेन्दुत्रपुषाकृतिरिति ख, ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 चतुर्भागैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
8 अन्त्यभागमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
9 चत्वारि तत्र छत्राणि इति ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्ट्यपाठः
:प् 155
पुण्डरीकन्तु भागेन विशालाख्यं विलोपनात् //
54.m:
There are four cords by dropping division upon division.
[...]
1 "And one should worship all of it" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "In the Āḍhya worshipped by the gods" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3 "Thus is the arrangement of eight digits" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha.
4 "One should cut the corners" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. "One should cut the chambers" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
5 "Above two parts it is eight-sided" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
6 "Having the shape of a cucumber [or] crescent moon" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha, ga, and gha.
7 "By four parts" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
8 "The last part" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha.
9 "There are four umbrellas" is the reading in the four manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa. / [Page 155]
The lotus [head is made] by one part, while that called wide is made by cutting away.

54.s:
triśātanāttu śrīvatsaṃ śatrukṛdvedalopanāt /
śiraḥ sarvasame śreṣṭhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ surāhvaye(1) //
54.d:
त्रिशातनात्तु श्रीवत्सं शत्रुकृद्वेदलोपनात् /
शिरः सर्वसमे श्रेष्ठं कुक्कुटाभं सुराह्वये(1) //
54.m: From paring three [parts] comes the śrīvatsa; by cutting away four, it creates enemies. / The head is best when all is equal; in the divine type, it resembles a cock's egg.

54.s:
caturbhāgātmake liṅgetrapuṣaṃ dvayalopanāt /
anādyasya śiraḥ proktamardhacandraṃ śiraḥ śṛṇu //
54.d:
चतुर्भागात्मके लिङ्गेत्रपुषं द्वयलोपनात् /
अनाद्यस्य शिरः प्रोक्तमर्धचन्द्रं शिरः शृणु //
54.m: In a liṅga consisting of four parts, the trapusa is made by paring away two. / This head of the Anāḍhya has been described; hear about the crescent moon head.

54.s:
aṃśāt prānte yugāṃśaiś ca tvekāhānyāmṛtākṣakaṃ(2) /
pūrṇabālendukumudaṃ dvitrivedakṣayāt kramāt //
54.d:
अंशात् प्रान्ते युगांशैश् च त्वेकाहान्यामृताक्षकं(2) /
पूर्णबालेन्दुकुमुदं द्वित्रिवेदक्षयात् क्रमात् //
54.m: From the part at the end, by four parts, but with the loss of one [part] each day, [it is called] an amṛtākṣaka; / with the loss of two, three, or four parts successively, [it is called] pūrṇabālendu and kumuda.

54.s:
catustrirekavadanaṃ mukhaliṅgamataḥ śṛṇu /
pūjābhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyagnipadakalpitaṃ(3) //
54.d:
चतुस्त्रिरेकवदनं मुखलिङ्गमतः शृणु /
पूजाभागं प्रकर्तव्यं मूर्त्यग्निपदकल्पितं(3) //
54.m: Hear now of the mukhaliṅga having four, three, or one face. / The portion for worship should be made, measured as three parts of the image.

54.s:
arkāṃśaṃ pūrvavat tyaktvā ṣaṭ sthānāni vivartayat /
śironnatiḥ prakartavyā lalāṭaṃ nāsikā tataḥ //
54.d:
अर्कांशं पूर्ववत् त्यक्त्वा षट् स्थानानि विवर्तयत् /
शिरोन्नतिः प्रकर्तव्या ललाटं नासिका ततः //
54.m: Having omitted twelve parts as before, one should shape six sections: / the elevation of the head should be made, then the forehead, the nose,

54.s:
vadanaṃ civukaṃ grīvā yugabhāgair bhujākṣibhiḥ /
karābhyāṃ mukulīkṛtya(4) pratimāyāḥ pramāṇataḥ //
54.d:
वदनं चिवुकं ग्रीवा युगभागैर् भुजाक्षिभिः /
कराभ्यां मुकुलीकृत्य(4) प्रतिमायाः प्रमाणतः //
54.m: the mouth, the chin, and the neck, with four parts, arms, and eyes. / Forming a bud with both hands, according to the measure of the image,

54.s:
mukhaṃ prati samaḥ kāryo vistārādaṣṭamāṃśataḥ /
caturmukhaṃ mayā proktaṃ trimukhañcocyate śṛṇu //
54.d:
मुखं प्रति समः कार्यो विस्तारादष्टमांशतः /
चतुर्मुखं मया प्रोक्तं त्रिमुखञ्चोच्यते शृणु //
54.m: equal for each face, it should be made from one-eighth of the width. / The four-faced [liṅga] has been described by me; now hear of the three-faced [which] is declared:

54.s:
karṇapādādhikāstasya lalāṭādīni nirdiśet /
bhujau caturbhirbhāgaistu kartavyau paścimorjitaṃ //
54.d:
कर्णपादाधिकास्तस्य ललाटादीनि निर्दिशेत् /
भुजौ चतुर्भिर्भागैस्तु कर्तव्यौ पश्चिमोर्जितं //
54.m: His forehead and other [features] should be indicated as increased by a fourth of the ear. / The two arms are to be made with four parts, elevated in the west.

54.s:
vistarādaṣṭamāṃśena mukhānāṃ pratinirgamaḥ /
ekavaktraṃ tathā kāryaṃ pūrvasyāṃ saumyalocanaṃ //
54.d:
विस्तरादष्टमांशेन मुखानां प्रतिनिर्गमः /
एकवक्त्रं तथा कार्यं पूर्वस्यां सौम्यलोचनं //
54.m: The projection of the faces is by an eighth part of the width. / Likewise, a single-faced [liṅga] should be made with gentle eyes in the east.

54.s:
lalāṭanāsikāvaktragrīvāyāñca vivartayet /
:n
1 kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ sudhādvaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dvaikahānyā sutāhvayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ṛtvagnipadakalpitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, mukhabhāgaṃ
prakartavyaṃ mūlāgnipadakalpitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 karṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 156
bhujācca pañcamāṃśena(1) bhujahīnaṃ vivartayet //
54.d:
ललाटनासिकावक्त्रग्रीवायाञ्च विवर्तयेत् /
:न्
1 कुक्कुटाण्डं सुधाद्वये इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 द्वैकहान्या सुताह्वयमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ऋत्वग्निपदकल्पितमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः, मुखभागं
प्रकर्तव्यं मूलाग्निपदकल्पितमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कर्णाभ्यां कुण्डलीकृत्वेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 156
भुजाच्च पञ्चमांशेन(1) भुजहीनं विवर्तयेत् //
54.m:
And one should shape [the head] in the forehead, nose, face, and neck;
[Notes]
1. "kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ sudhādvaye" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "dvaikahānyā sutāhvayam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "ṛtvagnipadakalpitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "mukhabhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūlāgnipadakalpitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "karṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtvā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 156]
and from the arm, by a fifth part, one should shape [it] devoid of arms.

54.s:
vistārasya ṣaḍaṃśena mukhair nirgamanaṃ hitaṃ /
sarveṣāṃ mukhaliṅgānāṃ trapuṣaṃ vātha kukkuṭaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vyaktāvyaktalakṣaṇaṃ nāma
catuḥpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ
54.d:
विस्तारस्य षडंशेन मुखैर् निर्गमनं हितं /
सर्वेषां मुखलिङ्गानां त्रपुषं वाथ कुक्कुटं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये व्यक्ताव्यक्तलक्षणं नाम
चतुःपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
पिण्डिकालक्षणकथनं
54.m:
The projection by the faces is beneficial as one-sixth of the width. / For all mukhaliṅgas, [the top] is like a cucumber or a cock's [egg].
Thus in the glorious and primal Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the fifty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Characteristics of the Manifest and Unmanifest [Liṅgas]”.
Now, the fifty-fifth chapter.
Declaration of the characteristics of the pedestal

55.s:
bhagavānuvāca
ataḥ paraṃpravakṣyāmi pratimānāntu piṇḍikām /
dairghyeṇa pratimātulyā tadardhena tu vistṛtā //
55.d:
भगवानुवाच
अतः परंप्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमानान्तु पिण्डिकाम् /
दैर्घ्येण प्रतिमातुल्या तदर्धेन तु विस्तृता //
55.m: The Lord said: / Hereafter I shall declare the pedestal of images. / It is equal in length to the image, and wide by half of that.

55.s:
ucchritāyāmatordhena suvistārārdhabhāgataḥ /
tṛtīyena tu vā tulyaṃ(2) tattribhāgeṇa mekhalā //
55.d:
उच्छ्रितायामतोर्धेन सुविस्तारार्धभागतः /
तृतीयेन तु वा तुल्यं(2) तत्त्रिभागेण मेखला //
55.m: Its height is half of its length, from a half-portion of its well-proportioned width, / or equal to a third; its rim is with a third of that.

55.s:
khātaṃ ca tatpramāṇaṃ tu kiñciduttarato natam /
vistārasya caturthena praṇālasya vinirgamaḥ //
55.d:
खातं च तत्प्रमाणं तु किञ्चिदुत्तरतो नतम् /
विस्तारस्य चतुर्थेन प्रणालस्य विनिर्गमः //
55.m: And the excavation of that measure should be slightly inclined to the north. / The outlet of the water-channel is by a fourth of the width.

55.s:
samūlasya vistāramagre kuryāttadardhataḥ /
vistārasya tṛtīyena toyamārgantu kārayet //
55.d:
समूलस्य विस्तारमग्रे कुर्यात्तदर्धतः /
विस्तारस्य तृतीयेन तोयमार्गन्तु कारयेत् //
55.m: One should make the width of its base half of that at the tip. / One should make the water conduit with a third of the width.

55.s:
piṇḍikārdhena vā tulyaṃ(3) dairghyamīśasya(4) kīrtitam /
īśaṃ vā(5) tulyadīrghañca jñātvā sūtraṃ prakalpayet //
:n
1 bhujārdhapañcamāṃśeneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tribhāgena tu bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 piṇḍikārdhena bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 dairghyaṃ kuśasyeti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 kuśambāhulyadīrghañceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 157
55.d:
पिण्डिकार्धेन वा तुल्यं(3) दैर्घ्यमीशस्य(4) कीर्तितम् /
ईशं वा(5) तुल्यदीर्घञ्च ज्ञात्वा सूत्रं प्रकल्पयेत् //
:न्
1 भुजार्धपञ्चमांशेनेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 त्रिभागेन तु बाहुल्यमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पिण्डिकार्धेन बाहुल्यमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 दैर्घ्यं कुशस्येति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 कुशम्बाहुल्यदीर्घञ्चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 157
55.m:
Or the length of Śiva is declared to be equal to half of the pedestal; / or knowing Śiva to be of equal length, one should lay out the cord.
[Notes]
1. "bhujārdhapañcamāṃśena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "tribhāgena tu bāhulyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "piṇḍikārdhena bāhulyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "dairghyaṃ kuśasya" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
5. "kuśambāhulyadīrghañca" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 157]

55.s:
ucchrāyaṃ pūrvavat kuryādbhāgaṣoḍaśasaṅkhyayā /
adhaḥ ṣaṭkaṃ dvibhāgantu kaṇṭhaṃ kuryāttribhāgakam //
55.d:
उच्छ्रायं पूर्ववत् कुर्याद्भागषोडशसङ्ख्यया /
अधः षट्कं द्विभागन्तु कण्ठं कुर्यात्त्रिभागकम् //
55.m: One should make the height as before, with a count of sixteen parts: / the lowest six [parts]; the neck should be two parts, [or] one should make it three parts.

55.s:
śeṣāstvekaikaśaḥ kāryāḥ pratiṣṭhānirgamās tathā /
paṭṭikā piṇḍikā ceyaṃ sāmānyapratimāsu ca //
55.d:
शेषास्त्वेकैकशः कार्याः प्रतिष्ठानिर्गमास् तथा /
पट्टिका पिण्डिका चेयं सामान्यप्रतिमासु च //
55.m: The remaining [parts] are to be made singly, as well as the projections of the base. / This molding and pedestal are for common images.

55.s:
prāsādadvāramānena pratimādvāramucyate(1) /
gajavyālakasaṃyuktā prabhā syāt pratimāsu ca //
55.d:
प्रासादद्वारमानेन प्रतिमाद्वारमुच्यते(1) /
गजव्यालकसंयुक्ता प्रभा स्यात् प्रतिमासु च //
55.m: The door of the image is declared according to the measure of the temple door. / And there should be an aureole endowed with elephants and vyālas for the images.

55.s:
piṇḍikāpi yathāśobhaṃ kartavyā satataṃ hareḥ /
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ śiṣṇūktaṃ mānamucyate /
devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ lakṣmyuktaṃ mānamucyate //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ nāma
pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dikpālayāgakathanaṃ
55.d:
पिण्डिकापि यथाशोभं कर्तव्या सततं हरेः /
सर्वेषामेव देवानां शिष्णूक्तं मानमुच्यते /
देवीनामपि सर्वासां लक्ष्म्युक्तं मानमुच्यते //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पिण्डिकालक्षणं नाम
पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षट्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
दिक्पालयागकथनं
55.m:
The pedestal of Hari should also always be made according to beauty. / The measure stated for Viṣṇu is declared for all gods; / the measure stated for Lakṣmī is declared for all goddesses.
Thus in the glorious and primal Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the fifty-fifth chapter, entitled “The Characteristics of the Pedestal”.
Now, the fifty-sixth chapter.
Declaration of the sacrifice to the guardians of the directions

56.s:
bhagavānuvāca
pratiṣṭhāpañcakaṃ vakṣye pratimātmā tu pūruṣaḥ /
prakṛtiḥ piṇḍikā lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhā yogakastayoḥ //
56.d:
भगवानुवाच
प्रतिष्ठापञ्चकं वक्ष्ये प्रतिमात्मा तु पूरुषः /
प्रकृतिः पिण्डिका लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठा योगकस्तयोः //
56.m: The Lord said: / I shall declare the fivefold consecration: the image itself is Puruṣa, / the pedestal is Prakṛti, Lakṣmī, and consecration is the union of the two.

56.s:
icchāphalārthibhistasmātpratiṣṭhā kriyate naraiḥ /
garbhasūtraṃ tu niḥsārya(2) prāsādasyāgrato guruḥ //
56.d:
इच्छाफलार्थिभिस्तस्मात्प्रतिष्ठा क्रियते नरैः /
गर्भसूत्रं तु निःसार्य(2) प्रासादस्याग्रतो गुरुः //
56.m: Therefore consecration is performed by men desiring the fruit of their wishes. / Having drawn out the center-cord in front of the temple, the guru [should construct]

56.s:
aṣṭaṣoḍaśaviṃśāntaṃ maṇḍapañcādhamādikam /
snānaṃ kalaśārthañca yāgadravyārthamardhataḥ //
56.d:
अष्टषोडशविंशान्तं मण्डपञ्चाधमादिकम् /
स्नानं कलशार्थञ्च यागद्रव्यार्थमर्धतः //
56.m: a pavilion of eight, sixteen, or up to twenty [cubits], lowest and so forth; / half of it for bathing and water-jars, and for sacrificial materials.

56.s:
tribhāgeṇārdhabhāgena vediṃ kuryāttu śobhanām /
:n
1 pratimādravyamucyate iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 garbhasūtrantu nirmāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 158
kalaśair ghaṭikābhiś ca vitānādyaiś ca bhūṣayet //
56.d:
त्रिभागेणार्धभागेन वेदिं कुर्यात्तु शोभनाम् /
:न्
1 प्रतिमाद्रव्यमुच्यते इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गर्भसूत्रन्तु निर्मायेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 158
कलशैर् घटिकाभिश् च वितानाद्यैश् च भूषयेत् //
56.m:
With a third or half portion, one should make a beautiful altar.
[Notes]
1. "pratimādravyamucyate" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "garbhasūtrantu nirmāya" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 158]
One should adorn it with jars, small pots, canopies, and the like.

56.s:
pañcagavyena samprokṣya sarvadravyāṇi dhārayet /
alaṅkṛto gururviṣṇuṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ prapūjayet //
56.d:
पञ्चगव्येन सम्प्रोक्ष्य सर्वद्रव्याणि धारयेत् /
अलङ्कृतो गुरुर्विष्णुं ध्यात्वात्मानं प्रपूजयेत् //
56.m: Having sprinkled all materials with the five products of the cow, one should place them. / Adorned, the guru, having meditated on Viṣṇu, should worship himself.

56.s:
aṅgulīyaprabhṛtibhirmūrtipān valayādibhiḥ /
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthāpayecca mūrtipāṃstatra pāragān //
56.d:
अङ्गुलीयप्रभृतिभिर्मूर्तिपान् वलयादिभिः /
कुण्डे कुण्डे स्थापयेच्च मूर्तिपांस्तत्र पारगान् //
56.m: With rings and the like, bracelets and the like, [he should honor] the guardians of the icons; / and he should station the guardians of the icons, who are proficient, at each fire-pit,

56.s:
catuṣkoṇe cārdhakoṇe vartule padmasannibhe /
pūrvādau toraṇārthantu pippaloḍumbarau vaṭaṃ //
56.d:
चतुष्कोणे चार्धकोणे वर्तुले पद्मसन्निभे /
पूर्वादौ तोरणार्थन्तु पिप्पलोडुम्बरौ वटं //
56.m: in the square, semicircular, circular, and lotus-like [fire-pits]. / In the east and other [directions], for the archways: the pippala, uḍumbara, banyan,

56.s:
plakṣaṃ suśobhanaṃ pūrvaṃ subhadrandakṣatoraṇaṃ /
sukarma ca suhotrañca āpye saumye samucchrayam //
56.d:
प्लक्षं सुशोभनं पूर्वं सुभद्रन्दक्षतोरणं /
सुकर्म च सुहोत्रञ्च आप्ये सौम्ये समुच्छ्रयम् //
56.m: and the very beautiful plakṣa [trees]. The eastern [archway] is Subhadra; the southern archway / is Sukarma; and in the western and northern [directions], the heights [are called] Suhotra [and Saumya].

56.s:
pañcahastaṃ tu saṃsthāpya syonāpṛthvīti pūjayet /
toraṇastambhamūle tu kalaśānmaṅgalāṅkurān //
56.d:
पञ्चहस्तं तु संस्थाप्य स्योनापृथ्वीति पूजयेत् /
तोरणस्तम्भमूले तु कलशान्मङ्गलाङ्कुरान् //
56.m: Having erected [an archway] of five cubits, one should worship it with “syonā pṛthivī...”. / At the base of the pillar of the archway, jars with auspicious sprouts

56.s:
pradadyādupariṣṭācca kuryāccakraṃ sudarśanaṃ /
pañcahastapramāṇantu dhvajaṃ kuryāddvicakṣaṇaḥ //
56.d:
प्रदद्यादुपरिष्टाच्च कुर्याच्चक्रं सुदर्शनं /
पञ्चहस्तप्रमाणन्तु ध्वजं कुर्याद्द्विचक्षणः //
56.m: one should place, and above it one should make the Sudarśana discus. / The wise man should make a banner measuring five cubits,

56.s:
vaipulyaṃ cāsya kurvīta ṣoḍaśāṅgulasanmitaṃ /
saptahastocchritaṃ vāsya kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ surottama(1) //
56.d:
वैपुल्यं चास्य कुर्वीत षोडशाङ्गुलसन्मितं /
सप्तहस्तोच्छ्रितं वास्य कुर्यात् कुण्डं सुरोत्तम(1) //
56.m: and he should make its width measure sixteen inches; / or, O best of gods, one should make its fire-pit seven cubits high.

56.s:
aruṇogninibhaś caiva kṛṣṇaḥ śuklotha pītakaḥ /
raktavarṇas tathā śvetaḥ śvetavarṇādikakramāt(2) //
56.d:
अरुणोग्निनिभश् चैव कृष्णः शुक्लोथ पीतकः /
रक्तवर्णस् तथा श्वेतः श्वेतवर्णादिकक्रमात्(2) //
56.m: Reddish-brown, fire-like, black, white, and yellow; / red-colored and white, in the order of white and other colors:

56.s:
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ /
śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ //
56.d:
कुमुदः कुमुदाक्षश् च पुण्डरीकोथ वामनः /
शङ्कुकर्णः सर्वनेत्रः सुमुखः सुप्रतिष्ठितः //
56.m: Kumuda, Kumudākṣa, Puṇḍarīka, then Vāmana, / Śaṅkukarṇa, Sarvanetra, Sumukha, and Supratiṣṭhita.

56.s:
pūjyā koṭiguṇair yuktāḥ pūrvādyā dhvajadevatāḥ /
jalāḍhakasupūrāstu pakvavimbopamā ghaṭāḥ //
:n
1 samāhita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śvetavarnakramāt dhvajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramāddhvajā iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 159
56.d:
पूज्या कोटिगुणैर् युक्ताः पूर्वाद्या ध्वजदेवताः /
जलाढकसुपूरास्तु पक्वविम्बोपमा घटाः //
:न्
1 समाहित इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 श्वेतवर्नक्रमात् ध्वजा इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
कृष्णवर्णः क्रमाद्ध्वजा इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 159
56.m:
Endowed with ten million qualities, the banner deities in the east and other directions are to be worshipped. / The jars, resembling ripe bimba fruit, should be well filled with an āḍhaka of water.
[Notes]
1. "samāhitaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "śvetavarṇakramāt dhvajāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
"kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramāddhvajāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 159]

56.s:
aṣṭāviṃśādhikaśataṃ kālamaṇḍanavarjitāḥ /
sahiraṇyā vastrakaṇṭhāḥ sodakāstoraṇādvahiḥ //
56.d:
अष्टाविंशाधिकशतं कालमण्डनवर्जिताः /
सहिरण्या वस्त्रकण्ठाः सोदकास्तोरणाद्वहिः //
56.m: One hundred and twenty-eight [pots], devoid of dark adornment, / with gold, with cloth-wrapped necks, and with water, outside the archways,

56.s:
ghaṭāḥ sthāpyāś ca pūrvādau vedikāyāś ca koṇagān /
caturaḥ sthāpayet kumbhānājighreti ca mantrataḥ //
56.d:
घटाः स्थाप्याश् च पूर्वादौ वेदिकायाश् च कोणगान् /
चतुरः स्थापयेत् कुम्भानाजिघ्रेति च मन्त्रतः //
56.m: are the pots to be placed, beginning in the east; and at the corners of the altar / one should place four pots with the mantra, "Smell [the jar]."

56.s:
kumbheṣvāvāhya śakrādīn pūrvādau pūjayet kramāt /
indrāgaccha devarāja vajrahasta gajasthita //
56.d:
कुम्भेष्वावाह्य शक्रादीन् पूर्वादौ पूजयेत् क्रमात् /
इन्द्रागच्छ देवराज वज्रहस्त गजस्थित //
56.m: Having invoked Śakra and the others into the pots, he should worship them in order from the east: / "Come, O Indra, king of the gods, thunderbolt in hand, seated on an elephant!

56.s:
pūrvadvārañca me rakṣa devaiḥ saha namostu te /
trātāramindramantreṇa arcayitvā yajed budhaḥ //
56.d:
पूर्वद्वारञ्च मे रक्ष देवैः सह नमोस्तु ते /
त्रातारमिन्द्रमन्त्रेण अर्चयित्वा यजेद् बुधः //
56.m: Protect my eastern door together with the gods; homage to you!" / Having worshiped Indra with the "trātāram" mantra, the wise man should make an offering.

56.s:
āgacchāgre śaktiyuta(1) cchāgastha balasaṃyuta /
rakṣāgneyīṃ diśaṃ devaiḥ pūjāṃ gṛha namostu te //
56.d:
आगच्छाग्रे शक्तियुत(1) च्छागस्थ बलसंयुत /
रक्षाग्नेयीं दिशं देवैः पूजां गृह नमोस्तु ते //
56.m: "Come before [us], possessing the spear, seated on a goat, endowed with strength! / Protect the south-eastern quarter with the gods; accept the worship; homage to you!"

56.s:
agnimūrdhetimantreṇa(2) yajedvā āgneya namaḥ /
mahiṣastha yamāgaccha daṇḍahasta mahābala //
56.d:
अग्निमूर्धेतिमन्त्रेण(2) यजेद्वा आग्नेय नमः /
महिषस्थ यमागच्छ दण्डहस्त महाबल //
56.m: One should worship him with the mantra, "Agni is the head...", or with: "Homage to Agni!" / "Come, O Yama, seated on a buffalo, staff in hand, possessed of great strength!

56.s:
rakṣa tvaṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vaivasvata namostu te /
vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanamityanena yajedyamaṃ //
56.d:
रक्ष त्वं दक्षिणद्वारं वैवस्वत नमोस्तु ते /
वैवस्वतं सङ्गमनमित्यनेन यजेद्यमं //
56.m: Protect the southern door, O Vaivasvata; homage to you!" / One should worship Yama with this [mantra]: "To Vaivasvata, the gathering-place..."

56.s:
nairṛtāgaccha khaḍgāḍhya balavāhanasaṃyuta(3) /
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ nairṛtīṃ diśaṃ //
56.d:
नैरृतागच्छ खड्गाढ्य बलवाहनसंयुत(3) /
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं रक्ष त्वं नैरृतीं दिशं //
56.m: "Come, O Nairṛta, rich in swords, accompanied by troops and a mount! / Here is the water offering, here is the foot-washing water; protect the south-western quarter!"

56.s:
eṣa te nairṛte mantreṇa yajedarghyādibhir naraḥ /
makarārūḍha varuṇa pāśahasta mahābala //
56.d:
एष ते नैरृते मन्त्रेण यजेदर्घ्यादिभिर् नरः /
मकरारूढ वरुण पाशहस्त महाबल //
56.m: A man should worship him with the mantra, "This is your [share], O Nairṛta...", with the water offering and the rest. / "O Varuṇa, mounted on a makara, noose in hand, possessed of great strength,

56.s:
āgaccha paścimaṃ dvāraṃ rakṣa rakṣa namostu te /
uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaṃ yajedarghyādibhirguruḥ //
56.d:
आगच्छ पश्चिमं द्वारं रक्ष रक्ष नमोस्तु ते /
उरुं हि राजा वरुणं यजेदर्घ्यादिभिर्गुरुः //
56.m: come, protect the western door, protect it; homage to you!" / The guru should worship King Varuṇa with the "uruṃ hi" [mantra] and with water offerings and the like.

56.s:
āgaccha vāyo sabala dhvajahasta savāhana /
vāyavyaṃ rakṣa devaistvaṃ samarudbhir namostu te //
:n
1 śaktihasta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 agnimūrdhveti arghyādyair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 naravāhanasaṃyuta iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 160
56.d:
आगच्छ वायो सबल ध्वजहस्त सवाहन /
वायव्यं रक्ष देवैस्त्वं समरुद्भिर् नमोस्तु ते //
:न्
1 शक्तिहस्त इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अग्निमूर्ध्वेति अर्घ्याद्यैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 नरवाहनसंयुत इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 160
56.m:
"Come, O Vāyu, with your army, banner in hand, with your mount! / Protect the north-western quarter together with the gods and the Maruts; homage to you!"
[...]
[Apparatus note 1: "śaktihasta" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa]
[Apparatus note 2: "agnimūrdhveti arghyādyair" is the variant reading in manuscript kha]
[Apparatus note 3: "naravāhanasaṃyuta" is the variant reading in manuscripts kha and ṅa]

56.s:
vāta ity ādibhiścārvedonnamo vāyavepi vā /
āgaccha soma sabalā gadāhasta savāhana //
56.d:
वात इत्य् आदिभिश्चार्वेदोन्नमो वायवेपि वा /
आगच्छ सोम सबला गदाहस्त सवाहन //
56.m: And with "The wind..." and so forth he should offer homage, or with "Homage to Vāyu." / "Come, O Soma, with your army, mace in hand, with your mount!

56.s:
rakṣa tvamuttaradvāraṃ sakuvera namostu te /
somaṃ rājānamiti vā yajetsomāya vai namaḥ //
56.d:
रक्ष त्वमुत्तरद्वारं सकुवेर नमोस्तु ते /
सोमं राजानमिति वा यजेत्सोमाय वै नमः //
56.m: Protect the northern door, along with Kubera; homage to you!" / Or one should worship with: "Soma the king...", or indeed, "Homage to Soma!"

56.s:
āgaccheśāna sabala śūlahasta vṛṣasthita /
yajñamaṇḍapasyaiśānīṃ diśaṃ rakṣa namostu te //
56.d:
आगच्छेशान सबल शूलहस्त वृषस्थित /
यज्ञमण्डपस्यैशानीं दिशं रक्ष नमोस्तु ते //
56.m: "Come, O Īśāna, with your army, trident in hand, mounted on a bull! / Protect the north-eastern quarter of the sacrificial pavilion; homage to you!"

56.s:
īśānamasyeti yajedīśānāya namopi vā /
brahmannāgaccha haṃsastha sruksruvavyagrahastaka //
56.d:
ईशानमस्येति यजेदीशानाय नमोपि वा /
ब्रह्मन्नागच्छ हंसस्थ स्रुक्स्रुवव्यग्रहस्तक //
56.m: One should worship with "Lord of this [world]...", or with: "Homage to Īśāna." / "Come, O Brahmā, seated on a swan, your hands occupied with the sruc and sruva ladles!

56.s:
salokordhvāṃ diśaṃ rakṣa yajñasyāja namostu te /
hiraṇyagarbheti yajennamaste brahmaṇepi vā //
56.d:
सलोकोर्ध्वां दिशं रक्ष यज्ञस्याज नमोस्तु ते /
हिरण्यगर्भेति यजेन्नमस्ते ब्रह्मणेपि वा //
56.m: Protect the upper direction of the sacrifice together with the worlds, O Unborn One; homage to you!" / One should worship with "The Golden Embryo...", or: "Homage to Brahmā!"

56.s:
anantāgaccha cakrāḍhya kūrmasthāhigaṇeśvara /
adhodiśaṃ rakṣa rakṣa ananteśa namostu te /
namostu sarpeti yajedanantāya namopi vā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye dikpatiyāgo nāma
ṣaṭpañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptapañcāśodhyāyaḥ
kumbhādhivāsavidhiḥ
56.d:
अनन्तागच्छ चक्राढ्य कूर्मस्थाहिगणेश्वर /
अधोदिशं रक्ष रक्ष अनन्तेश नमोस्तु ते /
नमोस्तु सर्पेति यजेदनन्ताय नमोपि वा //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये दिक्पतियागो नाम
षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तपञ्चाशोध्यायः
कुम्भाधिवासविधिः
56.m:
"Come, O Ananta, endowed with the discus, seated on a tortoise, lord of the serpent hosts! / Protect, protect the downward direction, O Lord Ananta; homage to you!" / One should worship with "Homage to the serpent...", or with: "Homage to Ananta."
Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, named "Sacrifice to the Guardians of the Directions", in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the fifty-seventh chapter.
The ritual of preliminary consecration of the jars.

57.s:
bhagavānuvāca
bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kuryāt kṣipedbrīhīṃś ca sarṣapān /
nārasiṃhena rakṣoghnān prokṣoghnān prokṣayet pañcagavyataḥ //
57.d:
भगवानुवाच
भूमेः परिग्रहं कुर्यात् क्षिपेद्ब्रीहींश् च सर्षपान् /
नारसिंहेन रक्षोघ्नान् प्रोक्षोघ्नान् प्रोक्षयेत् पञ्चगव्यतः //
57.m: The Holy One said: / One should take possession of the ground, and scatter rice and mustard seeds; / with the Nṛsiṃha [mantra] destroying demons, he should sprinkle [the site] with the five cow-products.

57.s:
bhūmiṃ ghaṭe tu sampūjya saratne sāṅgakaṃ hariṃ /
astramantreṇa karakaṃ(1) tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ yajet //
57.d:
भूमिं घटे तु सम्पूज्य सरत्ने साङ्गकं हरिं /
अस्त्रमन्त्रेण करकं(1) तत्र चाष्टशतं यजेत् //
57.m: Having worshiped the earth in the pot, and Hari with his limbs alongside jewels, / he should worship the water-pot there one hundred and eight times with the weapon-mantra.

57.s:
acchinnadhārayā siñcan brīhīn saṃskṛtya dhārayet /
:n
1 astramantreṇa kavacamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 161
pradakṣiṇaṃ paribhrāmya kalaśaṃ vikiropari //
57.d:
अच्छिन्नधारया सिञ्चन् ब्रीहीन् संस्कृत्य धारयेत् /
:न्
1 अस्त्रमन्त्रेण कवचमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 161
प्रदक्षिणं परिभ्राम्य कलशं विकिरोपरि //
57.m:
Sprinkling with an unbroken stream, having consecrated the rice grains, he should hold [them].
[...]
[Apparatus note 1: "astramantreṇa kavacam" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa]
Circumambulating clockwise, he should scatter [them] over the pot.

57.s:
savastre kalaśe bhūyaḥ pūjayedacyutaṃ śriyaṃ /
yoge yogeti mantreṇa nyasecchayyāntu maṇḍale //
57.d:
सवस्त्रे कलशे भूयः पूजयेदच्युतं श्रियं /
योगे योगेति मन्त्रेण न्यसेच्छय्यान्तु मण्डले //
57.m: Upon the cloth-covered pot he should again worship Acyuta and Śrī; / with the mantra "In union after union...", he should place the bed on the maṇḍala.

57.s:
kuśopari tūlikāñca śayyāyāṃ digvidikṣu ca /
vidyādhipān yajedviṣṇuṃ madhughātaṃ trivikramaṃ //
57.d:
कुशोपरि तूलिकाञ्च शय्यायां दिग्विदिक्षु च /
विद्याधिपान् यजेद्विष्णुं मधुघातं त्रिविक्रमं //
57.m: And upon the kuśa grass [he should place] a mattress; on the bed and in the cardinal and intermediate directions / he should worship the lords of knowledge: Viṣṇu, the Slayer of Madhu, Trivikrama,

57.s:
vāmanaṃ dikṣu vāyvādau(1) śrīdharañca hṛṣīkapaṃ /
padmanābhaṃ dāmodaramaiśānyāṃ snānamaṇḍape //
57.d:
वामनं दिक्षु वाय्वादौ(1) श्रीधरञ्च हृषीकपं /
पद्मनाभं दामोदरमैशान्यां स्नानमण्डपे //
57.m: Vāmana in the directions starting with north-west, Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa, / Padmanābha, and Dāmodara; [and] in the north-east in the bathing pavilion.

57.s:
abhyarcya paścādaiśānyāṃ catuṣkumbhe(2) savedike /
snānamaṇḍaṣake sarvadravyāṇyānīya nikṣipet //
57.d:
अभ्यर्च्य पश्चादैशान्यां चतुष्कुम्भे(2) सवेदिके /
स्नानमण्डषके सर्वद्रव्याण्यानीय निक्षिपेत् //
57.m: Having worshiped, afterwards in the north-east, with four pots, equipped with an altar / in the small bathing pavilion, having brought all materials, he should deposit them.

57.s:
snānakumbheṣu kumbhāṃstāṃś caturdikṣvadhivāsayet /
kalaśāḥ sthāpanīyāstu abhiṣekārthamādarāt //
57.d:
स्नानकुम्भेषु कुम्भांस्तांश् चतुर्दिक्ष्वधिवासयेत् /
कलशाः स्थापनीयास्तु अभिषेकार्थमादरात् //
57.m: In the bathing pots, he should perform the preliminary consecration of those pots in the four directions; / jars must indeed be placed with care for the purpose of the consecration by aspersion.

57.s:
vaṭodumbarakāśvatthāṃś campakāśokaśrīdrumān(3) /
palāśārjunaplakṣāṃstu kadambavakulāmrakān //
57.d:
वटोदुम्बरकाश्वत्थांश् चम्पकाशोकश्रीद्रुमान्(3) /
पलाशार्जुनप्लक्षांस्तु कदम्बवकुलाम्रकान् //
57.m: Banyan, udumbara, and aśvattha; campaka, aśoka, and śrī-trees; / palāśa, arjuna, and plakṣa; kadamba, bakula, and mango:

57.s:
pallavāṃstu samānīya pūrvakumbhe(4) vinikṣipet /
padmakaṃ rocanāṃ dūrvāṃ darbhapiñjalameva ca //
57.d:
पल्लवांस्तु समानीय पूर्वकुम्भे(4) विनिक्षिपेत् /
पद्मकं रोचनां दूर्वां दर्भपिञ्जलमेव च //
57.m: having collected their sprouts, he should place them into the eastern pot. / Padmaka wood, yellow orpiment, dūrvā grass, and tufts of darbha grass,

57.s:
jātīpuṣpaṃ kundapuṣpacandanaṃ raktacandanaṃ /
siddhārthaṃ tagarañcaiva taṇḍulaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset //
57.d:
जातीपुष्पं कुन्दपुष्पचन्दनं रक्तचन्दनं /
सिद्धार्थं तगरञ्चैव तण्डुलं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् //
57.m: jasmine flower, kunda flower, sandalwood, red sandalwood, / white mustard, tagara, and rice: he should place these in the south.

57.s:
savarṇaṃ rajatañcaiva kūladvayamṛdantathā /
nadyāḥ samudragāminyā viśeṣāt jāhnavīmṛdaṃ //
57.d:
सवर्णं रजतञ्चैव कूलद्वयमृदन्तथा /
नद्याः समुद्रगामिन्या विशेषात् जाह्नवीमृदं //
57.m: Gold, silver, and earth from both banks / of a river that flows into the ocean, especially earth from the Ganges,

57.s:
gomayañca yavān śālīṃstilāṃś caivāpare nyaset /
viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmalatāṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ śatāvarīṃ //
:n
1 dikṣu vahnyādāviti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 catustambhe iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 padmakāśokaśrīdrumāniti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 parṇakumbha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 162
57.d:
गोमयञ्च यवान् शालींस्तिलांश् चैवापरे न्यसेत् /
विष्णुपर्णीं श्यामलतां भृङ्गराजं शतावरीं //
:न्
1 दिक्षु वह्न्यादाविति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 चतुस्तम्भे इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पद्मकाशोकश्रीद्रुमानिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 पर्णकुम्भ इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 162
57.m:
cow dung, barley, winter rice, and sesame seeds he should place in the west. / Viṣṇuparṇī, śyāmalatā, bhṛṅgarāja, śatāvarī,
[...]
[Apparatus note 1: "dikṣu vahnyādāv" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa]
[Apparatus note 2: "catustambhe" is the variant reading in manuscript ga]
[Apparatus note 3: "padmakāśokaśrīdrumān" is the variant reading in manuscript ga]
[Apparatus note 4: "parṇakumbha" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa]

57.s:
sahadevāṃ mahādevīṃ(1) balāṃ vyaghrīṃ salakṣmaṇāṃ /
aiśānyāmapare kumbhe maṅgalyānviniveśayet //
57.d:
सहदेवां महादेवीं(1) बलां व्यघ्रीं सलक्ष्मणां /
ऐशान्यामपरे कुम्भे मङ्गल्यान्विनिवेशयेत् //
57.m: sahadevā, mahādevī, balā, vyāghrī, along with lakṣmaṇā: / in the north-east, in another pot, he should place these auspicious herbs.

57.s:
valmīkamṛttikāṃ saptasthānotthāmapare nyaset /
jāhnavīvālukātoyaṃ vinyasedapare ghaṭe //
57.d:
वल्मीकमृत्तिकां सप्तस्थानोत्थामपरे न्यसेत् /
जाह्नवीवालुकातोयं विन्यसेदपरे घटे //
57.m: He should deposit ant-hill earth, taken from seven places, in another [pot]; / he should deposit water and sand from the Ganges in another pot.

57.s:
varāhavṛṣanāgendraviṣāṇoddhṛtamṛttikāṃ /
mṛttikāṃ padmamūlasya kuśasya tvapare nyaset //
57.d:
वराहवृषनागेन्द्रविषाणोद्धृतमृत्तिकां /
मृत्तिकां पद्ममूलस्य कुशस्य त्वपरे न्यसेत् //
57.m: Earth dug up by the tusks of a boar, a bull, and a noble elephant; / and earth from the root of a lotus and of kuśa grass he should place in another [pot].

57.s:
tīrthaparvatamṛdbhiś ca yuktamapyapare nyaset /
nāgakeśarapuṣpañca kāśmīramapare nyaset //
57.d:
तीर्थपर्वतमृद्भिश् च युक्तमप्यपरे न्यसेत् /
नागकेशरपुष्पञ्च काश्मीरमपरे न्यसेत् //
57.m: He should also place [water] combined with earth from sacred fords and mountains in another [pot]; / and in another [pot] he should place the nāgakesara flower and saffron.

57.s:
candanāgurukarpūraiḥ puṣpaṃ caivāpare nyaset /
vaidūryaṃ vidrumaṃ muktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vajrameva ca //
57.d:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरैः पुष्पं चैवापरे न्यसेत् /
वैदूर्यं विद्रुमं मुक्तां स्फटिकं वज्रमेव च //
57.m: And in another [pot] he should place flowers along with sandalwood, agarwood, and camphor; / cat's eye, coral, pearl, crystal, and diamond:

57.s:
etānyekatra nikṣipya sthāpayeddevasattama /
nadīnadataḍāgānāṃ salilair aparaṃ nyaset //
57.d:
एतान्येकत्र निक्षिप्य स्थापयेद्देवसत्तम /
नदीनदतडागानां सलिलैर् अपरं न्यसेत् //
57.m: having placed these together, he should set them down, O best of gods. / In another [pot] he should deposit waters from rivers, streams, and ponds.

57.s:
ekāśītipade cānyānmaṇḍape kalaśān nyaset /
gandhodakādyaiḥ sampūrṇān śrīsūktenābhimantrayet //
57.d:
एकाशीतिपदे चान्यान्मण्डपे कलशान् न्यसेत् /
गन्धोदकाद्यैः सम्पूर्णान् श्रीसूक्तेनाभिमन्त्रयेत् //
57.m: And in the pavilion he should place other jars on eighty-one squares; / filled with fragrant water and the like, he should consecrate them with the Śrīsūkta.

57.s:
yavaṃ siddhārthakaṃ gandhaṃ kuśāgraṃ cākṣataṃ tathā /
tilān phalaṃ tathā puṣpamarghyārthaṃ pūrvato nyaset //
57.d:
यवं सिद्धार्थकं गन्धं कुशाग्रं चाक्षतं तथा /
तिलान् फलं तथा पुष्पमर्घ्यार्थं पूर्वतो न्यसेत् //
57.m: Barley, white mustard, perfume, the tip of kuśa grass, and unbroken grain, / sesame seeds, fruit, and flowers: he should place these in the east for the water offering.

57.s:
padmaṃ śyāmalatāṃ dūrvāṃ viṣṇuparṇīṃ kuśāṃstathā /
pādyārthaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge madhuparkaṃ tu dakṣiṇe(2) //
57.d:
पद्मं श्यामलतां दूर्वां विष्णुपर्णीं कुशांस्तथा /
पाद्यार्थं दक्षिणे भागे मधुपर्कं तु दक्षिणे(2) //
57.m: Lotus, śyāmalatā, dūrvā grass, viṣṇuparṇī, and kuśa grass / for foot-washing water in the southern quarter; and honey-mixture in the south.

57.s:
kakkolakaṃ lavaṅgañca tathā jātīphalaṃ śubhaṃ /
uttare hy ācamanāya agnau dūrvākṣatānvitaṃ //
57.d:
कक्कोलकं लवङ्गञ्च तथा जातीफलं शुभं /
उत्तरे ह्य् आचमनाय अग्नौ दूर्वाक्षतान्वितं //
57.m: Kakkolaka, clove, and auspicious nutmeg / in the north for rinsing the mouth; in the fire [direction] a vessel with dūrvā and unbroken grain

57.s:
pātraṃ nīrājanārthaṃ ca tathodvartanamānile /
gandhapuṣpānvitaṃ pātramaiśānyāṃ pātrake nyaset //
:n
1 sahadevāṃ siṃhapucchīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / sahadevāṃ
javāṃ siṃhīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 madhuparkantu paścime iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 163
57.d:
पात्रं नीराजनार्थं च तथोद्वर्तनमानिले /
गन्धपुष्पान्वितं पात्रमैशान्यां पात्रके न्यसेत् //
:न्
1 सहदेवां सिंहपुच्छीमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / सहदेवां
जवां सिंहीमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 मधुपर्कन्तु पश्चिमे इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 163
57.m:
for the waving of lights, and similarly an unguent in the wind [direction]; / he should deposit a vessel accompanied by perfume and flowers in a vessel in the north-east.
[...]
1 "sahadevāṃ siṃhapucchīm" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "sahadevāṃ javāṃ siṃhīm" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "madhuparkantu paścime" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 163]

57.s:
murāmāṃsī cāmalakaṃ sahadevāṃ niśādikaṃ /
ṣaṣṭidīpānnyasedaṣṭau nyasennīrājanāya ca //
57.d:
मुरामांसी चामलकं सहदेवां निशादिकं /
षष्टिदीपान्न्यसेदष्टौ न्यसेन्नीराजनाय च //
57.m: Murā, māṃsī, āmalaka, sahadevā, turmeric and the like; / one should place sixty lamps, and place eight for waving lights.

57.s:
śaṅkhaṃ cakrañca śrīvatsaṃ kuliśaṃ paṅkajādikaṃ /
hemādipātre kṛtvā tu nānāvarṇādipuṣpakaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kalaśādhivāso nāma
saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha aṣṭapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
snānādividhiḥ
57.d:
शङ्खं चक्रञ्च श्रीवत्सं कुलिशं पङ्कजादिकं /
हेमादिपात्रे कृत्वा तु नानावर्णादिपुष्पकं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये कलशाधिवासो नाम
सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ अष्टपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
स्नानादिविधिः
57.m:
Having made a conch, discus, śrīvatsa, thunderbolt, lotus, and so forth / in a vessel of gold or other [metal], with flowers of various colours and the like.
Thus ends the fifty-seventh chapter, entitled "Preliminary Consecration of the Water Jars," in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now the fifty-eighth chapter.
The Rite of Bathing and Related Ceremonies

58.s:
bhagavānuvāca
aiśānyāṃ janayet kuṇḍaṃ gururvahniñca vaiṣṇavaṃ /
gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sampātavidhinā ghaṭān //
58.d:
भगवानुवाच
ऐशान्यां जनयेत् कुण्डं गुरुर्वह्निञ्च वैष्णवं /
गायत्र्यष्टशतं हुत्वा सम्पातविधिना घटान् //
58.m: The Holy One said: / The guru should produce a fire-pit in the northeast and a Vaiṣṇava fire; / having made one hundred and eight fire oblations with the Gāyatrī, according to the rule of residual drops [he should touch] the jars.

58.s:
prokṣayet kāruśālāyāṃ śilpibhirmūrtipair vrajet /
tūryaśabdaiḥ kautukañca bandhayeddakṣiṇe kare //
58.d:
प्रोक्षयेत् कारुशालायां शिल्पिभिर्मूर्तिपैर् व्रजेत् /
तूर्यशब्दैः कौतुकञ्च बन्धयेद्दक्षिणे करे //
58.m: He should sprinkle [the deity] in the workshop; he should go with the artisans and the ritual assistants; / with sounds of musical instruments, he should bind an amulet cord upon the right hand.

58.s:
viṣṇave śipiviṣṭeti ūrṇāsūtreṇa sarṣapaiḥ /
paṭṭavastreṇa kartavyaṃ deśikasyāpi kautukaṃ //
58.d:
विष्णवे शिपिविष्टेति ऊर्णासूत्रेण सर्षपैः /
पट्टवस्त्रेण कर्तव्यं देशिकस्यापि कौतुकं //
58.m: [With the mantra] "To Viṣṇu, dweller in the rays...", with woollen thread, mustard seeds, / and a silken cloth, the protective cord should also be made for the preceptor.

58.s:
maṇḍape(1) pratimāṃ sthāpya savastrāṃ pūjitān stuvan /
namastercye sureśāni praṇīte viśvakarmaṇā //
58.d:
मण्डपे(1) प्रतिमां स्थाप्य सवस्त्रां पूजितान् स्तुवन् /
नमस्तेर्च्ये सुरेशानि प्रणीते विश्वकर्मणा //
58.m: Having placed the image in the pavilion, robed, praising the worshipped ones: / "Homage to you, worthy of worship, mistress of gods, fashioned by Viśvakarman!

58.s:
prabhāvitāśeṣajagaddhātri tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ /
tvayi sampūjayāmīśe nārāyaṇamanāmayaṃ //
58.d:
प्रभाविताशेषजगद्धात्रि तुभ्यं नमो नमः /
त्वयि सम्पूजयामीशे नारायणमनामयं //
58.m: Homage, homage to you, the upholder of the entire manifested universe! / In you, O sovereign mistress, I worship Nārāyaṇa, the free from affliction.

58.s:
rahitā śilpidoṣaistvamṛddhiyuktā sadā bhava /
evaṃ vijñāpya pratimāṃ nayettāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ //
58.d:
रहिता शिल्पिदोषैस्त्वमृद्धियुक्ता सदा भव /
एवं विज्ञाप्य प्रतिमां नयेत्तां स्नानमण्डपं //
58.m: May you ever be devoid of faults of craftsmanship and endowed with prosperity!" / Having thus addressed [her], he should lead that image to the bathing pavilion.

58.s:
śilpinantoṣayeddravyair gurave gāṃ pradāpayet /
citraṃ deveti mantreṇa netre conmīlayettataḥ //
:n
1 maṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 164
58.d:
शिल्पिनन्तोषयेद्द्रव्यैर् गुरवे गां प्रदापयेत् /
चित्रं देवेति मन्त्रेण नेत्रे चोन्मीलयेत्ततः //
:न्
1 मण्डले इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 164
58.m:
He should satisfy the artisan with wealth; he should cause a cow to be given to the guru; / then he should unclose the eyes with the mantra "The wondrous face of the gods..."
[...]
1 "maṇḍale" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 164]

58.s:
agnirjyotīti dṛṣṭiñca dadyādvai bhadrapīṭhake /
tataḥ śuklāni puṣpāṇi ghṛtaṃ siddhārthakaṃ tathā //
58.d:
अग्निर्ज्योतीति दृष्टिञ्च दद्याद्वै भद्रपीठके /
ततः शुक्लानि पुष्पाणि घृतं सिद्धार्थकं तथा //
58.m: He should direct the gaze upon an auspicious seat with [the mantra] "Agni is light..."; / then white flowers, clarified butter, likewise white mustard,

58.s:
dūrvāṃ kuśāgraṃ devasya dadyācchirasi deśikaḥ /
madhuvāteti mantreṇa netre cābhyañjayedguruḥ //
58.d:
दूर्वां कुशाग्रं देवस्य दद्याच्छिरसि देशिकः /
मधुवातेति मन्त्रेण नेत्रे चाभ्यञ्जयेद्गुरुः //
58.m: dūrvā grass, and the tip of kuśa grass the preceptor should place upon the head of the god; / and the guru should anoint the eyes with the mantra "Sweet the winds..."

58.s:
hiraṇyagarbhamantreṇa imaṃ meti ca kīrtayet /
ghṛtenābhyañjayet paścāt paṭhan ghṛtavatīṃ punaḥ //
58.d:
हिरण्यगर्भमन्त्रेण इमं मेति च कीर्तयेत् /
घृतेनाभ्यञ्जयेत् पश्चात् पठन् घृतवतीं पुनः //
58.m: With the Hiraṇyagarbha mantra, and he should recite "This of mine..."; / he should then smear [the image] with clarified butter, reciting once more the verse containing "ghṛtavatī".

58.s:
masūrapiṣṭe nodvartya(1) ato deveti kīrtayan /
kṣālayeduṣṇatoyena sapta te 'greti deśikaḥ //
58.d:
मसूरपिष्टे नोद्वर्त्य(1) अतो देवेति कीर्तयन् /
क्षालयेदुष्णतोयेन सप्त ते ऽग्रेति देशिकः //
58.m: Having rubbed [the image] with lentil flour, reciting "From this the god...", / the preceptor should wash it with warm water with "Seven are your sparks in front..."

58.s:
drupadādivetyanulimpedāpo hi ṣṭheti secayet /
nadījaistīrthajaiḥ snānaṃ pāvamānīti ratnajaiḥ //
58.d:
द्रुपदादिवेत्यनुलिम्पेदापो हि ष्ठेति सेचयेत् /
नदीजैस्तीर्थजैः स्नानं पावमानीति रत्नजैः //
58.m: He should anoint it with "As one released from the wooden post..."; he should sprinkle it with "For waters are indeed..."; / a bath with river waters, waters from sacred fords, and with gem waters with the Pāvamānī hymns;

58.s:
samudraṃ gaccha candanaistīrthamṛtkalaśena ca /
śanno devīḥ snāpayecca gāyatryāpyuṣṇavāriṇā(2) //
58.d:
समुद्रं गच्छ चन्दनैस्तीर्थमृत्कलशेन च /
शन्नो देवीः स्नापयेच्च गायत्र्याप्युष्णवारिणा(2) //
58.m: with "Go to the ocean...", with sandalwoods and a jar of sacred ford earth; / he should bathe it with "May the divine [waters] be auspicious for us...", and with the Gāyatrī and warm water;

58.s:
pañcamṛddhirhiraṇyeti snāpayetparameśvaraṃ /
sikatādbhirirmaṃ meti valmīkodaghaṭena ca //
58.d:
पञ्चमृद्धिर्हिरण्येति स्नापयेत्परमेश्वरं /
सिकताद्भिरिर्मं मेति वल्मीकोदघटेन च //
58.m: with "The fivefold prosperity..." and "Gold..." he should bathe the Supreme Lord; / with sandy waters, reciting "This of mine...", and with an anthill water jar;

58.s:
tadviṣṇoriti oṣadhyadbhiryā oṣadhīti mantrataḥ /
yajñāyajñeti kāṣāyaiḥ pañcabhirgavyakaistataḥ //
58.d:
तद्विष्णोरिति ओषध्यद्भिर्या ओषधीति मन्त्रतः /
यज्ञायज्ञेति काषायैः पञ्चभिर्गव्यकैस्ततः //
58.m: with "That [highest step] of Viṣṇu...", with herb waters using the mantra "Those herbs..."; / with "Sacrifice after sacrifice...", with astringents, and then with the five products of the cow;

58.s:
payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ mantreṇa yāḥ phalinī phalāmbubhiḥ /
viśvataś cakṣuḥ saumyena pūrveṇa kalasena ca //
58.d:
पयः पृथिव्यां मन्त्रेण याः फलिनी फलाम्बुभिः /
विश्वतश् चक्षुः सौम्येन पूर्वेण कलसेन च //
58.m: with the mantra "Milk upon the earth...", with fruit waters with "Those [plants] bearing fruit..."; / with "He whose eyes are on every side...", with the northern and eastern jar;

58.s:
somaṃ rājānamityevaṃ viṣṇo rarāṭaṃ dakṣataḥ /
haṃsaḥ śuciḥ paścimena kuryādudvartanaṃ hareḥ //
58.d:
सोमं राजानमित्येवं विष्णो रराटं दक्षतः /
हंसः शुचिः पश्चिमेन कुर्यादुद्वर्तनं हरेः //
58.m: similarly with "Soma the King...", and from the south with "The forehead of Viṣṇu..."; / from the west with "The swan seated in purity...", he should rub Hari [with cosmetics].

58.s:
mūrdhānandivamantreṇa dhātrīṃ māṃsīṃ ca ke dadet(3) /
mānastoketi mantreṇa gandhadvāreti gandhakaiḥ //
:n
1 mayūrapicchenodvartya iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gāyatryā gandhavāriṇā iti ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 dhātrīmāṃsyudakena ceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 165
58.d:
मूर्धानन्दिवमन्त्रेण धात्रीं मांसीं च के ददेत्(3) /
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रेण गन्धद्वारेति गन्धकैः //
:न्
1 मयूरपिच्छेनोद्वर्त्य इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गायत्र्या गन्धवारिणा इति ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 धात्रीमांस्युदकेन चेति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 165
58.m:
With the mantra "The head of heaven...", he should place dhātrī and māṃsī on the head; / with the mantra "Do not hurt our children...", and with perfumes with "Through the gateway of fragrance..."
[...]
1 "mayūrapicchenodvartya" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2 "gāyatryā gandhavāriṇā" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa.
3 "dhātrīmāṃsyudakena ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha. / [Page 165]

58.s:
idamāpeti ca ghaṭair etāśītipadasthitaiḥ /
ehyehi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānugrāhakāraka //
58.d:
इदमापेति च घटैर् एताशीतिपदस्थितैः /
एह्येहि भगवन् विष्णो लोकानुग्राहकारक //
58.m: And with jars situated in these eighty squares, with [the mantra] "These waters...": / "Come, come, O Lord Viṣṇu, maker of grace unto the worlds!

58.s:
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ vāsudeva namostu te /
anenāvāhya deveśaṃ kuryāt kautukamocanaṃ //
58.d:
यज्ञभागं गृहाणेमं वासुदेव नमोस्तु ते /
अनेनावाह्य देवेशं कुर्यात् कौतुकमोचनं //
58.m: Accept this portion of sacrifice, O Vāsudeva! Homage be to you!" / Having invoked the Lord of Gods with this, he should untie the amulet cord.

58.s:
muñcāmi tveti sūktena deśikasyāpi mocayet /
hiraṇmayena pādyaṃ dadyādato deveti cārghyakaṃ //
58.d:
मुञ्चामि त्वेति सूक्तेन देशिकस्यापि मोचयेत् /
हिरण्मयेन पाद्यं दद्यादतो देवेति चार्घ्यकं //
