58.m: With the hymn "I release you...", he should release [the cord] of the preceptor as well; / he should give foot-water with "Made of gold...", and water offering with "From this the god...";

58.s:
madhuvātā madhuparkaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi cācamet /
akṣannamīmadanteti kireddarvākṣataṃ budhaḥ //
58.d:
मधुवाता मधुपर्कं मयि गृह्णामि चाचमेत् /
अक्षन्नमीमदन्तेति किरेद्दर्वाक्षतं बुधः //
58.m: the honey-mixture with "Sweet the winds...", and he should sip water with "I take within myself..."; / with "They have eaten and made merry...", the wise one should scatter dūrvā grass and unbroken grain.

58.s:
kāṇḍānnirmañchanaṃ kuryādgandhaṃ gandhavatīti ca /
unnayāmīti(1) mālyañca idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pavitrakaṃ //
58.d:
काण्डान्निर्मञ्छनं कुर्याद्गन्धं गन्धवतीति च /
उन्नयामीति(1) माल्यञ्च इदं विष्णुः पवित्रकं //
58.m: With "From the stem..." he should perform the waving-off rite; and perfume with "Possessing fragrance..."; / and a garland with "I lead up..."; a sacred thread with "This Viṣṇu...";

58.s:
vṛhaspate vastrayugmaṃ vedāhamityuttarīyakaṃ /
mahāvratena sakalīpuṣpaṃ cauṣadhayaḥ kṣipet //
58.d:
वृहस्पते वस्त्रयुग्मं वेदाहमित्युत्तरीयकं /
महाव्रतेन सकलीपुष्पं चौषधयः क्षिपेत् //
58.m: a pair of garments with "O Bṛhaspati..."; an upper garment with "I know [this Great Person]..."; / with the Mahāvrata [hymn] he should cast a composite flower and herbs;

58.s:
dhūpaṃ dadyāddhūrasīti vibhrāṭsūktena cāñjanaṃ /
yuñjantīti ca tilakaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭveti mālyakaṃ //
58.d:
धूपं दद्याद्धूरसीति विभ्राट्सूक्तेन चाञ्जनं /
युञ्जन्तीति च तिलकं दीर्घायुष्ट्वेति माल्यकं //
58.m: he should offer incense with "You are the yoke..."; and collyrium with the Vibhrāṭ hymn; / a tilaka mark with "They harness..."; a garland with "For long life...";

58.s:
indracchatreti chatrantu ādarśantu virājataḥ /
cāmarantu vikarṇena bhūṣāṃ rathantareṇa ca //
58.d:
इन्द्रच्छत्रेति छत्रन्तु आदर्शन्तु विराजतः /
चामरन्तु विकर्णेन भूषां रथन्तरेण च //
58.m: a parasol with "Indra's parasol..."; a mirror with "From the radiant one..."; / a chowrie with "Vikarṇa..."; ornaments with the Rathantara hymn;

58.s:
vyajanaṃ vāyudaivatyair muñcāmi tveti puṣpakaṃ /
vedādyaiḥ saṃstutiṃ kuryāddhareḥ puruṣasūktataḥ //
58.d:
व्यजनं वायुदैवत्यैर् मुञ्चामि त्वेति पुष्पकं /
वेदाद्यैः संस्तुतिं कुर्याद्धरेः पुरुषसूक्ततः //
58.m: a fan with [mantras] sacred to Vāyu; flowers with "I release you..."; / he should praise Hari with the Vedic hymns and the Puruṣa Sūkta.

58.s:
sarvametatsamaṃ kuryāt piṇḍikādau harādike /
devasyotthānasamaye sauparṇaṃ sūktamuccaret //
58.d:
सर्वमेतत्समं कुर्यात् पिण्डिकादौ हरादिके /
देवस्योत्थानसमये सौपर्णं सूक्तमुच्चरेत् //
58.m: He should do all this identically for the pedestal and the rest, and for Hara and the others; / at the time of the rising of the god, he should recite the Sauparṇa hymn.

58.s:
uttiṣṭheti samutthāpya śayyāyā maṇḍape nayet /
śākunenaiva sūktena devaṃ brahmarathādinā //
58.d:
उत्तिष्ठेति समुत्थाप्य शय्याया मण्डपे नयेत् /
शाकुनेनैव सूक्तेन देवं ब्रह्मरथादिना //
58.m: Having raised him with "Arise!", he should lead him to the bed pavilion / with the Śākuna hymn itself, the god, with the Brahma chariot and other [vehicles];

58.s:
ato deveti sūktena prātimāṃ piṇḍikāṃ tathā /
śrīsūktena ca śayyāyāṃ viṣṇostu śakalīkṛtiḥ //
:n
1 tattvāyāmīti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 166
58.d:
अतो देवेति सूक्तेन प्रातिमां पिण्डिकां तथा /
श्रीसूक्तेन च शय्यायां विष्णोस्तु शकलीकृतिः //
:न्
1 तत्त्वायामीति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 166
58.m:
the image and the pedestal with the hymn "From this the god..."; / and on the bed with the Śrī Sūkta is the placing on the couch of Viṣṇu.
[...]
1 "tattvāyāmīti" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha. / [Page 166]

58.s:
mṛgarājaṃ vṛṣaṃ nāgaṃ vyajanaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā /
vaijayantīṃ tathā bherīṃ dīpamityaṣṭamaṅgalaṃ //
58.d:
मृगराजं वृषं नागं व्यजनं कलशं तथा /
वैजयन्तीं तथा भेरीं दीपमित्यष्टमङ्गलं //
58.m: A lion, a bull, an elephant, a fan, a water jar, / a victory banner, a kettle-drum, and a lamp: the eight auspicious emblems;

58.s:
darśayedaśvasūktena pādadeśe tripāditi /
ukhāṃ pidhānakaṃ pātramambikāṃ darvikāṃ dadet //
58.d:
दर्शयेदश्वसूक्तेन पाददेशे त्रिपादिति /
उखां पिधानकं पात्रमम्बिकां दर्विकां ददेत् //
58.m: he should display them at the feet with the Horse hymn and "With three quarters..."; / he should provide a cooking pot, a lid, a vessel, an Ambikā dish, and a ladle;

58.s:
muṣalolūkhalaṃ dadyācchilāṃ sammārjanīṃ tathā /
tathā bhojanabhāṇḍāni gṛhopakāraṇāni ca //
58.d:
मुषलोलूखलं दद्याच्छिलां सम्मार्जनीं तथा /
तथा भोजनभाण्डानि गृहोपकारणानि च //
58.m: he should provide a pestle and mortar, a grinding stone, and a broom, / as well as eating vessels and household utensils;

58.s:
śirodeśe ca nidrākhyaṃ vastraratnayutaṃ ghaṭaṃ /
khaṇḍakhādyaiḥ pūrayitvā snapanasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye snapanādividhānaṃ nāma
aṣṭapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
adhivāsanakathanaṃ
58.d:
शिरोदेशे च निद्राख्यं वस्त्ररत्नयुतं घटं /
खण्डखाद्यैः पूरयित्वा स्नपनस्य विधिः स्मृतः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये स्नपनादिविधानं नाम
अष्टपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथोनषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
अधिवासनकथनं
58.m:
and at the head, the jar called Nidrā, accompanied by cloth and jewels, / filled with candied foods. This is recorded as the rule of bathing.
Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter, entitled "The Procedure for Bathing and Related Ceremonies," in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now the fifty-ninth chapter.
Instruction on the Preliminary Consecration
